card_unit_lancashire_fusiliers.name: card_unit_lancashire_fusiliers
card_unit_lancashire_fusiliers.title: LANCASHIRE FUSILIERS
card_unit_lancashire_fusiliers.flavorText: The Lancashire Fusiliers was a line infantry regiment of the British Army that was active from 1688 to 1968. At the outbreak of WWII the regiment was stationed in British India and their first engagement was during the Burma Campaign where the 1st Battalion fought with the 77th Indian Infantry Brigade. The 2nd Battalion joined the British Expeditionary Forces and fought in Belgium and France before it was evacuated from Dunkirk. Parts of the 2nd Battalion participated in the Normandy landings during Operation Overlord and would later participate in two operations on French soil. In 1943 members of the Lancashire Fusiliers participated in the Italian Campaign and saw heavy fighting on the Gothic Line. In early 1945 parts of the regiment were sent to Palestine were they served for the rest of the war.

The QF 40 mm Mark III variant (QF stood for quick firing) was the standard light AA weapon of the British Army and considered vital in the defense of Britain and the Commonwealth countries after the fall of France. By the end of the war over 19,000 units had been produced and a small number of these weapons remain in service to this day.

card_event_radar_alert.title: RADAR ALERT
card_event_radar_alert.text: add a random British air unit of similar cost.
card_event_radar_alert.flavorText: and some of the energy returned as an echo that was displayed on a cathode-ray tube. The time between transmission and echo reception was used to calculate the distance to the reflecting object.

card_event_rescue_mission.name: card_event_rescue_mission
card_event_rescue_mission.title: RESCUE MISSION
card_event_rescue_mission.text: add two copies of it to your hand.
card_event_rescue_mission.flavorText: more than 8,000 aircrew and 5,000 civilians had been rescued from the sea.

card_event_supply_drop.name: card_event_supply_drop
card_event_supply_drop.title: SUPPLY DROP
card_event_supply_drop.text: Give a tank or infantry +4 defense and Guard. Smokescreen is removed.
card_event_supply_drop.flavorText: is a way of delivering supplies via military transport aircraft. This was a method developed during WWII and used to resupply otherwise inaccessible troops.

card_event_tactical_withdrawal.name: card_event_tactical_withdrawal
card_event_tactical_withdrawal.title: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
card_event_tactical_withdrawal.text: Retreat a friendly unit in the frontline and fully repair it. It can operate again this turn.
card_event_tactical_withdrawal.flavorText: the British Expeditionary Force was able to fortify the port of Dunkirk and initiate a frantic retreat codenamed Operation Dynamo.

card_event_the_commonwealth.name: card_event_the_commonwealth
card_event_the_commonwealth.title: THE COMMONWEALTH
card_event_the_commonwealth.text: Deal 20 damage to target HQ if your HQ has 30 or more defense. Draw 4 cards.
card_event_the_commonwealth.flavorText: India and the other colonial Dominions of the Empire had no choice and automatically joined in the war on the side of Britain. The Dominions made their own decision to enter the war on the British side. The Irish Free State decided on neutrality.

card_event_the_empire.name: card_event_the_empire
card_event_the_empire.title: THE EMPIRE STRIKES
card_event_the_empire.text: Deal damage to each enemy equal to 1 plus the number of bombers you control.
card_event_the_empire.flavorText: and was considered global super power at the outbreak of WWII.

card_event_ultra.name: card_event_ultra
card_event_ultra.title: ULTRA
card_event_ultra.text: Counter an enemy order and draw a card.
card_event_ultra.flavorText: a cryptography machine used by the Germans.

card_event_unexpected_resistance.name: card_event_unexpected_resistance
card_event_unexpected_resistance.title: UNEXPECTED RESISTANCE
card_event_unexpected_resistance.flavorText: the British and Polish troops put up a heavy resistance and fought for several days. Their story is told in the 1977 cinematic masterpiece "A Bridge Too Far".

card_unit_17_pounder.name: card_unit_17_pounder
card_unit_17_pounder.title: 17 POUNDER
card_unit_17_pounder.text: Deployment: Pin target enemy unit. Draw a card if it is a tank.
card_unit_17_pounder.flavorText: such as the Sherman Firefly and the Cruiser Mark VIII Challenger.

card_unit_1st_airlanding_brigade.name: card_unit_1st_airlanding_brigade
card_unit_1st_airlanding_brigade.title: 1st AIRLANDING BRIGADE
card_unit_1st_airlanding_brigade.flavorText: the brigade was sent to Norway to disarm a German garrison and shortly after it was disbanded.

card_unit_22nd_guards_brigade.name: card_unit_22nd_guards_brigade
card_unit_22nd_guards_brigade.title: 22nd GUARDS BRIGADE
card_unit_22nd_guards_brigade.text: Becomes Veteran at the start of its third turn on the battlefield.
card_unit_22nd_guards_brigade.flavorText: the brigade was sent back to Britain in 1944 where it became a training brigade for the whole Brigade of Guards for the rest of the war.

card_unit_25_pounder.name: card_unit_25_pounder
card_unit_25_pounder.title: 25 POUNDER
card_unit_25_pounder.flavorText: and a reasonably lethal shell in a highly mobile piece.

card_unit_2_pounder.name: card_unit_2_pounder
card_unit_2_pounder.title: 2 POUNDER
card_unit_2_pounder.flavorText: but some remained in service until the end of the war.

card_unit_3_7_inch_aa_gun.name: card_unit_3_7_inch_aa_gun
card_unit_3_7_inch_aa_gun.title: 3.7” ANTI-AIR GUN
card_unit_3_7_inch_aa_gun.text: Deployment: Pin all enemy air units.

card_unit_5th_brigade.name: card_unit_5th_brigade
card_unit_5th_brigade.title: 5th BRIGADE
card_unit_5th_brigade.flavorText: the 5th Brigade served in the Burma Campaign and the Battle of Kohima.

card_unit_6_pounder.name: card_unit_6_pounder
card_unit_6_pounder.title: 6 POUNDER
card_unit_6_pounder.flavorText: was a British 57 mm gun which was mainly used as an anti-tank gun by the British Army and the Allies during WWII. The 6 pounder was also used as a main armament a number of Allied tanks and other armored vehicles.

card_unit_85_pioneer_company.name: card_unit_85_pioneer_company
card_unit_85_pioneer_company.title: 85 PIONEER COMPANY
card_unit_85_pioneer_company.text: The first order you play each turn costs 1 less.

card_unit_albacore.name: card_unit_albacore
card_unit_albacore.title: ALBACORE Mk I
card_unit_albacore.text: Deployment: Deal 1 damage to an enemy ground unit and pin it.
card_unit_albacore.flavorText: but from 1943 the Fleet Air Arm service started replacing it with the Barracuda.

card_unit_argyllshire_highlanders.name: card_unit_argyllshire_highlanders
card_unit_argyllshire_highlanders.title: ARGYLLSHIRE HIGHLANDERS
card_unit_argyllshire_highlanders.text: Gets +1+1 when you deploy or add a Guard unit.
card_unit_argyllshire_highlanders.flavorText: The Argyll and Sutherland Highlanders was an  infantry regiment of the British Army and was created in 1881. The regiment was expanded to fifteen battalions during WWI (1914–1918) and nine during WWII (1939–1945) which between them participated in all theaters of the war.

card_unit_baluch_regiment.name: card_unit_baluch_regiment
card_unit_baluch_regiment.title: BALUCH REGIMENT
card_unit_baluch_regiment.flavorText: but most of them were disbanded in 1945.

card_unit_black_watch.name: card_unit_black_watch
card_unit_black_watch.title: BLACK WATCH
card_unit_black_watch.text: Orders in enemy hand cost 2 more.
card_unit_black_watch.flavorText: North West Europe and Burma. It's uncertain where the "Black Watch" name comes from but it may originate from the uniform plaids of dark tartan which the companies were provided and wore as part of its everyday uniform until 1940.

card_unit_british_sherman_firefly.name: card_unit_british_sherman_firefly
card_unit_british_sherman_firefly.title: M4 FIREFLY
card_unit_british_sherman_firefly.text: Deployment: Deal 5 damage to an enemy tank.
card_unit_british_sherman_firefly.flavorText: as well as tanks like the Panzer IVs and StuGs.

card_unit_churchill.name: card_unit_churchill
card_unit_churchill.title: CHURCHILL Mk IV
card_unit_churchill.flavorText: but had the ability to cross difficult ground and several variations were produced. The tank was named after British Prime Minister Winston Churchill.

card_unit_coastal_gun.name: card_unit_coastal_gun
card_unit_coastal_gun.title: 9.2” COASTAL GUN
card_unit_coastal_gun.text: Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ.
card_unit_coastal_gun.flavorText: and their role was to defeat enemy ships attacking the ships in a port. The 9.2 inch coastal gun fired 170 kg shells and had a maximum firing range of 26.7 km (29,200 yd).

card_unit_comet1.name: card_unit_comet1
card_unit_comet1.title: A34 COMET
card_unit_comet1.flavorText: hull gunner) and a main armament of 77 mm HV gun and a secondary armament of 2 x 7.92 mm Besa machine guns.

card_unit_commandos.name: card_unit_commandos
card_unit_commandos.title: No. 10 COMMANDO
card_unit_commandos.text: deal 1 damage to a random enemy.

card_unit_crusader_mk_ii.name: card_unit_crusader_mk_ii
card_unit_crusader_mk_ii.title: CRUSADER Mk II
card_unit_crusader_mk_ii.flavorText: the tank was no longer used in the front-lines and was replaced with the US-supplied M3 Grant and Sherman medium tanks.

card_unit_daimler_mk_ii.name: card_unit_daimler_mk_ii
card_unit_daimler_mk_ii.title: HUMBER Mk II
card_unit_daimler_mk_ii.flavorText: a main armament of Mk I-III 15 mm Besa machine gun and a secondary armament of 7.92 mm Besa machine gun.

card_unit_gladiator.name: card_unit_gladiator
card_unit_gladiator.title: GLADIATOR Mk I
card_unit_gladiator.flavorText: The Gloster Gladiator (or Gloster SS.37) was a British biplane fighter. It was used by both the Royal Air Force (RAF) and the Fleet Air Arm (FAA) (as the Sea Gladiator variant). Although the Gladiator was the last biplane fighter aircraft put in service by the RAF it was used throughout WWII and saw action in almost all theaters of the war.

card_unit_gladiator_escort.name: card_unit_gladiator_escort
card_unit_gladiator_escort.title: GLADIATOR ESCORT
card_unit_gladiator_escort.text: Damage to STIRLING Mk I S3 is dealt to this unit instead.

card_unit_grenadier_guards.name: card_unit_grenadier_guards
card_unit_grenadier_guards.title: GRENADIER GUARDS
card_unit_grenadier_guards.flavorText: the Italian Campaign and the final stages of the Tunisia Campaign. The Battalions of the Grenadier Guards saw action in most major military operations and battles from 1944 to 1945.

card_unit_hampden.name: card_unit_hampden
card_unit_hampden.title: HAMPDEN Mk I
card_unit_hampden.flavorText: but it was used as a long-range torpedo bomber and reconnaissance aircraft to some extent after that.

card_unit_hudson.name: card_unit_hudson
card_unit_hudson.title: HUDSON Mk III
card_unit_hudson.text: it gets Fury until end of turn.
card_unit_hudson.flavorText: mostly in maritime operations but also in transport and training roles as well as delivering agents into occupied France.

card_unit_hurricane.name: card_unit_hurricane
card_unit_hurricane.title: HURRICANE Mk I
card_unit_hurricane.flavorText: it did a very good job in taking down the German bombers.

card_unit_lancaster.name: card_unit_lancaster
card_unit_lancaster.title: LANCASTER Mk I
card_unit_lancaster.flavorText: which meant it could carry the biggest bombs the RAF had in their arsenal. The Lancaster was first used in the strategic bombing offensive over Europe in 1942 and after that it operated in almost every major bombing raid in the European conflict.

card_unit_lancaster_biii.name: card_unit_lancaster_biii
card_unit_lancaster_biii.title: LANCASTER B.III
card_unit_lancaster_biii.text: cards in enemy hand cost +1 kredit.
card_unit_lancaster_biii.flavorText: The Avro Lancaster B.III (Special) was a British heavy bomber variant used by the Allies during WWII. This variant was built to carry the "Upkeep" bouncing bomb for dam busting raids. The bomb bay doors were removed and the dam busting bomb was mounted under the aircraft. A chain driven by a hydraulic motor gave the bomb its backspin when it was dropped. In total 23 aircraft of this type were built.

card_unit_mathilda_mk_ii.name: card_unit_mathilda_mk_ii
card_unit_mathilda_mk_ii.title: MATILDA Mk II
card_unit_mathilda_mk_ii.text: Units damaged by MATILDA Mk II are pinned.
card_unit_mathilda_mk_ii.flavorText: commander) and had a mounted 2 pounder (40 mm) and a 7.92 mm Besa machine gun.

card_unit_mosquito.name: card_unit_mosquito
card_unit_mosquito.title: MOSQUITO FB Mk VI
card_unit_mosquito.text: Deployment: Deal 4 damage to an enemy unit.
card_unit_mosquito.flavorText: maritime strike aircraft and photo-reconnaissance aircraft.

card_unit_p38_lightning_raf.name: card_unit_p38_lightning_raf
card_unit_p38_lightning_raf.title: RAAF LIGHTNING F-4
card_unit_p38_lightning_raf.flavorText: radar and visual path-finding for bombers and evacuation missions.

card_unit_p40_kittyhawk.name: card_unit_p40_kittyhawk
card_unit_p40_kittyhawk.title: P-40 KITTYHAWK
card_unit_p40_kittyhawk.text: Deployment: Deal 2 damage to an enemy ground target.
card_unit_p40_kittyhawk.flavorText: but the Americans used the name Warhawk.

card_unit_royal_engineers.name: card_unit_royal_engineers
card_unit_royal_engineers.title: 26 ENGINEER REGIMENT
card_unit_royal_engineers.text: Deployment: Give all other friendly units +2 defense.

card_unit_royal_west_kents.name: card_unit_royal_west_kents
card_unit_royal_west_kents.title: ROYAL WEST KENTS
card_unit_royal_west_kents.text: Your other Guard units have +2 attack and Blitz.

card_unit_sexton.name: card_unit_sexton
card_unit_sexton.title: SEXTON
card_unit_sexton.flavorText: and then the Sexton II design which was based on the Grizzly (M4A1 Sherman) hull. Both versions used a QF 25 pounder gun-howitzer as its main armament and for secondary armament it used two 0.303 (7.7 mm) Bren light machine guns.The British forces used the Sexton for indirect supporting fire and kept them back from the front line and used forward observers to direct fire onto a target. The Sexton was produced from 1943 to 1945 with a total of 2000 units put into service.

card_unit_skua_mk_ii.name: card_unit_skua_mk_ii
card_unit_skua_mk_ii.title: BLACKBURN SKUA Mk II
card_unit_skua_mk_ii.flavorText: and by 1941 most of them were withdrawn from frontline service.

card_unit_spitfire.name: card_unit_spitfire
card_unit_spitfire.title: SPITFIRE Mk Ia
card_unit_spitfire.flavorText: especially during the Battle of Britain. Many variants of the Spitfire were built and it was produced in greater numbers than any other British aircraft.

card_unit_spitfire_v.name: card_unit_spitfire_v
card_unit_spitfire_v.title: SPITFIRE Mk V
card_unit_spitfire_v.flavorText: the Spitfire Mk V was designed and produced in 1941 and it was a Mk I with the Merlin 45 series engine. Three versions of the Mk V were produced and several sub-series.

card_unit_stirling.name: card_unit_stirling
card_unit_stirling.title: STIRLING Mk I S3
card_unit_stirling.text: Deployment: Add a GLADIATOR ESCORT fighter to the support line.
card_unit_stirling.flavorText: became increasingly available for the strategic bombing of Germany.

card_unit_swordfish.name: card_unit_swordfish
card_unit_swordfish.title: SWORDFISH Mk I
card_unit_swordfish.flavorText: and caused more destruction of Axis shipping than any other Allied aircraft. The Swordfish was also involved in the bombing and sinking of the Bismarck.

card_event_breakout.name: card_event_breakout
card_event_breakout.title: BREAKOUT
card_event_breakout.text: Give a Veteran unit Fury and Shock.

card_event_creeping_barrage.name: card_event_creeping_barrage
card_event_creeping_barrage.title: CREEPING BARRAGE
card_event_creeping_barrage.flavorText: effectively blending artillery support with infantry movement.

card_event_desert_dust.name: card_event_desert_dust
card_event_desert_dust.title: DESERT DUST
card_event_desert_dust.text: Pin target unit. Add two GARRISON units to your support line.
card_event_desert_dust.flavorText: misled German forces into overestimating British strength and contributed to the Allied victory.

card_event_echelon.name: card_event_echelon
card_event_echelon.title: ECHELON
card_event_echelon.text: Your units get: "Gets +1+1 if another of your units is attacked."
card_event_echelon.flavorText: land and naval forces. The first recorded use of an echelon formation was in the Battle of Leuctra in 371 BC.

card_event_entanglement.name: card_event_entanglement
card_event_entanglement.title: ENTANGLEMENT
card_event_entanglement.text: give it +2 defense before damage. Add a GARRISON to your support line.
card_event_entanglement.flavorText: a strong prepared position is a force multiplier. Any attacking unit caught in an entanglement is at a serious disadvantage.

card_event_kangaroo_transport.name: card_event_kangaroo_transport
card_event_kangaroo_transport.title: KANGAROO TRANSPORT
card_event_kangaroo_transport.text: Give a British infantry Blitz and +1 Heavy Armor.
card_event_kangaroo_transport.flavorText: where they helped troops advance alongside tanks.

card_unit_70th_brigade.name: card_unit_70th_brigade
card_unit_70th_brigade.title: 70th BRIGADE
card_unit_70th_brigade.text: draw a card and gain +2 HQ defense if this unit was not attacked last turn.
card_unit_70th_brigade.flavorText: but withdrew from the frontline in August and disbanded in order to fill the gaps in other infantry formations. In October 1944 the brigade ceased to exist and most of its men were posted to battalions of the 50th (Northumbrian) and the 51st (Highland) Infantry Divisions.

card_unit_black_prince.name: card_unit_black_prince
card_unit_black_prince.title: BLACK PRINCE
card_unit_black_prince.text: Only 2 units can occupy the frontline. Deployment: Retreat all units in it.
card_unit_black_prince.flavorText: the project was discontinued after the war.

card_unit_bloody_eleventh.name: card_unit_bloody_eleventh
card_unit_bloody_eleventh.title: BLOODY ELEVENTH
card_unit_bloody_eleventh.flavorText: and served with various divisions until the end of the war.

card_unit_chesire_regiment.name: card_unit_chesire_regiment
card_unit_chesire_regiment.title: CHESHIRE REGIMENT
card_unit_chesire_regiment.text: deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ if this unit was not attacked last turn.

card_unit_frontier_force.name: card_unit_frontier_force
card_unit_frontier_force.title: FRONTIER FORCE
card_unit_frontier_force.text: Deployment: Add a GARRISON unit to your hand.
card_unit_frontier_force.flavorText: while the 5th battalion was on garrison duties in Iraq as part of the 6th Indian Infantry Division. The Regiment's casualties in the war totalled 1,444 dead and 3,503 wounded.

card_unit_garrison.name: card_unit_garrison
card_unit_garrison.title: GARRISON
card_unit_garrison.text: deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ if this unit was not attacked last turn.

card_unit_humber_mk_iv.name: card_unit_humber_mk_iv
card_unit_humber_mk_iv.title: HUMBER Mk IV
card_unit_humber_mk_iv.flavorText: but also in infantry support roles.

card_unit_matilda_mk_iv.name: card_unit_matilda_mk_iv
card_unit_matilda_mk_iv.title: MATILDA Mk IV
card_unit_matilda_mk_iv.text: Becomes Veteran after it Shock attacks.
card_unit_matilda_mk_iv.flavorText: Soviet Union and in the Pacific. The Mk IV variant used a QF 3-inch howitzer instead of the QF 2-pounder. The QF 3-inch gun fired high explosives and smoke shells and was much favored in the Pacific.

card_unit_slashers.name: card_unit_slashers
card_unit_slashers.title: SLASHERS
card_unit_slashers.text: add a GARRISON unit to your support line.

card_unit_the_rangers.name: card_unit_the_rangers
card_unit_the_rangers.title: THE RANGERS
card_unit_the_rangers.text: non-attack damage dealt by your units by 1.
card_unit_the_rangers.flavorText: they withdrew to Egypt. The depleted Battalion was disbanded in September 1942 and the remaining men re-allocated to other units.

card_event_active_sonar.name: card_event_active_sonar
card_event_active_sonar.title: ACTIVE SONAR
card_event_active_sonar.text: Pin all enemy units. Increase cost of all cards in enemy hand by 3.

card_event_advanced_royal_research.name: card_event_advanced_royal_research
card_event_advanced_royal_research.title: ADVANCED ROYAL RESEARCH
card_event_advanced_royal_research.text: Choose one - add ACTIVE SONAR to your hand OR add BLETCHLEY PARK to your hand.

card_event_airdrop.name: card_event_airdrop
card_event_airdrop.title: AIRDROP
card_event_airdrop.flavorText: 6th Airborne Division and the independent 2nd Parachute Brigade.

card_event_bletchley_park.name: card_event_bletchley_park
card_event_bletchley_park.title: BLETCHLEY PARK
card_event_bletchley_park.text: All enemy cards with cost 5 or less in hand and on the battlefield are put on top of enemy's deck.

card_event_critical_damage.name: card_event_critical_damage
card_event_critical_damage.title: CRITICAL DAMAGE
card_event_critical_damage.flavorText: and 4,303 aircrew. Most of the Luftwaffe aircraft that were shot down were bombers.

card_event_dowding_system.name: card_event_dowding_system
card_event_dowding_system.title: DOWDING SYSTEM
card_event_dowding_system.text: Counter an enemy order with cost 4 or more.
card_event_dowding_system.flavorText: searchlights and barrage balloons against the attacking Luftwaffe.

card_event_evasive_action.name: card_event_evasive_action
card_event_evasive_action.title: EVASIVE ACTION
card_event_evasive_action.text: Trigger this card when the enemy deploys a unit with a deployment effect. Cancel the effect.
card_event_evasive_action.flavorText: followed by a steep climb and then to roll and repeat the manoeuvre. The dive was intended to pull enough G-force that it would tear off the wings of a fighter. Another evasive maneuver was the “Barrel Roll” which involved slowing down the forward motion by doing a Helical Roll around a straight flightpath. This would often force an attacking fighter to overshoot the bomber and fly out in front.

card_event_expanded_royal_research.name: card_event_expanded_royal_research
card_event_expanded_royal_research.title: EXPANDED ROYAL RESEARCH
card_event_expanded_royal_research.text: Choose one - add SYNTHETIC RUBBER to hand OR add ADVANCED ROYAL RESEARCH to hand.

card_event_fog_of_war.name: card_event_fog_of_war
card_event_fog_of_war.title: FOG OF WAR
card_event_fog_of_war.text: Remove target unit from the battlefield. Put two copies on top of owner's deck.
card_event_fog_of_war.flavorText: but is actually a paraphrase of what he said:  “War is the realm of uncertainty; three quarters of the factors on which action in war is based are wrapped in a fog of greater or lesser uncertainty.”

card_event_long_range_desert_group.name: card_event_long_range_desert_group
card_event_long_range_desert_group.title: LONG RANGE DESERT GROUP
card_event_long_range_desert_group.flavorText: but they were perhaps better known for their cooperation with the newly established SAS that were operating behind enemy lines. In 1943 the LRDG was retrained for mountain warfare and for the remainder of the war they operated in Italy and the Balkans where they continued to support the Allied onslaught against the Axis.

card_event_radar.name: card_event_radar
card_event_radar.title: RADAR
card_event_radar.text: Draw a card. Your HQ gains +4 defense.

card_event_royal_research.name: card_event_royal_research
card_event_royal_research.title: ROYAL RESEARCH
card_event_royal_research.text: Choose one - add RADAR to hand OR add EXPANDED ROYAL RESEARCH to hand.
card_event_royal_research.flavorText: a portable truss bridge that was used by Allied military engineers.

card_event_sea_patrol.name: card_event_sea_patrol
card_event_sea_patrol.title: SEA PATROL
card_event_sea_patrol.text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Costs 1 less for each friendly air unit.
card_event_sea_patrol.flavorText: In WWII maritime patrol aircraft used by the RAF were often older biplanes or converted bombers or airliners. Other maritime aircraft were also used such as the Short Sunderland flying boat and the Consolidated PBY Catalina. During the war there were also major developments in sonar and radar technology which helped the aircrafts to find and destroy enemy submarines.

card_event_second_chance.name: card_event_second_chance
card_event_second_chance.title: SECOND CHANCE
card_event_second_chance.text: Draw two random orders from your deck.
card_event_second_chance.flavorText: usually those that had been rejected or withdrawn from front line service. Spitfires and Boulton Paul Defiants were used to look for downed aircrew and Avro Ansons to drop supplies. Supermarine Walrus and Supermarine Sea Otter amphibious aircraft were used to pick up aircrew from the water.

card_event_synthetic_rubber.name: card_event_synthetic_rubber
card_event_synthetic_rubber.title: SYNTHETIC RUBBER
card_event_synthetic_rubber.text: then set its attack equal to its defense.

card_unit_cruiser_mk_iii.name: card_unit_cruiser_mk_iii
card_unit_cruiser_mk_iii.title: CRUISER Mk III
card_unit_cruiser_mk_iii.flavorText: but it was mechanically unreliable and the armor was insufficient which made it vulnerable in combat. Only 65 Mk III’s were produced.

card_unit_irish_guards.name: card_unit_irish_guards
card_unit_irish_guards.title: IRISH GUARDS
card_unit_irish_guards.flavorText: Operation Market Garden and the Rhineland Campaign.

card_unit_no_3_commando.name: card_unit_no_3_commando
card_unit_no_3_commando.title: No. 3 COMMANDO
card_unit_no_3_commando.text: Units with 4 or more attack cannot attack.
card_unit_no_3_commando.flavorText: and as such they would fight with the Allied forces on the Western Front until the war in Europe ended. After the German surrendered Nr. 3 was tasked with occupational duties before being sent home to Britain in 1946 and disbanded.

card_unit_raf_ground_crew.name: card_unit_raf_ground_crew
card_unit_raf_ground_crew.title: RAF GROUND CREW
card_unit_raf_ground_crew.text: Your Spitfires cost 2 less to deploy and get +1+1 when deployed.
card_unit_raf_ground_crew.flavorText: checking them over and warming the engines before a flying mission.

card_unit_royal_scots.name: card_unit_royal_scots

In 1942 the regiment and the rest of the 11th Brigade became part of the 78th Battleaxe Infantry Division which participated in Operation Torch and landed in Algiers as part of the British First Army. In 1943 they fought with the British Eight Army in the Italian Campaign and participated in the Battle of Termoli and saw combat at the Barbara Line and River Sangro. In 1944 the division participated in the fourth and final battle of Monte Cassino and in the winter they participated in Operation Olive where they fought against the German forces in the Apennine Mountains. Finally the regiment fought with the 78th Division in the spring offensive of 1945 and ended the war in Austria.

card_event_enigma.flavorText: the Allies finally managed to crack the Enigma Code.

card_event_iron_from_the_north.name: card_event_iron_from_the_north
card_event_iron_from_the_north.title: IRON FROM THE NORTH

card_event_reinforcements.flavorText: A reinforcement in military terms is when additional troops or material are sent to support a military action.

card_unit_22_infantry.flavorText: the remains of the division surrendered to the Soviet Army.

card_unit_33_panzergrenadier.name: card_unit_33_panzergrenadier
card_unit_33_panzergrenadier.title: 33. PANZERGRENADIER
card_unit_33_panzergrenadier.flavorText: the Battle of Moscow and the Battle of Kursk. In 1944 the division was moved to northern Lithuania where they supported the defenses against the Soviet offensive until the end of the war.

card_unit_3_fallschirmjager.name: card_unit_3_fallschirmjager

card_unit_3_fallschirmjager.flavorText: Vitebsk and Smolensk over the next couple of years. In 1943 it was sent to Sicily to defend against the Allied invasion of the island and spent the remainder of the war slowly retreating up the Italian peninsula from one defensive position to another.

card_unit_4_pioneer.name: card_unit_4_pioneer
card_unit_4_pioneer.title: 4. PIONEER BATTALION

card_unit_4_pioneer.flavorText: maintain supply routes etc. The 4th Pioneer Battalion was attached to the 13th Infantry Division of the Wehrmacht and first saw combat in the Polish Campaign. They fought in France and on the Eastern Front until they finally surrendered to the American Army in Herford Germany in 1945.

card_unit_88_mm_flak.name: card_unit_88_mm_flak
card_unit_88_mm_flak.title: 88 mm FLAK

card_unit_88_mm_flak.flavorText: originally manufactured and used as an anti-aircraft gun but also used as anti-tank artillery gun. It was widely used by Germany in WWII and was one of the most recognized German weapons in the conflict.

card_unit_arado_ar_196.name: card_unit_arado_ar_196
card_unit_arado_ar_196.title: ARADO AR 196
card_unit_arado_ar_196.flavorText: but it was no match against enemy fighters. The Finnish Air Force used it for transporting and supplying special forces behind enemy lines as it had the ability to land on small lakes in remote locations.

card_unit_comet.name: card_unit_comet
card_unit_comet.title: KOMET
card_unit_comet.flavorText: due to the rocket's short fuel life which only allowed for a short time to attack. Allied pilots soon learned to simply wait until the rocket fuel ran out before beginning their attacks.

card_unit_dornier_do_217.name: card_unit_dornier_do_217
card_unit_dornier_do_217.title: DORNIER DO 217

card_unit_fallschirmjager.flavorText: which was formed in 1943. The regiment fought with its division in Normandy and in the Arnhem area before participating in the Battle of the Hurtgen Forest in Germany. They surrendered to the Americans in Rhur in April 1945.

card_unit_flak_37_spg.name: card_unit_flak_37_spg
card_unit_flak_37_spg.title: 3.7cm FLAK 37
card_unit_flak_37_spg.flavorText: most of which were of the Flak 36 and Flak 37 variant design.

card_unit_fw_190.title: FW 190 A
card_unit_fw_190.flavorText: ground-attack aircraft and night fighter. The FW 190 was well-liked by its pilots and a number of German fighter aces claimed many aerial victories while flying it.

card_unit_grenadier_245.name: card_unit_grenadier_245
card_unit_grenadier_245.title: 980. VOLKSGRENADIER
card_unit_grenadier_245.flavorText: the defense of the Eastern Front and Siegfried Line, and in the final battles in Germany.

card_unit_henschel_hs_123.name: card_unit_henschel_hs_123
card_unit_henschel_hs_123.title: HENSCHEL HS 123

card_unit_jagdpanther.name: card_unit_jagdpanther
card_unit_jagdpanther.title: JAGDPANTHER
card_unit_jagdpanther.flavorText: a main armament of 1x 8.8 cm Pak 43/3 or 43/4 L/71 and a secondary armament of 1x 7.92 mm Maschinengewehr 34. Only 415 Jagdpanther's were produced and placed into service.

card_unit_junkers_ju_188.name: card_unit_junkers_ju_188
card_unit_junkers_ju_188.title: JUNKERS JU 188 E
card_unit_junkers_ju_188.flavorText: the Luftwaffe focusing more on building fighters and the effect the heavy Allied bombing had on German industries.

card_unit_junkers_ju_88.name: card_unit_junkers_ju_88
card_unit_junkers_ju_88.title: JUNKERS JU 88 A
card_unit_junkers_ju_88.flavorText: the Ju 88 became one of the most important aircraft for the Luftwaffe and it was produced nonstop from 1936 to 1945.

card_unit_ju_87_stuka.name: card_unit_ju_87_stuka
card_unit_ju_87_stuka.title: JU 87 B STUKA
card_unit_ju_87_stuka.text: The enemy must discard a card each time Stuka deals damage to their HQ.
card_unit_ju_87_stuka.flavorText: was a German dive bomber and ground-attack aircraft. The aircraft was easily recognized by its inverted wings and undercarriage and the wailing sound of the Jericho-Trumpets when it made its dive. The Stuka was the main aircraft used for close air support in the Luftwaffe and was first used in combat in the Spanish Civil War in 1937 and served the Axis forces throughout WWII.

card_unit_marder_iii_h.name: card_unit_marder_iii_h
card_unit_marder_iii_h.title: MARDER III H
card_unit_marder_iii_h.flavorText: The Marder III H was a German tank destroyer that was produced from 1942 to 1944 and served at the frontline until the end of WWII. The Marder III H variant mounted a 7.5 cm Pak 40 German anti-tank gun on a slightly modified Panzer 38(t) Ausf. H chassis and also carried a 7.92 mm machine gun in the hull. This tank destroyer type was considered mechanically reliable and it carried enough firepower to take out the majority of enemy tanks on the battlefield.

card_unit_me_262_schwalbe.name: card_unit_me_262_schwalbe
card_unit_me_262_schwalbe.title: ME 262A SCHWALBE
card_unit_me_262_schwalbe.text: Deployment: Destroy all enemy air units.
card_unit_me_262_schwalbe.flavorText: however the Czechoslovak Air Force the operated the aircraft until 1951.

card_unit_me_bf_109_g.name: card_unit_me_bf_109_g
card_unit_me_bf_109_g.title: ME BF 109 E
card_unit_me_bf_109_g.flavorText: and conducted more aerial kills than any other aircraft during WWII.

card_unit_me_bf_110.name: card_unit_me_bf_110

card_unit_me_bf_110.flavorText: but by 1944 it was no match against American air supremacy.

card_unit_nebelwerfer.name: card_unit_nebelwerfer
card_unit_nebelwerfer.title: NEBELWERFER 42

card_unit_nebelwerfer.flavorText: and the rockets were electrically fired to a maximum range of 7.85 km.

card_unit_pak_36.flavorText: and due to its light weight and maneuverability it was often used by German paratroopers.

card_unit_pak_38_vs_2.name: card_unit_pak_38_vs_2
card_unit_pak_38_vs_2.title: PAK 38
card_unit_pak_38_vs_2.flavorText: but never used due to its low capabilities. The gun remained in service until the end of the war and was one of the few early guns capable of penetrating the 45 mm sloped armor of the T-34's hull at close range. It could also be equipped with Panzergranate 40 APCR ammunition with a hard tungsten core against the heavy KV-1 tank.

card_unit_panther.name: card_unit_panther

card_unit_panzergrenadier.flavorText: etc. The 59th Panzergrenadier Regiment was attached to the 20th Panzer Division of the Whermacht which fought on the Eastern Front and took part in the battles of Moscow and Kursk. They surrendered with their division to the US and Soviet forces in Czechoslovakia in May 1945.

card_unit_panzerzug_6.name: card_unit_panzerzug_6
card_unit_panzerzug_6.title: PANZERZUG 61 BP42

card_unit_panzerzug_6.flavorText: 2x Tender and the armored locomotive in the middle.

card_unit_panzer_35_t.name: card_unit_panzer_35_t
card_unit_panzer_35_t.title: PANZER 35(t)

card_unit_panzer_35_t.flavorText: a main armament of 3.7 cm (1.5 in) KwK 34(t) gun and a secondary armament of 2 x 7.92 mm MG 37(t) machine guns.

card_unit_panzer_38_t.name: card_unit_panzer_38_t
card_unit_panzer_38_t.title: PANZER 38(t)
card_unit_panzer_38_t.flavorText: but production was halted in 1942 since its armament was deemed inadequate.

card_unit_panzer_iii_e.name: card_unit_panzer_iii_e
card_unit_panzer_iii_e.title: PANZER III-L
card_unit_panzer_iii_e.text: Has +1 attack for each non-tank unit type you control.
card_unit_panzer_iii_e.flavorText: 20 mm stand-off armor plates on hull and turret front.

card_unit_panzer_iii_l.name: card_unit_panzer_iii_l
card_unit_panzer_iii_l.title: PANZER III-E
card_unit_panzer_iii_l.text: Other friendly tanks with Blitz have +2 attack.
card_unit_panzer_iii_l.flavorText: which made it heavier than its predecessors. The suspension was redesigned and used six road wheels per side instead of five and a 300 PS HL 120 engine. The Panzer III-E had a main armament of a 1x 3.7 cm KwK 36 gun and secondary armament of  2–3x 7.92 mm MG 34 machine guns. This variant was first introduced in 1939 with 96 units being manufactured.

card_unit_panzer_ii_a.name: card_unit_panzer_ii_a
card_unit_panzer_ii_a.title: PANZER II-A
card_unit_panzer_ii_a.flavorText: but was also used in North Africa and on the Eastern Front.

card_unit_panzer_iv_f2.flavorText: a main armament of 7.5 cm (2.95 in) KwK 40 L/48 and secondary armament of 2 × 7.92 mm MG 34 machine guns.

card_unit_panzer_iv_g.name: card_unit_panzer_iv_g
card_unit_panzer_iv_g.title: PANZER IV-G

card_unit_railway_gun_leopold.flavorText: it was destroyed by its crew.

card_unit_sd_kfz222x.flavorText: The Sd KFz 222 (Leichter Panzerspähwagen) was a light armored reconnaissance vehicle used by the Germans in WWII. It had a crew of three and was armed with a 2 cm KwK 30 L/55 autocannon and a 7.92 mm MG 13 machine gun.

card_unit_stug_iii.name: card_unit_stug_iii
card_unit_stug_iii.title: STUG III-F
card_unit_stug_iii.flavorText: but also as an assault gun. For main armament it had a 1× 7.5 cm StuK 40 L/48 gun and 1 × 7.92 mm MG34 machine gun as a secondary armament.

card_unit_stug_iv.name: card_unit_stug_iv
card_unit_stug_iv.title: STUG IV
card_unit_stug_iv.flavorText: a main armament of 1 x 7.5 cm StuK 40 L/48 and a secondary armament of 1 x 7.92 mm MG34 machine gun.

card_unit_tiger_i.name: card_unit_tiger_i
card_unit_tiger_i.title: TIGER I-H
card_unit_tiger_i.flavorText: assistant driver) and was the first tank that mounted a 8.8 cm KwK 36 gun. The Tiger I was an outstanding design of its time but the production and the maintenance was very expensive and only 1347 were built.

card_unit_wirbelwind.name: card_unit_wirbelwind
card_unit_wirbelwind.title: WIRBELWIND
card_unit_wirbelwind.text: enemy air units enter the battlefield pinned.

card_event_aunt_frieda.name: card_event_aunt_frieda
card_event_aunt_frieda.title: AUNT FRIEDA
card_event_aunt_frieda.text: Give a friendly infantry +1+1. Add TANK MANEUVER to your hand.
card_event_aunt_frieda.flavorText: it provided guidelines that could be consulted for any situation. It insisted on the importance of delegating operational command and that all subordinates had to understand the commander's intent so they could act on their own initiative. This way of thinking gave the German army an advantage over their enemies while they updated their own tactics and command structure. The manual was affectionately called “Tante Frieda”. A modified form is still used today by the German Army.

card_event_buzz_bomb.name: card_event_buzz_bomb
card_event_buzz_bomb.title: BUZZ BOMB
card_event_buzz_bomb.text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Draw a card if it is the HQ.
card_event_buzz_bomb.flavorText: causing thousands of casualties and leaving a lasting mark on the cities they targeted. The V-1’s development marked a significant step in the evolution of modern missile technology.

card_event_case_blue.name: card_event_case_blue
card_event_case_blue.title: CASE BLUE
card_event_case_blue.text: Deal 4 damage to target enemy for each unit with 4 or more attack you control.
card_event_case_blue.flavorText: marking a turning point in the war. The failure of Case Blue not only weakened Germany's military strength but also signaled the beginning of the Soviet counteroffensive that would eventually lead to Germany's defeat.

card_event_crossfire.name: card_event_crossfire
card_event_crossfire.title: CROSSFIRE
card_event_crossfire.text: Deal 1 damage to each enemy unit. Repeat this effect if any unit is destroyed.
card_event_crossfire.flavorText: creating kill zones that inflicted significant losses on Allied troops.

card_event_glide_bombing.name: card_event_glide_bombing
card_event_glide_bombing.title: GLIDE BOMBING
card_event_glide_bombing.text: Target unit has 0 attack until your next turn. Draw a card if it is destroyed this turn.
card_event_glide_bombing.flavorText: Glide bombing was an alternative tactic to dive bombing and it involved the use of heavier aircraft which had difficulties recovering from near vertical approaches. This required the use of more sophisticated bombsights and aiming techniques and relied on specialized bomb aimers amongst the aircrew. During WWII the German Luftwaffe used glide bombing tactics with multi-engine aircraft such as the Junkers Ju 88 and the Heinkel He 177.

card_event_run_the_battlefield.name: card_event_run_the_battlefield
card_event_run_the_battlefield.title: RUN THE BATTLEFIELD
card_event_run_the_battlefield.text: give it +2+2 or draw a card.
card_event_run_the_battlefield.flavorText: it placed them in greater personal danger and resulted in irreplaceable losses within the German command structure as the war wore on.

card_event_tank_frieda.name: card_event_tank_frieda
card_event_tank_frieda.title: TANK MANEUVER
card_event_tank_frieda.text: Give a friendly tank +2+1. Add AIR SUPPORT to your hand.

card_unit_110_panzergrenadier.name: card_unit_110_panzergrenadier
card_unit_110_panzergrenadier.title: 110. PANZERGRENADIER
card_unit_110_panzergrenadier.text: Your ground units with 4 or more attack deal +3 damage.
card_unit_110_panzergrenadier.flavorText: the division was almost entirely destroyed during its breakout from the pocket. The remains of the division were then sent to France where they fought with Army Group G against the Allied invasion of southern France. The survivors finally surrendered to the US forces in Czechoslovakia in 1945.

card_unit_304_panzergrenadier.name: card_unit_304_panzergrenadier
card_unit_304_panzergrenadier.title: 304. PANZERGRENADIER
card_unit_304_panzergrenadier.text: Deployment: Gets +2+2 if the enemy HQ has taken damage this turn.
card_unit_304_panzergrenadier.flavorText: was noted for its aggressive tactics and experienced heavy losses throughout the war.

card_unit_62_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_62_infantry_regiment
card_unit_62_infantry_regiment.title: 62. INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_62_infantry_regiment.text: Deployment: Reduce the operation cost on a friendly unit by 1.

card_unit_feldhernhalle_rifles.name: card_unit_feldhernhalle_rifles
card_unit_feldhernhalle_rifles.title: FELDHERRNHALLE RIFLES
card_unit_feldhernhalle_rifles.text: gain 2 kredits when you deploy another unit with 4 or more attack.
card_unit_feldhernhalle_rifles.flavorText: but once again it was recreated as Panzer-Division Feldherrnhalle 1. The remnants of the division surrendered to the Soviets in May 1945 in Czechoslovakia.

card_unit_maus.name: card_unit_maus
card_unit_maus.title: MAUS
card_unit_maus.text: Deployment: Destroy all units with cost 3 or less. Deal 2 damage to an enemy for each.
card_unit_maus.flavorText: which meant it had to ford or submerge in rivers to a depth up to 8 m using a snorkel. In the end only two prototypes were built before all work was stopped in August 1944. After the war the Soviets captured the first hull and mated it with the turret of the second Maus. The sole remaining Maus is now on display at the Kubinka tank Museum.

card_unit_panzer_iii_j_late.name: card_unit_panzer_iii_j_late
card_unit_panzer_iii_j_late.title: PANZER III-J LATE
card_unit_panzer_iii_j_late.text: Becomes Veteran when the enemy HQ has taken 4 or more damage.
card_unit_panzer_iii_j_late.flavorText: continued to be manufactured until the end of the war.

card_unit_panzer_iv_h.name: card_unit_panzer_iv_h
card_unit_panzer_iv_h.title: PANZER IV-H
card_unit_panzer_iv_h.text: Deployment: Fight target enemy unit. Becomes Veteran if the enemy unit is destroyed.
card_unit_panzer_iv_h.flavorText: The Panzer IV (Panzerkampfwagen IV) was the main workhorse of the German armored forces during World War II. It fought on every front and was the only German tank in production from the beginning to the end of the war. It saw continuous development and went through a series of upgrades. The Panzer IV-H was the pinnacle of the series as later versions had to be simplified to speed production and due to lack of raw materials.

card_unit_panzer_i_dak.name: card_unit_panzer_i_dak
card_unit_panzer_i_dak.title: PANZER I DAK
card_unit_panzer_i_dak.text: Gets Shock when it moves into the frontline.
card_unit_panzer_i_dak.flavorText: which were far better suited to the rigors of desert warfare and the stronger Allied armor they faced.

card_event_advanced_reich_research.name: card_event_advanced_reich_research
card_event_advanced_reich_research.title: ADVANCED REICH R&D

card_event_entrapment.name: card_event_entrapment
card_event_entrapment.title: ENTRAPMENT
card_event_entrapment.flavorText: with nearly 3.5 million prisoners of war being taken along with masses of equipment.

card_event_expanded_reich_research.name: card_event_expanded_reich_research

card_unit_119_grenadier.flavorText: the brigade regained divisional status and became the 25th Panzergrenadier Division again. It fought a delaying action against the US Third Army in France and defended the Maginot Line fortifications. The division also took part in Operation Nordwind which was the last major German offensive on the Western Front. After the failed German offensive the division was sent to defend against the Soviet attack on the Oder north of Berlin. Afterwards many survivors of the division managed to escape to the west and surrender to British or American forces.

card_unit_104_panzergrenadier.title: 104. PANZERGRENADIER
card_unit_104_panzergrenadier.text: Deployment: Reduce the operation cost by 1 if you control a tank.
card_unit_104_panzergrenadier.flavorText: which ended in retreat and evacuation from the island. The division would later participate in the Italian Campaign and defend against the Allied forces in the Battle of Monte Cassino and the Battle of Anzio. The 15th Division spent the rest of the war on the Western Front where they fought in the Battle of the Bulge before surrendering to the British when the war ended.

card_unit_1097_volksgrenadier.name: card_unit_1097_volksgrenadier
card_unit_1097_volksgrenadier.title: 1097. VOLKSGRENADIER
card_unit_1097_volksgrenadier.text: Deployment: Gets +2 defense and Guard if the enemy controls a Blitz unit.
card_unit_1097_volksgrenadier.flavorText: The 1097th Volksgrenadier Regiment was a unit of the 549th Volksgrenadier Division of the Wehrmacht during WWII. The division was formed in 1944 and fought on the Eastern Front and was nearly destroyed by the Red Army during the East Prussian Offensive in 1945. The survivors retreated to the west and surrendered to American troops when the war ended.

card_unit_136_gebirgsjager.name: card_unit_136_gebirgsjager
card_unit_136_gebirgsjager.title: 136. GEBIRGSJÄGER
card_unit_136_gebirgsjager.flavorText: The 136th Mountain Infantry Regiment was a regiment of the 2nd Mountain Division of the Wehrmacht which was formed in 1938 and trained in operating in mountainous terrain and cold weather. The division was formed with personnel from the 6th Division of the Austrian Alpenkorps and most men serving in it came from the Salzburg and Tyrol regions of Austria. During WWII the division served in Norway and the northern sectors near the Arctic on the Eastern Front before being moved to the Western Front by the end of the war. The division fought with Army Group South during the Invasion of Poland in 1939 and in the Norwegian Campaign in 1940. During Operation Barbarossa the 2nd Mountain Division fought with Mountain Corps Norway alongside the Finnish Army against the Red Army in the Arctic region where it continued to serve until the hostilities between Finland and USSR ended in 1944. The division ended the war on the Western Front where it surrendered to the Western Allies.

card_unit_28_jager_regiment.name: card_unit_28_jager_regiment
card_unit_28_jager_regiment.title: 28. JÄGER REGIMENT
card_unit_28_jager_regiment.text: Gains Ambush when it moves into the frontline.
card_unit_28_jager_regiment.flavorText: the Battle of France and Operation Barbarossa. In 1942 the division was redesignated as the 8th Jäger Division and their main purpose was to fight in rough terrain or urban areas on the Eastern Front. The division surrendered to the Red Army in Moravia in 1945.

card_unit_gebirger_pionier_95.name: card_unit_gebirger_pionier_95
card_unit_gebirger_pionier_95.title: GEBIRGS-PIONIER 95
card_unit_gebirger_pionier_95.flavorText: The Gebirgs-Pionier 95 was a battalion sized unit of the 5th Gebirgs-Division that was formed in 1940 and specialized in mountain warfare. The division took part in the invasion of Greece and the island of Crete where it fought its most significant battle in May 1941. In 1942 the division was deployed to the Eastern Front where it joined Army Group North in its offensive towards Leningrad. In 1943 it was redeployed in Italy where it fought for the remainder of the war. The 5th Gebirgs-Division surrendered to the US forces in May 1945.

card_unit_me_bf_109_v2.name: card_unit_me_bf_109_v2
card_unit_me_bf_109_v2.title: BF 109E-7 TROP
card_unit_me_bf_109_v2.text: Deployment: +1+1 if you control a tank or infantry. +3+3 if you control both.
card_unit_me_bf_109_v2.flavorText: The Messerschmitt Bf 109 was one of the main German fighter aircraft during WWII. A total of 33,984 aircraft were produced from 1937 to 1945 and the BF 109E-7 Trop was one of many variants made. Apart from the tropical color scheme a number of modifications were made to the standard Bf 109 in order to make it suitable for tropical climates and the desert sand. The E-7 was very similar to the previously made E-4 Trop variant except that it had an option 300 L drop tank.

card_location_ardennes_waw.title: ARDENNES
card_location_ardennes_waw.text: The Germans used the hilly Ardennes to launch several offensives during the war.
card_location_ardennes_waw.flavorText: the Battle of France (1940) and the Battle of the Bulge (1944–1945).

card_location_berlin.title: DANZIG
card_location_berlin.text: The Free City of Danzig was captured by German forces at the start of the war.
card_location_berlin.flavorText: marking the start of World War II in Europe. Germany held the city until at the end of the war when it was liberated by Polish and Soviet forces.

card_location_el_alamein.name: card_location_el_alamein
card_location_el_alamein.title: EL ALAMEIN
card_location_el_alamein.text: El Alamein was the furthest the Afrikakorps got in Egypt.
card_location_el_alamein.flavorText: but the Allies managed to halt the Axis advance on Alexandria. The Second Battle of El Alamein (23 October – 11 November 1942) ended in a decisive Allied victory and broke the grip the Axis had on North Africa.

card_location_villers_bocage.name: card_location_villers_bocage
card_location_villers_bocage.title: VILLERS-BOCAGE
card_location_villers_bocage.text: The Battle of Villers-Bocage was a 1944 tank battle between German and British forces.
card_location_villers_bocage.flavorText: with German commander Michael Wittmann leading a counterattack using Tiger tanks against British armored units. Wittmann achieved early success by ambushing British forces and destroying several tanks. The battle resulted in heavy casualties on both sides and in the retreat of the British forces. This allowed the Germans to take control of the town for a brief period.

card_location_ai_german_unlock1.flavorText: in which Germany and its Allies fought the Soviet Union for control of the city of Stalingrad (now Volgograd) in Southern Russia.

The Italian forces successfully invaded and occupied this strategic territory in the Horn of Africa,outmaneuvering and overwhelming the British defenders. This victory was the greatest success of the Italians in the East African campaign and demonstrated the Italian army's capability to conduct successful military operations without direct assistance from their German allies.

card_event_italian_human_torpedo.text: Destroy target enemy unit in the support line.
card_event_italian_human_torpedo.flavorText: A human torpedo is a type of diver propulsion vehicle on which the diver rides. They were used as secret naval weapons in WWII and the name is commonly used to refer to the weapon that Italy and later Britain deployed in the Mediterreanean and used to attack and sink enemy ships in the harbor.

card_event_lion_for_a_day.name: card_event_lion_for_a_day
card_event_lion_for_a_day.title: LION FOR A DAY
card_event_lion_for_a_day.text: Destroy target unit with 4 or more attack.
card_event_lion_for_a_day.flavorText: but many believe it was borrowed by him.

card_event_med_raid.name: card_event_med_raid
card_event_med_raid.title: MEDITERRANEAN RAID
card_event_med_raid.flavorText: along with 113,317 tons of merchant shipping.

card_event_naval_engagement.name: card_event_naval_engagement
card_event_naval_engagement.title: NAVAL ENGAGEMENT
card_event_naval_engagement.text: Fully repair all units in your support line. Destroy all units in the enemy support line.
card_event_naval_engagement.flavorText: the Italian fleet was either disarmed or incorporated into Allied naval operations for the remainder of the war.

card_event_pact_of_steel.name: card_event_pact_of_steel
card_event_pact_of_steel.title: PACT OF STEEL
card_event_pact_of_steel.text: Both players draw a card. Discard the lower cost card. Repeat 3 more times.

card_event_regia_aeronautica.name: card_event_regia_aeronautica
card_event_regia_aeronautica.title: REGIA AERONAUTICA
card_event_regia_aeronautica.text: Deal damage to each enemy equal to friendly air units.
card_event_regia_aeronautica.flavorText: with some units joining the Allies (forming Kingdom of Italy’s Co-belligerent Air Force) and others aligning with the German Luftwaffe (forming Italian Social Republic’s National Republican Air Force).

card_event_regia_marina.name: card_event_regia_marina
card_event_regia_marina.title: REGIA MARINA
card_event_regia_marina.text: Draw the highest cost card in your deck. Repeat if it did not start there.

card_event_rm_bersaglieri.name: card_event_rm_bersaglieri
card_event_rm_bersaglieri.title: RM BERSAGLIERE
card_event_rm_bersaglieri.text: Draw a card from your deck that did not start there. Give your HQ defense equal to its cost.
card_event_rm_bersaglieri.flavorText: killing 59 crewmen. Her sinking reflected the growing dominance of Allied air power in the Mediterranean by 1943.

card_event_rm_roma.name: card_event_rm_roma
card_event_rm_roma.title: RM ROMA
card_event_rm_roma.text: Deal 4 damage to an enemy. The top card of your deck has the Navy type until the end of your next turn.
card_event_rm_roma.flavorText: signaling a shift in naval warfare. Her wreck was located in 2012 off Sardinia's coast at a depth of approximately 1,000 meters.

card_event_spirit_of_rome.name: card_event_spirit_of_rome
card_event_spirit_of_rome.title: SPIRIT OF ROME
card_event_spirit_of_rome.text: Target friendly infantry unit gets +1+1 for every defense your HQ has over the enemy HQ.
card_event_spirit_of_rome.flavorText: symbols and propaganda. Fascists claimed that modern Italy was the heir to ancient Rome and that their history supported the creation and expansion of an Italian Empire.

card_event_spring_offensive.name: card_event_spring_offensive
card_event_spring_offensive.title: SPRING OFFENSIVE
card_event_spring_offensive.text: Draw 2 cards. Gain 2 kredits for each unit with 4 or more attack drawn.
card_event_spring_offensive.flavorText: and Greece held its ground until Germany intervened in April 1941.

card_event_vanguard_ita.name: card_event_vanguard_ita
card_event_vanguard_ita.title: VANGUARD
card_event_vanguard_ita.text: A friendly Alpine unit gets Blitz and "Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ."
card_event_vanguard_ita.flavorText: as it helps ensure the safety and success of the larger force by providing critical intelligence and early engagement capabilities.

card_event_campaign_alamein1_through_the.name: card_event_campaign_alamein1_through_the_wire
card_event_campaign_alamein1_through_the.title: THROUGH THE WIRE
card_event_campaign_alamein1_through_the.text: Target enemy unit loses Guard. Friendly Italian units get +1+1.

card_event_campaign_alamein3_spring_the_.name: card_event_campaign_alamein3_spring_the_reserves
card_event_campaign_alamein3_spring_the_.title: SPRING THE RESERVES
card_event_campaign_alamein3_spring_the_.text: Italian units in your hand cost 0 to deploy this turn.

card_unit_18th_bersaglieri.name: card_unit_18th_bersaglieri
card_unit_18th_bersaglieri.title: 18th BERSAGLIERI
card_unit_18th_bersaglieri.text: Deployment: Shuffle 9th BERSAGLIERI into your deck.

card_unit_125th_la_spezia.name: card_unit_125th_la_spezia
card_unit_125th_la_spezia.title: 125th LA SPEZIA
card_unit_125th_la_spezia.text: Deployment: Draw a card if you control an air unit.
card_unit_125th_la_spezia.flavorText: approximately 80,000 Italian troops surrendered to the British. The 80th Infantry Division "La Spezia" was officially lost on 13 May 1943.

card_unit_185th_folgore_cov.name: card_unit_185th_folgore_cov
card_unit_185th_folgore_cov.title: 185th FOLGORE
card_unit_185th_folgore_cov.text: Costs 1 more to deploy if you started the battle.
card_unit_185th_folgore_cov.flavorText: fighting alongside them against the Germans.

card_unit_1st_san_marco.name: card_unit_1st_san_marco
card_unit_1st_san_marco.title: 1st SAN MARCO
card_unit_1st_san_marco.text: Deployment: Gets +2+2 and Blitz if there is a Navy card on top of your deck.
card_unit_1st_san_marco.flavorText: the San Marco Regiment proved itself as one of Italy’s most formidable units in WWII.

card_unit_33rd_livorno.name: card_unit_33rd_livorno
card_unit_33rd_livorno.title: 33rd LIVORNO REGIMENT
card_unit_33rd_livorno.flavorText: the remainder of the division surrendered to the German forces who had by then occupied Italy.

card_unit_39th_bologna.name: card_unit_39th_bologna
card_unit_39th_bologna.title: 39th BOLOGNA REGIMENT
card_unit_39th_bologna.text: this unit costs 1 more each time you lose a unit.
card_unit_39th_bologna.flavorText: but the remainder of the Bologna Division was officially dissolved in November 1942.

card_unit_3rd_alpini.name: card_unit_3rd_alpini
card_unit_3rd_alpini.title: 3rd ALPINI REGIMENT
card_unit_3rd_alpini.flavorText: which fought with the Allies. After suffering heavy casualties the brigade was merged into a single infantry regiment of the Polish II Corps and fought its last engagements with the British 8th Army near the river Idice in Italy.

card_unit_49th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_49th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_49th_infantry_regiment.title: 49th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_49th_infantry_regiment.text: Deployment: Your HQ gets +4 defense if you control another unit with 4 or more attack.
card_unit_49th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: the division was disbanded by German forces occupying the region. Some members of the division joined partisan groups or the Italian Co-belligerent Army to continue the fight.

card_unit_4th_alpini_regiment.name: card_unit_4th_alpini_regiment
card_unit_4th_alpini_regiment.title: 4th ALPINI REGIMENT
card_unit_4th_alpini_regiment.text: Deployment: Add a 4th ALPINI REGIMENT to your deck for every 10 cards in it.
card_unit_4th_alpini_regiment.flavorText: its surviving elements were forced to surrender.

card_unit_5th_bersaglieri.name: card_unit_5th_bersaglieri
card_unit_5th_bersaglieri.title: 5th BERSAGLIERI
card_unit_5th_bersaglieri.text: Destruction: Shuffle 18th BERSAGLIERI into your deck.
card_unit_5th_bersaglieri.flavorText: including the Military Order of Italy and medals for valor. It was one of the last Bersaglieri regiments to fight in North Africa before the Italian surrender in that theater.

card_unit_6th_alpini_regiment.name: card_unit_6th_alpini_regiment
card_unit_6th_alpini_regiment.title: 6th ALPINI REGIMENT
card_unit_6th_alpini_regiment.flavorText: remnants of the Tridentine Division managed to break the encirclement and 4250 survivors managed to reach German lines in January 1943. The 6th Alpini Regiment was dissolved in 1943 after the signing of the Italian armistice with the Allies.

card_unit_76th_napoli.name: card_unit_76th_napoli
card_unit_76th_napoli.title: 76th NAPOLI
card_unit_76th_napoli.text: Deployment: Gets +1 attack for each defense your HQ has over the enemy HQ.
card_unit_76th_napoli.flavorText: but the new Allied landing north of Augusta outflanked the division and inflicted heavy casualties in the following days. The remnants of the Napoli division were absorbed into the incoming Panzer Division "Hermann Göring" and fought some small rearguard battles between 16-24 July. The division was disbanded on 14 August 1943 after it was unable to reform and its remaining personnel were ordered to evacuate to Southern Italy. For its conduct between 10 July and 1 August 1943 the 76th Infantry Regiment was awarded a Silver Medal of Military Valour.

card_unit_7th_alpini.name: card_unit_7th_alpini
card_unit_7th_alpini.title: 7th ALPINI REGIMENT
card_unit_7th_alpini.text: Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ.
card_unit_7th_alpini.flavorText: while one battalion (Val Cismon) was sent to Albania where Italian forces were suffering heavy casualties. In 1942 battalion Val Cismon was sent with the 3rd Alpine Division to the Eastern Front where it was annihilated during the Soviet Operation Little Saturn (1942-43). Meanwhile the Uork Amba battalion was fighting in the East African Campaign where it distinguished itself during the Battle of Keren. After the armistice between Italy and the Allies in 1943 remnants of the 7th Alpini Regiment surrendered to the German forces in France after a brief resistance.

card_unit_80th_pasubio.name: card_unit_80th_pasubio
card_unit_80th_pasubio.title: 80th PASUBIO
card_unit_80th_pasubio.text: Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ.
card_unit_80th_pasubio.flavorText: the 80th regiment was disbanded and its personnel were demobilized.

card_unit_93rd_messina.name: card_unit_93rd_messina
card_unit_93rd_messina.title: 93rd MESSINA
card_unit_93rd_messina.text: Units that did not start in your deck cost 2 less to deploy.
card_unit_93rd_messina.flavorText: while the rest of the division was disbanded by German forces.

card_unit_9th_bersaglieri.name: card_unit_9th_bersaglieri
card_unit_9th_bersaglieri.title: 9th BERSAGLIERI
card_unit_9th_bersaglieri.text: Destruction: Shuffle 18th BERSAGLIERI into your deck.
card_unit_9th_bersaglieri.flavorText: even in the face of defeat. The regiment was officially disbanded on 5 November 1942 following its destruction.

card_unit_breda_ba_65.name: card_unit_breda_ba_65
card_unit_breda_ba_65.title: BREDA Ba.65
card_unit_breda_ba_65.text: Deployment: Deal 1 damage to each enemy.

card_unit_cannone_da_47.name: card_unit_cannone_da_47
card_unit_cannone_da_47.title: CANNONE DA 47
card_unit_cannone_da_47.text: Takes 1 damage at the end of your turn unless you control more units than the enemy.
card_unit_cannone_da_47.flavorText: and it didn’t have any gun shield. The Italian soldiers called the gun “elefantino” (e. Little elephant) due to its shape.

card_unit_caproni_ca_133.name: card_unit_caproni_ca_133
card_unit_caproni_ca_133.title: CAPRONI CA.133
card_unit_caproni_ca_133.text: Your HQ gets +2 defense when you deploy or add a unit.
card_unit_caproni_ca_133.flavorText: with over 500 units built and active service continuing throughout Africa and the Mediterranean during WWII.

card_unit_fiat_br_20.name: card_unit_fiat_br_20
card_unit_fiat_br_20.title: FIAT BR.20
card_unit_fiat_br_20.text: Deployment: Add two 3rd ALPINI REGIMENT to your support line.
card_unit_fiat_br_20.flavorText: including a few variants. None of the aircraft remain today.

card_unit_fiat_cr_32.name: card_unit_fiat_cr_32
card_unit_fiat_cr_32.title: FIAT C.R.32
card_unit_fiat_cr_32.text: fully repair a random friendly unit.
card_unit_fiat_cr_32.flavorText: it is worth noting that a few C.R.32s remained in use until the end of the war in 1945.

card_unit_fiat_cr_42.name: card_unit_fiat_cr_42
card_unit_fiat_cr_42.title: FIAT C.R.42
card_unit_fiat_cr_42.text: Deployment: Gets +1 attack if you control more units than the enemy.
card_unit_fiat_cr_42.flavorText: the CR.42s were relocated to North Africa where they were still used in reconnaissance and ground attack roles. In total 1819 aircraft were manufactured and they were last used in 1948 by the Spanish Air Force.

card_unit_fiat_g50.name: card_unit_fiat_g50
card_unit_fiat_g50.title: FIAT G.50
card_unit_fiat_g50.text: Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ.
card_unit_fiat_g50.flavorText: but by the time the Italians surrendered in 1943 very few of them were still in service.

card_unit_fiat_g55.name: card_unit_fiat_g55
card_unit_fiat_g55.title: FIAT G.55
card_unit_fiat_g55.text: Deployment: +2+2 if your HQ has 5 or more defense than the enemy HQ.
card_unit_fiat_g55.flavorText: only 300 aircraft had been built by the end of WWII.

card_unit_italian_cavalry.name: card_unit_italian_cavalry
card_unit_italian_cavalry.title: SAVOIA CAVALLERIA
card_unit_italian_cavalry.flavorText: and the outcome didn’t have much bearing on the Eastern Front. This event is however remembered as the last cavalry charges in history and it had great propaganda resonance in Italy at the time.

card_unit_l6_40.name: card_unit_l6_40
card_unit_l6_40.title: L6/40
card_unit_l6_40.flavorText: and finally a Semovente 47/32 which was a self-propelled gun.

card_unit_la_decima.name: card_unit_la_decima
card_unit_la_decima.title: LA DECIMA
card_unit_la_decima.text: Deployment: Destroy target unit in the enemy support line.
card_unit_la_decima.flavorText: Explosive Motorboats and frogmen to carry out their raids. La Decima was active from 1941 to 1943 and participated in numerous daring raids on Allied shipping during that time. In 3 years members of the flotilla single handedly managed to sink or disable 5 Allied warships and 20 merchant ships. The La Decima units also earned a good reputation fighting on the frontline against the Allies at Anzio and on the Gothic Line.

card_unit_m13_40.name: card_unit_m13_40
card_unit_m13_40.title: M13/40
card_unit_m13_40.text: Deployment: Gains Blitz if you control an infantry.
card_unit_m13_40.flavorText: a main armament of a 47 mm cannone da 47/32 AT gun and a secondary armament of 4 x 8 mm Breda mod. 38 machine guns.

card_unit_macchi_c202.name: card_unit_macchi_c202
card_unit_macchi_c202.title: MACCHI C.202
card_unit_macchi_c202.text: Takes 2 damage at the end of your turn if your HQ has less defense than the enemy HQ.
card_unit_macchi_c202.flavorText: The Macchi C.202 Folgore (e. thunderbolt) was an Italian fighter aircraft developed and manufactured by Macchi Aeronautica and used during WWII by the Regia Aeronautica (Royal Italian Air Force). According to some the Folgore was one of the best wartime fighters to serve in large numbers with the Italian Air Force and it was superior to many of the older British fighters in the North African conflict. With its Daimler-Benz engine it could reach a top speed of 600 km/h and it was adequately armed four machine guns and two 160kg bombs. In total 1,150 aircraft were built and it was in use until 1951.

card_unit_macchi_c_200.name: card_unit_macchi_c_200
card_unit_macchi_c_200.title: MACCHI C.200
card_unit_macchi_c_200.text: Deployment: Gets +1+1 for each other friendly air unit.
card_unit_macchi_c_200.flavorText: the Saetta was respected for its maneuverability and played a key role in Italy’s early wartime campaigns. It was considered the best early-war Italian fighter.

card_unit_obice_da_75_13.name: card_unit_obice_da_75_13
card_unit_obice_da_75_13.title: OBICE DA 75/13
card_unit_obice_da_75_13.text: Your Alpine units can move and attack during the same turn.
card_unit_obice_da_75_13.flavorText: but designated as the Obice da 75/13 in Italy. The Italians captured large numbers of these guns in WWI and they were distributed among the Italian Alpini divisions who found them very useful in mountain terrain. It was therefore decided to reproduce the Obice da 75/13 in 1933 and many of them were still in service when WWII started and they were still in use when the war ended.

card_unit_sm_79.name: card_unit_sm_79
card_unit_sm_79.title: SAVOIA-MARCHETTI SM.79
card_unit_sm_79.text: Deployment: Trigger a non-targeted deployment effect on a friendly unit.
card_unit_sm_79.flavorText: and due to its distinctive looks it was nicknamed  “il gobbo maledetto” (e. damned hunchback).

card_unit_trento_division.name: card_unit_trento_division
card_unit_trento_division.title: TRENTO DIVISION
card_unit_trento_division.text: Deployment: Destroy an enemy unit if you control another unit with 4 or more attack.
card_unit_trento_division.flavorText: the Trento Division was declared lost.

card_unit_wolves_of_tuscany.name: card_unit_wolves_of_tuscany
card_unit_wolves_of_tuscany.title: WOLVES OF TUSCANY
card_unit_wolves_of_tuscany.flavorText: the division resisted German forces in Rome for a short while before being disbanded.

card_event_desperate_measures.name: card_event_desperate_measures
card_event_desperate_measures.title: DESPERATE MEASURES
card_event_desperate_measures.text: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. You lose a kredit slot.
card_event_desperate_measures.flavorText: the first kamikaze attack took place. What followed was a wave of suicide attacks on Allied targets and the bloodiest battles of WWII.

card_event_elusive_force.name: card_event_elusive_force
card_event_elusive_force.title: ELUSIVE FORCE
card_event_elusive_force.text: The enemy cannot give orders next turn.
card_event_elusive_force.flavorText: but primarily they acted as scouts and attrition units.

card_event_for_glory.name: card_event_for_glory
card_event_for_glory.title: FOR GLORY
card_event_for_glory.flavorText: and the top ranking Japanese ace of WWII was Warrant Officer Hiroyoshi Nishizawa (nicknamed Demon of Rabaul) with 87 claimed victories.

card_event_gunboat_hit.name: card_event_gunboat_hit
card_event_gunboat_hit.title: GUNBOAT HIT
card_event_gunboat_hit.text: Deal 2 damage to a unit in the enemy support line. Add a GUNBOAT RUN to your hand. Discarded end of turn.
card_event_gunboat_hit.flavorText: some of them were captured from enemy fleets.

card_event_gunboat_raid.name: card_event_gunboat_raid
card_event_gunboat_raid.title: GUNBOAT RAID
card_event_gunboat_raid.text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy unit in the frontline. Add a GUNBOAT HIT to your hand.
card_event_gunboat_raid.flavorText: some of them were captured from enemy fleets.

card_event_gunboat_run.name: card_event_gunboat_run
card_event_gunboat_run.title: GUNBOAT RUN
card_event_gunboat_run.text: Deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ. Discarded end of turn.

card_event_honorable_death.name: card_event_honorable_death
card_event_honorable_death.title: HONORABLE DEATH
card_event_honorable_death.text: Destroy target unit with attack 3 or less. Owner of the unit draws a card.
card_event_honorable_death.flavorText: and many of them would commit suicide rather than be captured alive by the Americans. It is unclear if the soldiers really believed in the samurai code “Bushido” or if they were afraid of being killed by the Americans or by their own side for surrendering.

card_event_imperial_decree.name: card_event_imperial_decree
card_event_imperial_decree.title: IMPERIAL DECREE
card_event_imperial_decree.text: The next damage order you give this turn deals +1 damage.
card_event_imperial_decree.flavorText: there was an official code for military personnel known as the "Imperial Rescript to Soldiers and Sailors," which symbolized the obedience and loyalty expected of service members. All military personnel were required to memorize the document and were sometimes called upon to recite it during ceremonies.

card_event_isolation.name: card_event_isolation
card_event_isolation.title: ISOLATION
card_event_isolation.text: Remove target unit from the battlefield. Return it at the start of your next turn.
card_event_isolation.flavorText: utilized both on a grand scale and in smaller skirmishes.

card_event_sneak_maneuver.name: card_event_sneak_maneuver
card_event_sneak_maneuver.title: SNEAK MANEUVER
card_event_sneak_maneuver.text: Give target infantry or tank with 0 operation cost +2 attack.
card_event_sneak_maneuver.flavorText: in the evening or in the early morning. The Soviet forces never executed a large scale attack on Japan but the Japanese could nevertheless use these tactics to their advantage against the Allies in the Pacific War.

card_event_to_the_last_man.name: card_event_to_the_last_man
card_event_to_the_last_man.title: TO THE LAST MAN
card_event_to_the_last_man.flavorText: the commander of the 5th Navy Air Fleet.

card_unit_144th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_144th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_144th_infantry_regiment.title: 144th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_144th_infantry_regiment.text: Destruction: Deal damage to the enemy HQ equal to the kredit slots you have lost this battle.
card_unit_144th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: a brigade sized force used to seize the islands of Guam. After a failed attempt to seize Wake Island the 144th Regiment was sent back to rejoin the 55th Division for the New Guinea Campaign where it fought in several battles and campaigns. That last major engagement was a failed offensive against the British and Commonwealth forces in what became known as the Battle of the Admin Box and took place in Myanmar. After that the division was on retreat and was located in Cambodia when Japan surrendered in 1945.

card_unit_1st_yokosuka.name: card_unit_1st_yokosuka
card_unit_1st_yokosuka.title: 1st YOKOSUKA
card_unit_1st_yokosuka.text: Deployment: Receives +1 attack for each friendly unit with 0 operation cost.

card_unit_34th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_34th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_34th_infantry_regiment.title: 34th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_34th_infantry_regiment.text: draw and discard the top card of your deck.
card_unit_34th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: its parent division was considered an elite formation and took part in 16 major engagements and campaigns. The division was disbanded at the end of the war.

card_unit_a6m3_zeke.name: card_unit_a6m3_zeke
card_unit_a6m3_zeke.title: A6M3 ZEKE
card_unit_a6m3_zeke.text: Enemy countermeasures cost 2 more to activate.
card_unit_a6m3_zeke.flavorText: which meant that it was only suitable for shorter range missions and interception. The Allied reporting name for the aircraft was Zeke 32. Only 343 A6M3’s were built.

card_unit_d4y_suisei.name: card_unit_d4y_suisei
card_unit_d4y_suisei.title: D4Y SUISEI
card_unit_d4y_suisei.text: Deployment: Pin target enemy unit and its adjacent units.

card_unit_hayabusa.name: card_unit_hayabusa
card_unit_hayabusa.title: Ki-43 HAYABUSA
card_unit_hayabusa.text: Destruction: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_hayabusa.flavorText: but often called the "Army Zero" by American pilots due to its resemblance to the Mitsubishi A6M Zero.

card_unit_kagoshima_regiment.name: card_unit_kagoshima_regiment
card_unit_kagoshima_regiment.title: KAGOSHIMA REGIMENT
card_unit_kagoshima_regiment.flavorText: The 45th Infantry Regiment (Kagoshima) was part of the 6th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army. The regiment fought with its division in the Second Sino-Japanese War. During the later stages of WWII the regiment fought in Bougainville Island in the Solomon Islands as part of the Japanese Seventeenth Army.

card_unit_ki_51_sonia.name: card_unit_ki_51_sonia
card_unit_ki_51_sonia.title: Ki-51 SONIA
card_unit_ki_51_sonia.flavorText: and a reconnaissance version Ki-51A was also built. 2,385 aircraft were constructed and by the end of the war the Japanese began using them in kamikaze attacks.

card_unit_ki_61_tony.name: card_unit_ki_61_tony
card_unit_ki_61_tony.title: Ki-61-II TONY
card_unit_ki_61_tony.text: Spend 7 kredits at the end of enemy turn and add it to the battlefield.
card_unit_ki_61_tony.flavorText: first they mistook it for the German Messerschmitt Bf 109s and later the Italian Macchi C.202 which led to the Allied codename “Tony”. The Ki-61-II variant was introduced in 1943 and had a more powerful engine than its predecessor. Later variants would focus on increasing the speed and firepower. A total of 3,078 aircraft were built.

card_unit_osaka_regiment.name: card_unit_osaka_regiment
card_unit_osaka_regiment.title: OSAKA REGIMENT
card_unit_osaka_regiment.flavorText: but was lastly transferred to Thailand where it was disbanded in 1946.

card_unit_shibata_regiment.name: card_unit_shibata_regiment
card_unit_shibata_regiment.title: SHIBATA REGIMENT
card_unit_shibata_regiment.text: deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_shibata_regiment.flavorText: and was deployed to Burma in 1944 where it was almost annihilated in the conflict against the Allies. The survivors were assigned to the Japanese 38th Army in French Indochina where it was disbanded at the end of WWII.

card_unit_type94_tk.name: card_unit_type94_tk
card_unit_type94_tk.title: TYPE 94 TK
card_unit_type94_tk.text: Deployment: Add a SURPRISE ATTACK to your hand.
card_unit_type94_tk.flavorText: but even so the Type 94 TK was used in front line service by the Japanese until 1945.

card_unit_type_1_37mm.name: card_unit_type_1_37mm
card_unit_type_1_37mm.title: TYPE 1 37mm
card_unit_type_1_37mm.text: Deployment: Gets +1+1 and Blitz if your HQ has 10 or less defense.
card_unit_type_1_37mm.flavorText: but it had its shortcomings and was not capable of piercing the armor of new Soviet tanks. The solution was to modify the Type 93 AT Gun with a longer barrel which would provide it with greater firepower. The new gun was designated Type 1 37mm Anti-tank Gun and 2,300 guns were produced. The gun was used in frontline service in the Pacific Theater and was moderately effective against Allied light tanks but did little damage against medium tanks such as the M4 Sherman.

card_unit_type_1_chi_he.name: card_unit_type_1_chi_he
card_unit_type_1_chi_he.title: TYPE 1 Chi-He
card_unit_type_1_chi_he.flavorText: a main armament of a Type 1 47mm tank gun and a secondary armament of 2 x 7.7mm Type 97 light machine guns. A total of 170 tanks were produced between 1943-44 which were all allocated to the Japanese home islands to defend against an expected Allied attack.

card_event_air_superiority.name: card_event_air_superiority
card_event_air_superiority.title: AIR SUPERIORITY
card_event_air_superiority.flavorText: mainly due to their superior production capabilities.

card_event_amphibious_assault.name: card_event_amphibious_assault
card_event_amphibious_assault.title: AMPHIBIOUS ASSAULT
card_event_amphibious_assault.text: Destroy an enemy unit that has 3 or less attack.
card_event_amphibious_assault.flavorText: Amphibious warfare is a type of offensive where attacks are launched from the sea by naval and landing forces against hostile shores.

card_event_ancient_empire.name: card_event_ancient_empire
card_event_ancient_empire.title: ANCIENT EMPIRE
card_event_ancient_empire.text: Set your HQ's defense to 8. Draw an ANCIENT EMPIRE.
card_event_ancient_empire.flavorText: The Empire of Japan was considered a colonial empire and existed as such from 1868 until the enactment of the 1947 constitution of modern Japan.

card_event_blade_of_the_samurai.name: card_event_blade_of_the_samurai
card_event_blade_of_the_samurai.title: BLADE OF THE SAMURAI
card_event_blade_of_the_samurai.flavorText: and it was used in combat occasionally as well.

card_event_bombing_raid.name: card_event_bombing_raid
card_event_bombing_raid.title: BOMBING RAID
card_event_bombing_raid.text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy target and 2 damage to adjacent targets.
card_event_bombing_raid.flavorText: as well as conducting air raids on Philippines and Northern Australia.

card_event_burning_sun.name: card_event_burning_sun
card_event_burning_sun.title: BURNING SUN
card_event_burning_sun.text: Friendly air units have +3 attack until end of turn.
card_event_burning_sun.flavorText: which became a symbol of Japan’s war effort in Asia and the Pacific during WWII and earlier conflicts. The flag was often signed and given away as farewell presents to departing soldiers.
