They were called “prayer flags” and the text on them often wished the soldiers good luck and fortune in their fight for Imperial Japan.

card_event_burst_of_fire.name: card_event_burst_of_fire
card_event_burst_of_fire.title: BURST OF FIRE
card_event_burst_of_fire.text: Give a friendly fighter +1 attack and Fury this turn.
card_event_burst_of_fire.flavorText: Aircraft of the Japanese Imperial Army used both Type 89 7.7 mm machine guns (copy of Vickers Class E) and Ho-103 12.7 mm machine guns (based on Browning M1921). For rear armament (defensive use) they used Type 89 7.7 mm machine gun (based on Type 11), Type 98 7.92 mm machine gun (copy of MG 15) and Ho-104 12.7 mm machine gun (based on Browning M1921). Navy aircraft used Type 92 7.7 mm machine guns (British Lewis),  Type 97 7.7 mm machine gun (Vickers) and Type 3 13.2 mm machine gun (Browning with Hotchkiss 13.2mm cartridge). For rear armament (defensive use) they used Type 92 7.7 mm machine gun (British Lewis), Type 1 7.92 mm machine gun (German MG 15), Type 2 13 mm machine gun (German MG 131) and Type 99-1/Type 99-2 20 mm cannon (Oerlikon FF).

card_event_code_of_bushido.name: card_event_code_of_bushido
card_event_code_of_bushido.title: CODE OF BUSHIDO
card_event_code_of_bushido.text: Choose and discard an air unit to destroy a unit with 5 or less attack.
card_event_code_of_bushido.flavorText: which seemed to fuel Japan’s determination to fight to the very last man and woman and many link it to the atrocities committed by their soldiers during WWII.

card_event_deadly_duty.name: card_event_deadly_duty
card_event_deadly_duty.title: DEADLY DUTY
card_event_deadly_duty.text: Destroy a friendly unit. Draw 2 cards.
card_event_deadly_duty.flavorText: rather than to surrender or be captured alive.

card_event_divine_wind.name: card_event_divine_wind
card_event_divine_wind.title: DIVINE WIND
card_event_divine_wind.text: Destroy a unit. Discard a random card from your hand.
card_event_divine_wind.flavorText: which allegedly were the two storms that saved Japan from two Mongol fleets under Kublai Khan. This word was later used during WWII for suicide attacks by Japanese pilots in the Pacific war. The metaphor meant that the pilots were to be the "Divine Wind" that would again sweep the enemy from the seas.

card_event_empire_of_the_sun.name: card_event_empire_of_the_sun
card_event_empire_of_the_sun.title: EMPIRE OF THE SUN
card_event_empire_of_the_sun.text: Destroy an enemy unit. Draw cards equal to its attack.
card_event_empire_of_the_sun.flavorText: it was also given the exonym Empire of the Sun.

card_event_for_prosperety.name: card_event_for_prosperety
card_event_for_prosperety.title: FOR PROSPERITY
card_event_for_prosperety.flavorText: The Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere was a concept promoted by the Empire of Japan. It represented the desire to create a self-sufficient block of Asian nations led by the Japanese and free of Western powers.

card_event_for_the_emperor.name: card_event_for_the_emperor
card_event_for_the_emperor.title: FOR THE EMPEROR
card_event_for_the_emperor.text: All friendly Japanese units have +1 attack and operate for one less until end of turn.
card_event_for_the_emperor.flavorText: Emperor Hirohito was considered a living god and there was no greater honor than to serve under him and/or to die for him in battle.

card_event_home_defense.name: card_event_home_defense
card_event_home_defense.title: HOME DEFENSE
card_event_home_defense.text: Costs 4 if your HQ is at 10 or less. Add TYPE 3 CHI-NU and AICHI D3A-2 to the support line.
card_event_home_defense.flavorText: it never came to use since Japan surrendered after the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

card_event_honor.name: card_event_honor
card_event_honor.title: HONOR
card_event_honor.flavorText: "Victory or death" was a principle strongly promoted by the Imperial Japanese Army. This idea framed the refusal to surrender and the decision to fight to the last as part of an extreme form of wartime mobilization.

card_event_imperial_order.name: card_event_imperial_order
card_event_imperial_order.title: IMPERIAL ORDER
card_event_imperial_order.text: Fully repair a unit and give it +1+1.

card_event_imperial_strength.name: card_event_imperial_strength
card_event_imperial_strength.title: IMPERIAL STRENGTH
card_event_imperial_strength.text: Discard all activated countermeasures. Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_event_imperial_strength.flavorText: Before and during WWII Japan had occupied or taken control of regions that counted approximately 464 million inhabitants. Control over all territories except the Japanese mainland and surrounding islands was renounced by Japan in the unconditional surrender after World War II.

card_event_kamikaze.name: card_event_kamikaze
card_event_kamikaze.title: KAMIKAZE
card_event_kamikaze.text: Deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ. Draw a card.

card_event_last_rites.name: card_event_last_rites
card_event_last_rites.title: LAST RITES
card_event_last_rites.text: Shuffle 8 KAMIKAZE cards into your deck.
card_event_last_rites.flavorText: the pilot was to yell "hissatsu" which translates to "certain kill".

card_event_lightning_conquest_new.name: card_event_lightning_conquest_new
card_event_lightning_conquest_new.title: LIGHTNING CONQUEST
card_event_lightning_conquest_new.text: Friendly infantry units are immune to damage and can both move and attack this turn.
card_event_lightning_conquest_new.flavorText: as the war progressed and the US and Soviet allies joined the war against Japan their strategy changed to a defensive war.

card_event_naval_operation.name: card_event_naval_operation
card_event_naval_operation.title: NAVAL OPERATION
card_event_naval_operation.text: Pin all enemy ground units and deal 1 damage to them.
card_event_naval_operation.flavorText: the Americans soon got the upper hand in the war.

card_event_naval_supply_run.name: card_event_naval_supply_run
card_event_naval_supply_run.title: NAVAL SUPPLY RUN
card_event_naval_supply_run.text: Give your units +2+1. At start of your next turn discard a card at random.
card_event_naval_supply_run.flavorText: and delivering it under cover of darkness and being back to base before daylight in order to avoid being intercepted by the Allies. The Allied called this operation the Tokyo Express.

card_event_reconnaissance.name: card_event_reconnaissance
card_event_reconnaissance.title: LONG RANGE RECON
card_event_reconnaissance.text: Your HQ gains defense equal to the number of all cards on the battlefield.
card_event_reconnaissance.flavorText: a long range reconnaissance/bomber aircraft (depicted in the image).

card_event_rising_sun.name: card_event_rising_sun
card_event_rising_sun.title: EXPANSION
card_event_rising_sun.flavorText: which is considered to be a turning point in the Battle of the Pacific. After that the Allied forces slowly gained air and naval supremacy in the Pacific and the tables were turned.

card_event_surprise_attack.name: card_event_surprise_attack
card_event_surprise_attack.title: SURPRISE ATTACK
card_event_surprise_attack.flavorText: which eventually led to the surrender of Imperial Japan and the Axis powers.

card_event_tora_tora.name: card_event_tora_tora
card_event_tora_tora.title: TORA! TORA! TORA!
card_event_tora_tora.flavorText: which is a dramatic retelling of the Pearl Harbor attack.

card_event_yamamoto.name: card_event_yamamoto
card_event_yamamoto.title: ADMIRAL YAMAMOTO
card_event_yamamoto.text: Give friendly air units on the battlefield +1 attack and Blitz this turn.
card_event_yamamoto.flavorText: which enable the US air force to intercept and shoot down his plane.

card_unit_15th_cavalry_regiment.name: card_unit_15th_cavalry_regiment
card_unit_15th_cavalry_regiment.title: 15th CAVALRY REGIMENT
card_unit_15th_cavalry_regiment.flavorText: The 15th Cavalry Regiment was attached to the 2nd Cavalry Brigade. The Japanese Imperial Army retained a few cavalry units during WWII but most of them were used for reconnaissance.

card_unit_1st_signal_regiment.name: card_unit_1st_signal_regiment
card_unit_1st_signal_regiment.title: 1st SIGNAL REGIMENT
card_unit_1st_signal_regiment.text: deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_1st_signal_regiment.flavorText: a radio intercept unit and a field pigeon unit.

card_unit_28cm_coasttal_howitzer.name: card_unit_28cm_coasttal_howitzer
card_unit_28cm_coasttal_howitzer.title: 28cm COASTAL HOWITZER
card_unit_28cm_coasttal_howitzer.flavorText: and it was used with some success during the Soviet invasion of Manchuria in 1945.

card_unit_2nd_raiding_brigade.name: card_unit_2nd_raiding_brigade
card_unit_2nd_raiding_brigade.title: 2nd RAIDING BRIGADE
card_unit_2nd_raiding_brigade.text: Deployment: Destroy an enemy unit with attack 2 or less.
card_unit_2nd_raiding_brigade.flavorText: but most of the aircraft were shot down on the way. Around 300 of them managed to land in the Burauen area on Leyte and managed to destroy some planes and inflict numerous casualties before they were defeated by Allied forces.

card_unit_33rd_recon.name: card_unit_33rd_recon
card_unit_33rd_recon.title: 33rd RECON
card_unit_33rd_recon.flavorText: the Battle of Yenangyaung and the Battle of Imphal). Reconnaissance regiments were types of units tasked with combat scouting and attached to many Japanese divisions during WWII.

card_unit_41st_bicycle_regiment.name: card_unit_41st_bicycle_regiment
card_unit_41st_bicycle_regiment.title: 41st BICYCLE REGIMENT
card_unit_41st_bicycle_regiment.flavorText: The 41st Bicycle Regiment of the Imperial Japanese Army was subordinate of the 9th Infantry Bicycle Brigade of the 5th Division. The division participated in the Second Sino-Japanese war and later in the war in the Pacific where it saw action in numerous battles and campaigns. In WWII the Imperial Japanese Army used bicycles extensively in their campaigns in Southeast Asia as they thought it was an efficient form of transportation and cheap for the war effort. Their bicycle soldiers could carry 36 kilograms of equipment and it often allowed them to move faster across terrain than the Allied forces.

card_unit_6th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_6th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_6th_infantry_regiment.title: 6th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_6th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: the Siberian Intervention and the Shandong Incident and was considered a crack unit.

card_unit_75mm_field_artillery.name: card_unit_75mm_field_artillery
card_unit_75mm_field_artillery.title: 75mm FIELD ARTILLERY
card_unit_75mm_field_artillery.text: Enemies adjacent to target attacked by 75mm FIELD ARTILLERY are dealt 1 damage.
card_unit_75mm_field_artillery.flavorText: and often deployed with armored units.

card_unit_75mm_mountain_gun.name: card_unit_75mm_mountain_gun
card_unit_75mm_mountain_gun.title: 75mm MOUNTAIN GUN
card_unit_75mm_mountain_gun.flavorText: The type 41 75 mm mountain gun was used as an infantry gun and normally each regiment had four of them deployed. The 75 mm mountain gun was referred to as "rentai ho" (regimental artillery).

card_unit_a5m4_claude.name: card_unit_a5m4_claude
card_unit_a5m4_claude.title: A5M4 CLAUDE
card_unit_a5m4_claude.text: Deployment: Give another friendly unit -1 operation cost.
card_unit_a5m4_claude.flavorText: with excellent maneuverability and robust construction.  Later in WWII the A5M's also provided much-needed escorts for the vulnerable Mitsubishi G3M bombers.

card_unit_aichi_d3a.name: card_unit_aichi_d3a
card_unit_aichi_d3a.title: AICHI D3A-2
card_unit_aichi_d3a.text: Has +2 attack for each other AICHI D3A you control.

card_unit_akita_regiment.name: card_unit_akita_regiment
card_unit_akita_regiment.title: AKITA REGIMENT
card_unit_akita_regiment.text: Destruction: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
card_unit_akita_regiment.flavorText: the capital city of Akita Prefecture. These regiments served in several divisions in the Japanese Imperial Army.

card_unit_c6n_saiun.name: card_unit_c6n_saiun
card_unit_c6n_saiun.title: C6N SAIUN
card_unit_c6n_saiun.text: Cannot be attacked by ground units while in the support line. Countermeasures cannot trigger.
card_unit_c6n_saiun.flavorText: it didn't enter service until 1944 when only a few carriers were left to operate from which meant that most were flown from land bases. 463 aircraft were produced including a few variants.

card_unit_dinah.name: card_unit_dinah
card_unit_dinah.title: M6A1 SEIRAN
card_unit_dinah.flavorText: not long before Japan surrendered. Many of the M6A1's were destroyed to prevent capture and only one exists today at the Udvar-Hazy Center of the Smithsonian's National Air and Space Museum.

card_unit_g4m1_betty.name: card_unit_g4m1_betty
card_unit_g4m1_betty.title: G4M1 BETTY
card_unit_g4m1_betty.text: add to support line instead. Deployment: Discard a random card from your hand.

card_unit_j1n1_gekko.name: card_unit_j1n1_gekko
card_unit_j1n1_gekko.title: J1N1 GEKKO
card_unit_j1n1_gekko.flavorText: allowing attacks from above or below. This arrangement was effective against the Allied B-17 Flying Fortress Bombers and B-24 Liberators. By the end of the war a number of Gekko's were used for Kamikaze attacks where they had 250 kg bombs attached to the wings.

card_unit_jade_division.name: card_unit_jade_division
card_unit_jade_division.title: JADE DIVISION
card_unit_jade_division.flavorText: the Battle of Leyte and the Battle of Luzon.

card_unit_ki_27_nate.name: card_unit_ki_27_nate
card_unit_ki_27_nate.title: Ki-27 NATE
card_unit_ki_27_nate.text: Destruction: Add a random Japanese unit that costs 1 or less to your hand.
card_unit_ki_27_nate.flavorText: The Nakajima Ki-27 was the main fighter aircraft used by the Imperial Japanese Army Air Force up until 1940. Allegedly it was named "Abdul" in the "China Burma India" theater but it was generally known to the Allies by the nickname "Nate".

card_unit_ki_44_tojo.name: card_unit_ki_44_tojo
card_unit_ki_44_tojo.title: Ki-44 TOJO
card_unit_ki_44_tojo.text: Deployment: The enemy discards a random bomber from hand.
card_unit_ki_44_tojo.flavorText: which was often the case for the Japanese during the later stages of the war.

card_unit_ki_61_hien.name: card_unit_ki_61_hien
card_unit_ki_61_hien.title: Ki-61 HIEN
card_unit_ki_61_hien.flavorText: was a Japanese fighter aircraft used by the Imperial Japanese Army Air Force in WWII. It was first introduced in 1942 and was used in combat missions throughout the war. 3,078 aircraft of this type were built and they were used in combat service throughout the war. The Allies code name for the aircraft was "Tony".

card_unit_ki_84_frank.name: card_unit_ki_84_frank
card_unit_ki_84_frank.title: Ki-84 FRANK
card_unit_ki_84_frank.flavorText: plus it had enough firepower to take down the high flying and well-defended Boeing B-29 Superfortress.

card_unit_kumamoto_regiment.name: card_unit_kumamoto_regiment
card_unit_kumamoto_regiment.title: KUMAMOTO REGIMENT
card_unit_kumamoto_regiment.flavorText: at Bougainville Island in the Solomon Islands.

card_unit_mito_regiment.name: card_unit_mito_regiment
card_unit_mito_regiment.title: MITO REGIMENT
card_unit_mito_regiment.text: Destruction: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_mito_regiment.flavorText: where one of the fiercest battles of the Pacific War took place.

card_unit_model_25.name: card_unit_model_25
card_unit_model_25.title: MODEL 25
card_unit_model_25.text: Deployment: Give a friendly infantry +2 attack until end of turn.
card_unit_model_25.flavorText: during the 1930s. The Model 25 had a crew of 5 and a main armament of 2 x Vickers 7.7 mm machine guns.

card_unit_p1y_ginga.name: card_unit_p1y_ginga
card_unit_p1y_ginga.title: P1Y GINGA
card_unit_p1y_ginga.text: deal 1 damage to all enemies. Deployment: Deal 1 damage to all enemies.
card_unit_p1y_ginga.flavorText: but at the end of the war it was also used for Kamikaze attacks against Allied ships. The Allied code name for the P1Y Ginga was "Frances".

card_unit_pete.name: card_unit_pete
card_unit_pete.title: F1M2 PETE
card_unit_pete.text: Cannot be attacked by ground units while in the support line.

card_unit_sally.name: card_unit_sally
card_unit_sally.title: Ki-21 SALLY
card_unit_sally.flavorText: but production was halted in 1944. The Allied reporting name of the Mitsubishi Ki-21 was "Sally".

card_unit_sendai_regiment.name: card_unit_sendai_regiment
card_unit_sendai_regiment.title: SENDAI REGIMENT
card_unit_sendai_regiment.text: Deployment: Remove an enemy unit until SENDAI REGIMENT leaves the battlefield.
card_unit_sendai_regiment.flavorText: but after a defeat the remnants of the division were assigned to the Japanese 38th Army in French Indochina before it was disbanded by the end of the war.

card_unit_shiden.name: card_unit_shiden
card_unit_shiden.title: N1K-J SHIDEN
card_unit_shiden.flavorText: a land-based version of the N1K Kyōfū which was a Navy float plane. The Allied nicknamed the aircraft "George" and both pilots and opponents considered it to be one of the finest land-based fighters flown by the Japanese during WWII. The N1K-J Shiden entered service in early 1944 and 1,007 aircraft were produced before production was switched to the improved N1K2-J.

card_unit_sonia.name: card_unit_sonia
card_unit_sonia.title: AICHI D3A-1
card_unit_sonia.text: add an AICHI D3A-2 to your support line.

card_unit_takasagi_regiment.name: card_unit_takasagi_regiment
card_unit_takasagi_regiment.title: TAKASAKI REGIMENT
card_unit_takasagi_regiment.text: Destruction: Your enemy discards a card.
card_unit_takasagi_regiment.flavorText: The 15th Infantry Regiment (Takasaki) was attached to the 14th Division of the Japanese Imperial Army and was with them from 1937 and throughout WWII. In 1944 parts of the regiment took part in the Battle of Peleliu.

card_unit_type_3_chi_nu.name: card_unit_type_3_chi_nu
card_unit_type_3_chi_nu.title: TYPE 3 Chi-Nu
card_unit_type_3_chi_nu.text: Has Ambush and Guard while in your support line.
card_unit_type_3_chi_nu.flavorText: Type 3 Chi-Nu  was a Japanese medium tank used by the Imperial Japanese Army in WWII. The tank was an improved version of the Type 97 Chi-Ha and used a Type 3 75 mm tank gun which was one the largest tank guns used by the Japanese forces in the war. 144 to 166 units were produced from 1944 to 1945 and due to its late arrival it did not see combat during the war as all units were used for defense of the homeland for the anticipated Allied invasion. The Type 3 Chi-Nu had a crew of 5 and a secondary armament of a single 7.7 mm Type 97 machine gun.

card_unit_type_88_aa_gun.name: card_unit_type_88_aa_gun
card_unit_type_88_aa_gun.title: TYPE 88 AA GUN
card_unit_type_88_aa_gun.text: Air units that attack or are attacked by TYPE 88 AA GUN are pinned.
card_unit_type_88_aa_gun.flavorText: and as a coastal-defense gun. By the end of the war many of the guns were withdrawn from front line services and used for Japan's homeland defenses against Allied air raids and to prepare for the threat of the Allied invasion.

card_unit_type_89.name: card_unit_type_89
card_unit_type_89.title: TYPE 89 Chi-Ro
card_unit_type_89.text: it takes that much damage instead.
card_unit_type_89.flavorText: a main armament of 57 mm Type 90 gun and a secondary armament of 2 x 6.5 mm Type 91 machine guns.

card_unit_type_93.name: card_unit_type_93
card_unit_type_93.title: TYPE 93
card_unit_type_93.flavorText: Type 93 was an armored car used by the Imperial Japanese Army and naval landing forces in WWII. It had a crew of 4-6 a main armament of 1x 7.7mm Vickers Mk I Medium Machine Gun and a secondary armament of 4x 6.5mm Type 91mm Machine Guns or Nambu Type 11 machine guns.

card_unit_type_95.name: card_unit_type_95
card_unit_type_95.title: TYPE 95 Ha-Go
card_unit_type_95.text: deal 1 damage to the HQ of the player giving the order.
card_unit_type_95.flavorText: a main armament of Type 94 (1934) 37 mm tank gun and a secondary armament of 2x 7.7 mm Type 97 machine guns.

card_unit_type_96_25mm_aa_gun.name: card_unit_type_96_25mm_aa_gun
card_unit_type_96_25mm_aa_gun.title: TYPE 96 AA GUN
card_unit_type_96_25mm_aa_gun.text: Enemy air units enter the battlefield with defense of 1. Destruction: Draw a card.
card_unit_type_96_25mm_aa_gun.flavorText: but was primarily used as an anti-aircraft gun in fixed mounts with between one and three guns. 33,000 units were built and military personnel generally considered it the most reliable Japanese anti-aircraft gun.

card_unit_type_97.name: card_unit_type_97
card_unit_type_97.title: TYPE 97 Chi-Ha
card_unit_type_97.flavorText: a main armament of Type 97 57 mm tank gun and a secondary armament of 2x 7.7 mm Type 97 machine guns.

card_unit_type_98_ke_ni.name: card_unit_type_98_ke_ni
card_unit_type_98_ke_ni.title: TYPE 98 Ke-Ni
card_unit_type_98_ke_ni.text: Gets +1 attack if you have attacked with another unit this turn.
card_unit_type_98_ke_ni.flavorText: making more room for the commander/gunner to operate the 37mm tank gun.

card_unit_zero.name: card_unit_zero
card_unit_zero.title: A6M2 ZERO
card_unit_zero.flavorText: which resulted in the design of the Grummen Hellcat.

card_event_command_failure.name: card_event_command_failure
card_event_command_failure.title: COMMAND FAILURE
card_event_command_failure.text: Destroy target unit with less attack than defense.
card_event_command_failure.flavorText: in one of the most significant Allied defeats of the war.

card_event_defeat_in_detail.name: card_event_defeat_in_detail
card_event_defeat_in_detail.title: DEFEAT IN DETAIL
card_event_defeat_in_detail.text: Your units get: "Gets +1+1 when it damages the enemy HQ."
card_event_defeat_in_detail.flavorText: suffering only light damage in return.

card_event_duty_bound.name: card_event_duty_bound
card_event_duty_bound.title: DUTY BOUND
card_event_duty_bound.text: plus +1+1 for each previously played DUTY BOUND.
card_event_duty_bound.flavorText: often leading to kamikaze missions and other acts of martyrdom during the war.

card_event_exhaust_all_options.name: card_event_exhaust_all_options
card_event_exhaust_all_options.title: EXHAUST ALL OPTIONS
card_event_exhaust_all_options.text: Pin target unit and adjacent units. Pin units deployed and added by the enemy next turn.
card_event_exhaust_all_options.flavorText: and brutal treatment by their captors.

card_event_seek_and_destroy.name: card_event_seek_and_destroy
card_event_seek_and_destroy.title: SEEK AND DESTROY
card_event_seek_and_destroy.flavorText: the strong eat is a proverb from the 8th century. In the Malayan campaign the Japanese repeatedly infiltrated the defenses of the British Commonwealth army units and had them surrounded before they realized they were under attack.

card_event_shadow_strike.name: card_event_shadow_strike
card_event_shadow_strike.title: SHADOW STRIKE
card_event_shadow_strike.flavorText: like at the Battle of Rennell Island in 1943. As the war progressed the Allies more or less managed to counter these attacks with the advancement of airborne radar technology which allowed night fighters to operate independently to locate and attack the Japanese bombers.

card_unit_388th_independent.name: card_unit_388th_independent
card_unit_388th_independent.title: 388th INDEPENDENT
card_unit_388th_independent.text: Destruction: The enemy draws a card.
card_unit_388th_independent.flavorText: and had far superior tanks and equipment.

card_unit_58th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_58th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_58th_infantry_regiment.title: 58th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_58th_infantry_regiment.text: Has +2 attack while it has Shock.
card_unit_58th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: the siege was lifted. The remaining forces of the 31st Division continued resisting the Allied reoccupation of Burma but had lost their strength and were no longer an effective fighting unit.

card_unit_77th_regiment.name: card_unit_77th_regiment
card_unit_77th_regiment.title: 77th REGIMENT
card_unit_77th_regiment.text: add a 20th INFANTRY REGIMENT to your support line.
card_unit_77th_regiment.flavorText: where they survived until Japan's surrender in August 1945. Smaller detachments were eliminated in Sarangani Bay in July 1945.

card_unit_cedar_division.name: card_unit_cedar_division
card_unit_cedar_division.title: CEDAR DIVISION
card_unit_cedar_division.text: Becomes Veteran if you have 4 or less kredit slots.
card_unit_cedar_division.flavorText: who did not surrender until 10 March 1974.

card_unit_fukuoka_regiment.name: card_unit_fukuoka_regiment
card_unit_fukuoka_regiment.title: FUKUOKA REGIMENT
card_unit_fukuoka_regiment.text: Destruction: The enemy gains an extra kredit slot.
card_unit_fukuoka_regiment.flavorText: the division was ordered to surrender and most of its soldiers were subsequently taken prisoner by the Soviet Red Army.

card_unit_ki_30_ann.name: card_unit_ki_30_ann
card_unit_ki_30_ann.title: Ki-30 ANN
card_unit_ki_30_ann.text: deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_ki_30_ann.flavorText: the aircraft played an important role in Japan's early air campaigns and contributed to the initial wave of Japanese successes in Asia.

card_unit_type_4_chi_to.name: card_unit_type_4_chi_to
card_unit_type_4_chi_to.title: TYPE 4 Chi-To
card_unit_type_4_chi_to.text: Your units have +2 attack while they have Shock.

card_unit_type_92_jyu_shokasa.name: card_unit_type_92_jyu_shokasa
card_unit_type_92_jyu_shokasa.title: TYPE 92 Jyu-Shokosha
card_unit_type_92_jyu_shokasa.text: Gets +1 attack when it damages the enemy HQ.
card_unit_type_92_jyu_shokasa.flavorText: but was outdated when WWII began. 169 Type 92 tankettes were built by 1939.

card_event_costly_victory.name: card_event_costly_victory
card_event_costly_victory.title: COSTLY VICTORY
card_event_costly_victory.text: Destroy target unit. Remove cards from the top of your deck equal to its attack.
card_event_costly_victory.flavorText: not only in combat but also due to starvation and disease.

card_event_experimental_flight.name: card_event_experimental_flight
card_event_experimental_flight.title: EXPERIMENTAL FLIGHT
card_event_experimental_flight.text: Choose and discard a card to add a random Japanese elite air unit to your hand.
card_event_experimental_flight.flavorText: and dive into its target. Very few Ohkas ever made it near the US fleet as patrolling fighters shot down most of the G4M Betty bombers before they could get into range to launch their Ohkas.

card_event_greater_purpose.name: card_event_greater_purpose
card_event_greater_purpose.title: GREATER PURPOSE
card_event_greater_purpose.text: Your units get: "Destruction: Draw a card."
card_event_greater_purpose.flavorText: but there is no record of a Japanese military unit surrendering in battle.

card_event_outmaneuver.name: card_event_outmaneuver
card_event_outmaneuver.title: OUTMANEUVER
card_event_outmaneuver.text: Target Japanese unit has 0 operation cost this turn. If it has Smokescreen it gets +2+2.
card_event_outmaneuver.flavorText: usually in support of naval operations or amphibious landings. The focus was on swift surprise attacks where they tried to catch the enemy off guard. From 1942 and onward the strength of the Japanese naval air forces were greatly reduced and so was their offensive capability and the air doctrine focused mainly on defensive operations and/or desperate Kamikaze attacks.

card_event_reorganize.name: card_event_reorganize
card_event_reorganize.title: REORGANIZE
card_event_reorganize.text: Choose a card in hand and shuffle it into your deck. Draw a card.
card_event_reorganize.flavorText: but soon the Allies knew what to expect and were prepared.

card_event_seize_the_initiative.name: card_event_seize_the_initiative
card_event_seize_the_initiative.title: TAKE INITIATIVE
card_event_seize_the_initiative.text: Draw 1 card. Add TAKE INITIATIVE to the enemy hand with all numericals one higher.
card_event_seize_the_initiative.flavorText: making it impossible to defend all of its newly claimed territory and soon the Pacific Theater became a war of attrition and Japan was on the losing side.

card_event_sneak_attack.name: card_event_sneak_attack
card_event_sneak_attack.title: SNEAK ATTACK
card_event_sneak_attack.text: Destroy target unit. Remove copies of it from the owner's hand and deck.
card_event_sneak_attack.flavorText: the Americans dropped two atomic bombs on the cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki with such a devastating effect that the Japanese leadership finally decided to surrender to the Allies.

card_event_yamato.name: card_event_yamato
card_event_yamato.title: IJN YAMATO
card_event_yamato.text: Your Japanese units everywhere get: "Destruction: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ."
card_event_yamato.flavorText: gunnery and optics which gave her tremendous precision to her main gunfire. The construction of these ships was an incredible achievement for the Japanese naval engineering and shipbuilding industry by any international standard. In 1945 Yamato was dispatched on a mission to Okinawa with orders to beach herself and defend the island until destroyed. On her way to Okinawa she was spotted by US aircraft and submarines and sunk in an air raid of carrier based bombers and torpedo bombers. The Yamato was lost with almost all hands. Her sister ship Musashi was sunk during the Battle of Leyte Gulf in 1944.

card_unit_dinah_iii.name: card_unit_dinah_iii
card_unit_dinah_iii.title: Ki-46 DINAH III
card_unit_dinah_iii.text: Deployment: Draw two random 1-cost units from your deck.
card_unit_dinah_iii.flavorText: it lacked self sealing fuel tanks and was slow to climb.

card_unit_japan_ki_100_goshiken.name: card_unit_japan_ki_100_goshiken
card_unit_japan_ki_100_goshiken.title: Ki-100 GOSHIKISEN
card_unit_japan_ki_100_goshiken.text: Is immune to damage during your turn.

card_unit_ki_83.name: card_unit_ki_83
card_unit_ki_83.title: Ki-83
card_unit_ki_83.text: you draw a card and the enemy draws 2 cards.
card_unit_ki_83.flavorText: before the Ki-83 entered production the war was over.

card_unit_mikawa_regiment.name: card_unit_mikawa_regiment
card_unit_mikawa_regiment.title: MIKAWA REGIMENT
card_unit_mikawa_regiment.text: Deployment: Increase the cost of all cards in your hand by 1.
card_unit_mikawa_regiment.flavorText: where it was ultimately destroyed by Allied forces.

card_unit_toyama_regiment.name: card_unit_toyama_regiment
card_unit_toyama_regiment.title: TOYAMA REGIMENT
card_unit_toyama_regiment.flavorText: The 69th Infantry Regiment Toyama was a regiment of the 109th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army which was active from 1937 to 1945. The division was sent to China in 1937 where it saw combat but was later assigned to garrison duty in the Shanxi province. The 109th Division was dissolved in 1939 but reformed in 1944 and assigned to the 31st Army. The bulk of the division was assigned to garrison duty on the volcanic islands of Iwo Jima and Chichi Jima and would be wiped out in the Battle of Iwo Jima in 1945.

card_unit_type_92_105mm_field_gun.name: card_unit_type_92_105mm_field_gun
card_unit_type_92_105mm_field_gun.title: TYPE 92 105mm FIELD GUN
card_unit_type_92_105mm_field_gun.flavorText: especially at long ranges. Only 180 TYPE 92 105mm field guns were manufactured and they were deployed in Phillipine Islands and at Guadalcanal where they were used to bombard American positions at Henderson Field.

card_unit_type_97_kai.name: card_unit_type_97_kai
card_unit_type_97_kai.title: TYPE 97 SHINHOTO
card_unit_type_97_kai.flavorText: driver) and a secondary armament of 2 x 7.7 mm Type 97 machine guns.

card_unit_utsunomiya_regiment.name: card_unit_utsunomiya_regiment
card_unit_utsunomiya_regiment.title: UTSUNOMIYA REGIMENT
card_unit_utsunomiya_regiment.text: deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_utsunomiya_regiment.flavorText: but the Battle of Angaur and the Battle of Peleliu were among the bloodiest battles in the Pacific War and almost all defenders were killed.

card_unit_wakamatsu_regiment.name: card_unit_wakamatsu_regiment
card_unit_wakamatsu_regiment.title: WAKAMATSU REGIMENT
card_unit_wakamatsu_regiment.text: Destruction: Destroy all of your WAKAMATSU REGIMENT units.
card_unit_wakamatsu_regiment.flavorText: but in 1944 the division was sent to Burma where it was almost destroyed while fighting the British reoccupation. The 29th Wakamatsu Regiment was disbanded after the war along with the 2nd Division.

card_unit_yamagata_regiment.name: card_unit_yamagata_regiment
card_unit_yamagata_regiment.title: YAMAGATA REGIMENT
card_unit_yamagata_regiment.text: Blitz and Fury if you have no cards in hand.
card_unit_yamagata_regiment.flavorText: disease or Allied air raids. The remainder of the 24th was sent to Okinawa to defend against an Allied invasion where the division was nearly annihilated during the  Battle of Okinawa in June 1945. Only the 1st and 3rd battalions of the 32nd Yamagata Infantry Regiment continued to fight the US occupation until they surrendered in late August that same year.

card_event_diplomatic_attache.name: card_event_diplomatic_attache
card_event_diplomatic_attache.title: DIPLOMATIC ATTACHÉ
card_event_diplomatic_attache.text: plus 1 for each previously played DIPLOMATIC ATTACHÉ.
card_event_diplomatic_attache.flavorText: but its impact on the outcome of the war was limited as the fortunes of the Axis powers declined.

card_event_island_fighting.name: card_event_island_fighting
card_event_island_fighting.title: ISLAND DEFENSE
card_event_island_fighting.text: Draw a card if your HQ has 10 or less defense. Give your HQ +8 defense.
card_event_island_fighting.flavorText: the overwhelming resources of the Allied forces eventually led to the recapture of the Pacific islands from Japanese control.

card_event_japan_duty.name: card_event_japan_duty
card_event_japan_duty.title: DUTY IS A MOUNTAIN
card_event_japan_duty.text: Give your units: "Destruction effects on this unit trigger an extra time."
card_event_japan_duty.flavorText: and unwavering dedication to duty. The Rescript played a significant role in shaping the mindset and moral code of Japanese soldiers and sailors during WWII. The quote in question was later used by Robert Jordan in his book series The Wheel of Time.

card_event_jungle_warfare.name: card_event_jungle_warfare
card_event_jungle_warfare.title: JUNGLE WARFARE
card_event_jungle_warfare.text: Give a unit: "Destruction: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy." Trigger its Destruction effects.
card_event_jungle_warfare.flavorText: and Burma showcased the Allies growing proficiency in jungle warfare and their ability to overcome Japanese resistance.

card_event_on_the_horizon.name: card_event_on_the_horizon
card_event_on_the_horizon.title: ON THE HORIZON
card_event_on_the_horizon.text: your units are immune to damage and have "Cannot attack the enemy HQ."
card_event_on_the_horizon.flavorText: the Japanese Navy faced increasing challenges from the growing strength of the Allies.

card_event_shinano.name: card_event_shinano
card_event_shinano.title: IJN SHINANO
card_event_shinano.text: Distribute damage randomly to enemies equal to the number of units on the battlefield.
card_event_shinano.flavorText: representing the brief operational period of a formidable carrier that never had the opportunity to fulfill its intended role in combat.

card_event_stealth_mission.name: card_event_stealth_mission
card_event_stealth_mission.title: STEALTH MISSION
card_event_stealth_mission.text: Give a friendly unit: "Remove from the battlefield at the start of your turn to gain 6 kredits and draw 3 cards."
card_event_stealth_mission.flavorText: the attack on Pearl Harbor remains one of the most notable examples of Japanese submarine operations during the war.

card_event_under_fire_japan.name: card_event_under_fire_japan
card_event_under_fire_japan.title: UNDER FIRE
card_event_under_fire_japan.text: Deal 1 damage to target enemy unit and to adjacent enemies. Pin units damaged.
card_event_under_fire_japan.flavorText: and it sometimes led to devastating losses.

card_unit_24th_cavalry_regiment.name: card_unit_24th_cavalry_regiment
card_unit_24th_cavalry_regiment.title: 24th CAVALRY REGIMENT
card_unit_24th_cavalry_regiment.text: Destruction: Draw a 24th CAVALRY REGIMENT from your deck.
card_unit_24th_cavalry_regiment.flavorText: belonged to the 8th Division and did not surrender until 1974.

card_unit_56th_recon.name: card_unit_56th_recon
card_unit_56th_recon.title: 56th RECON
card_unit_56th_recon.text: Destruction: Deal 1 damage to each enemy unit.
card_unit_56th_recon.flavorText: the division was stationed on the border between South Burma and Thailand.

card_unit_66th_independent.name: card_unit_66th_independent
card_unit_66th_independent.title: 66th INDEPENDENT
card_unit_66th_independent.text: Deployment: Destroy an enemy unit with two adjacent units.
card_unit_66th_independent.flavorText: the 145th Regiment was unable to be transported and was redirected from Saipan in June 1944 to Iwo Jima under General Kuribayashi’s command. It met its demise during the intense Battle of Iwo Jima in February to March 1945.

card_unit_ki_45_dragon_slayer.name: card_unit_ki_45_dragon_slayer
card_unit_ki_45_dragon_slayer.title: Ki-45 DRAGON SLAYER
card_unit_ki_45_dragon_slayer.text: Deployment: Becomes Veteran if this is the first Ki-45 DRAGON SLAYER you deploy this battle.

card_unit_ki_49_donryu.name: card_unit_ki_49_donryu
card_unit_ki_49_donryu.title: Ki-49 STORM DRAGON
card_unit_ki_49_donryu.flavorText: and even kamikaze missions. Production ended in December 1944 after approximately 819 aircraft had been built.

card_unit_kokuras_sword.name: card_unit_kokuras_sword
card_unit_kokuras_sword.title: KOKURA'S SWORD
card_unit_kokuras_sword.text: add a random Japanese ground unit to your support line and give it this ability.

card_unit_matsumoto_regiment.name: card_unit_matsumoto_regiment
card_unit_matsumoto_regiment.title: MATSUMOTO REGIMENT
card_unit_matsumoto_regiment.text: Deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ when a Destruction effect triggers.
card_unit_matsumoto_regiment.flavorText: but the battle continued for a few more days until organized resistance was effectively crushed on 3 August 1944. Only about 200 men of the Japanese garrison survived the fighting.

card_event_air_land_sea.name: card_event_air_land_sea
card_event_air_land_sea.title: LAND & SEA
card_event_air_land_sea.text: Develop a card in your deck. Lose a kredit slot.
card_event_air_land_sea.flavorText: and strategic miscalculations ultimately led to their defeat in all three domains.

card_event_carrier_battle.name: card_event_carrier_battle
card_event_carrier_battle.title: CARRIER BATTLE
card_event_carrier_battle.text: Deal 3 damage. Add CARRIER BATTLE to the enemy hand with all numericals one higher.
card_event_carrier_battle.flavorText: three of those in the Battle of the Philippine Sea alone.

card_event_commit_the_reserves.name: card_event_commit_the_reserves
card_event_commit_the_reserves.title: COMMIT THE RESERVES
card_event_commit_the_reserves.text: Destroy target unit with attack equal or less than your kredit slots. Lose a kredit slot.
card_event_commit_the_reserves.flavorText: the Japanese military's focus on offensive tactics and its reluctance to rotate troops led to exhaustion and a lack of fresh reinforcements. This ultimately hampered Japan's ability to sustain its war effort and contributed to its eventual defeat.

card_event_grand_plans.name: card_event_grand_plans
card_event_grand_plans.title: GRAND PLANS
card_event_grand_plans.text: Choose and discard a card to draw a card with higher cost from your deck.
card_event_grand_plans.flavorText: these were not part of a larger strategic bombing campaign.

card_event_great_expanse.name: card_event_great_expanse
card_event_great_expanse.title: THE GREAT EXPANSE
card_event_great_expanse.text: Set your kredit slots to equal the enemy kredit slots. Your units get +1 attack for each slot gained.
card_event_great_expanse.flavorText: this overextension of their forces and the fierce resistance of Allied powers proved unsustainable and led to their eventual downfall.

card_event_one_roof.name: card_event_one_roof
card_event_one_roof.title: ONE ROOF
card_event_one_roof.text: Draw 2 cards. Gain 4 kredits if you have lost 2 or more kredit slots this battle.
card_event_one_roof.flavorText: the brutality and atrocities of invasion and occupation stood in stark contrast to the idealized vision promoted by wartime propaganda.

card_unit_174th_independent.name: card_unit_174th_independent
card_unit_174th_independent.title: 174th INDEPENDENT
card_unit_174th_independent.text: it gets +1+1 and you draw a card.
card_unit_174th_independent.flavorText: approximately 4,000 personnel from the 77th Infantry Brigade of the 102nd Division also survived and engaged in guerrilla warfare against invading US forces from March 1945 until the end of the war.

card_unit_40th_cavalry_regiment.name: card_unit_40th_cavalry_regiment
card_unit_40th_cavalry_regiment.title: 40th CAVALRY REGIMENT
card_unit_40th_cavalry_regiment.text:
Deployment: Lose a kredit slot. 
Destruction: Reduce the cost of cards in your hand by 1.
card_unit_40th_cavalry_regiment.flavorText: and surviving personnel returned to Japan by May 1946.

card_unit_51st_recon.name: card_unit_51st_recon
card_unit_51st_recon.title: 51st RECON
card_unit_51st_recon.flavorText: and only a small fraction of its soldiers survived until Japan's surrender in August 1945.

card_unit_5th_regiment.name: card_unit_5th_regiment
card_unit_5th_regiment.title: 5th REGIMENT
card_unit_5th_regiment.text: this unit gets +2+1 if on the battlefield or -2 cost if in hand.

card_unit_e7k.name: card_unit_e7k
card_unit_e7k.title: KAWANISHI E7K
card_unit_e7k.text: Reveal: Gets +2 attack if it is your turn.
card_unit_e7k.flavorText: two Type 92 machine guns and could carry up to 120 kg of bombs.

card_unit_kurume_regiment.name: card_unit_kurume_regiment
card_unit_kurume_regiment.title: KURUME REGIMENT
card_unit_kurume_regiment.flavorText: in the Jiandao area which is a border region between Northeastern China and Korea. In August 1945 the Soviet Red Army invaded Manchuria and the division was caught in heavy fighting against the advancing Soviets. Hunchun city was soon lost to Soviet forces but the division continued fighting until it was ordered to lay down arms on August 18th after the general surrender of Japan. Most of the remaining men of the 112th Division were taken prisoners by the Red Army.

card_unit_shoge_detachment.name: card_unit_shoge_detachment
card_unit_shoge_detachment.title: SHOGE DETACHMENT
card_unit_shoge_detachment.flavorText: which was a series of battles fought in north-eastern Papua New Guinea in 1943 and 1944.

card_unit_tsu_regiment.name: card_unit_tsu_regiment
card_unit_tsu_regiment.title: TSU REGIMENT
card_unit_tsu_regiment.text:
Deployment: Target a unit. 
Destruction: Destroy the unit targeted.

card_event_drive_into_the_sea.name: card_event_drive_into_the_sea
card_event_drive_into_the_sea.title: DRIVE INTO THE SEA
card_event_drive_into_the_sea.flavorText: many would face brutal conditions in captivity.

card_event_ijn_shirakumo.name: card_event_ijn_shirakumo
card_event_ijn_shirakumo.title: IJN SHIRAKUMO
card_event_ijn_shirakumo.text: remove it instead. Your HQ gains +2 defense.
card_event_ijn_shirakumo.flavorText: putting her out of action until October. She resumed escort duties in Northern-Pacific waters in 1943 but was lost with all hands on 16 March 1944 when the submarine USS Harder torpedoed her off Hokkaido while she was escorting a convoy to the Kuril islands.

card_event_overpower.name: card_event_overpower
card_event_overpower.title: OVERPOWER
card_event_overpower.text: Destroy a unit with 2 or less attack and all other units with the same name on the battlefield.
card_event_overpower.flavorText: introduced newer fighters and expanded production.

card_event_swift_victory.name: card_event_swift_victory
card_event_swift_victory.title: SWIFT VICTORY
card_event_swift_victory.text: Deal 3 damage. Units in the enemy deck get +3 attack.
card_event_swift_victory.flavorText: but not the means to sustain it.

card_event_volunteer_corps_home.name: card_event_volunteer_corps_home
card_event_volunteer_corps_home.title: VOLUNTEER CORPS
card_event_volunteer_corps_home.text: Remove a unit from the battlefield until the end of turn.
card_event_volunteer_corps_home.flavorText: their formation reflected the desperate state of the empire in its final months and the extent to which it was prepared to sacrifice its civilian population in defense of the home islands.

card_event_way_of_subjects.name: card_event_way_of_subjects
card_event_way_of_subjects.title: WAY OF SUBJECTS
card_event_way_of_subjects.text: All Japanese cards in your deck get Bond and "Your HQ gets +1 defense when you play this card."
card_event_way_of_subjects.flavorText: used to shape public thinking and justify military expansion during WWII.

card_unit_106th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_106th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_106th_infantry_regiment.title: 106th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_106th_infantry_regiment.text: add a copy to your hand.
card_unit_106th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: the remnants of the division participated in defensive actions during the Battle of the Sittang Bend and were still holding positions on the Sittang River when Japan surrendered in August 1945.

card_unit_211th_tokyo.name: card_unit_211th_tokyo
card_unit_211th_tokyo.title: 211th TOKYO
card_unit_211th_tokyo.flavorText: and ordered to fight to the end. Its destruction marked one of many costly defeats for Japan in the Philippines.

card_unit_73rd_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_73rd_infantry_regiment
card_unit_73rd_infantry_regiment.title: 73rd INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_73rd_infantry_regiment.text: Deployment: Trigger the destruction effects of all friendly units destroyed since the start of your last turn.
card_unit_73rd_infantry_regiment.flavorText: ceasing to function as a coherent unit.

card_unit_9th_guards_regiment.name: card_unit_9th_guards_regiment
card_unit_9th_guards_regiment.title: 9th GUARDS REGIMENT
card_unit_9th_guards_regiment.flavorText: though its role in the war remained limited to defensive preparations.

card_unit_japan_ki_67_peggy.name: card_unit_japan_ki_67_peggy
card_unit_japan_ki_67_peggy.title: Ki-67 PEGGY
card_unit_japan_ki_67_peggy.text: Deployment: Remove an enemy unit that has 3 or less attack.
card_unit_japan_ki_67_peggy.flavorText: including the Sakura-dan variant which carried two 800 kg bombs. Some variants such as night fighters and anti-submarine aircraft were also developed. Its durability and agility made it one of Japan's most capable twin-engine bombers of WWII.

card_unit_kanazawa_regiment.name: card_unit_kanazawa_regiment
card_unit_kanazawa_regiment.title: KANAZAWA REGIMENT
card_unit_kanazawa_regiment.flavorText: the division saw real combat in the final hours of Japan’s war effort.

card_unit_kawasaki_ki_10.name: card_unit_kawasaki_ki_10
card_unit_kawasaki_ki_10.title: KAWASAKI Ki-10
card_unit_kawasaki_ki_10.text: Gets +1 attack until end of turn after you attack with a Japanese unit.
card_unit_kawasaki_ki_10.flavorText: though the Ki-10 remained in service for training and patrol duties until early 1942.

card_unit_ki_61_i_tei.name: card_unit_ki_61_i_tei
card_unit_ki_61_i_tei.title: Ki-61-I-TEI
card_unit_ki_61_i_tei.flavorText: production and deployment of the TEI variant were limited due to engine shortages and Allied bombing of Japanese industrial centers. It saw service defending the Japanese home islands and in units deployed to Okinawa and the Philippines. Roughly 1,380 Ki-61-I-TEI aircraft were produced before production ended.

card_unit_kofu_regiment.name: card_unit_kofu_regiment
card_unit_kofu_regiment.title: KŌFU REGIMENT
card_unit_kofu_regiment.flavorText: their deployment reflected Japan’s urgent shift to homeland defense during the final months of the war.

card_unit_oita_regiment.name: card_unit_oita_regiment
card_unit_oita_regiment.title: ŌITA REGIMENT
card_unit_oita_regiment.text: Gets +1+1 when a Destruction effect triggers.
card_unit_oita_regiment.flavorText: ultimately surrendering to Allied forces on the island in August 1945.

card_unit_sapporo_regiment.name: card_unit_sapporo_regiment
card_unit_sapporo_regiment.title: SAPPORO REGIMENT
card_unit_sapporo_regiment.text: Gain +1+1 and a random combat keyword when an undestroyed unit leaves the battlefield.
card_unit_sapporo_regiment.flavorText: more than 18,000 troops from the 88th Division and the Koton Fortified Region were captured and sent to labor camps in Siberia or Sakhalin.

card_unit_storm_division.name: card_unit_storm_division
card_unit_storm_division.title: STORM DIVISION
card_unit_storm_division.text: Your other Japanese units have +2 attack.
card_unit_storm_division.flavorText: it took part in the Battle of West Henan–North Hubei with the support of the 86th Independent Mixed Brigade. The division was stationed in Hengyang when Japan surrendered in August 1945.

card_event_banzai_charge.name: card_event_banzai_charge
card_event_banzai_charge.title: BANZAI
card_event_banzai_charge.text: Destroy all units with 4 attack or less. End your turn.
card_event_banzai_charge.flavorText: when Japanese troops launched a final charge after their ammunition and supplies were nearly exhausted; almost all of them were killed.

card_event_calm_before_the_storm.name: card_event_calm_before_the_storm
card_event_calm_before_the_storm.title: CALM BEFORE THE STORM
card_event_calm_before_the_storm.text: Give your units +3+1. End your turn.
card_event_calm_before_the_storm.flavorText: but they believed that swift defeat of their fleet in the Pacific would force them to negotiate for peace. Little did they know.

card_event_dawn_operations.name: card_event_dawn_operations
card_event_dawn_operations.title: DAWN OPERATIONS
card_event_dawn_operations.text: Your air units operate for free this turn. Lose a kredit slot.

card_event_diversion.name: card_event_diversion
card_event_diversion.title: DIVERSION
card_event_diversion.text: Give target non-Guard ground unit in a support line Smokescreen. Draw a card.
card_event_diversion.flavorText: but they were usually outclassed in tank vs tank combat and were easy targets for anti-tank weapons.

card_event_new_doctrine.name: card_event_new_doctrine
card_event_new_doctrine.title: NEW DOCTRINE
card_event_new_doctrine.text: Ignore "Cannot attack the enemy HQ" on target unit.
card_event_new_doctrine.flavorText: which nevertheless ended with the total annihilation of the defending forces.

card_event_redeployment.name: card_event_redeployment
card_event_redeployment.title: REDEPLOYMENT
card_event_redeployment.text: then draw that many cards plus one.

card_event_rule_the_skies.name: card_event_rule_the_skies
card_event_rule_the_skies.title: RULE THE SKIES
card_event_rule_the_skies.flavorText: and not enough fuel to keep their aircraft constantly in the air to be on the lookout enemy aircraft.

card_event_shock_attack.name: card_event_shock_attack
card_event_shock_attack.title: SHOCK ATTACK
card_event_shock_attack.text: When a friendly unit loses Smokescreen this turn it gets +2+2
card_event_shock_attack.flavorText: and the success of these attacks early in the war made them a standard tactic of their army. The Allied forces would quickly adapt to these tactics and their superior firepower and manpower would often result in heavy Japanese casualties and the failure of the attacks.

card_unit_54th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_54th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_54th_infantry_regiment.title: 54th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_54th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: where it defended against the invading Allied forces. The remaining survivors of the 17th Division surrendered to the Allies when the Pacific War ended in August 1945.

card_unit_aichi_b7a2.name: card_unit_aichi_b7a2
card_unit_aichi_b7a2.title: B7A2 RYUSEI
card_unit_aichi_b7a2.flavorText: plus a handful of other variants.

card_unit_kikka_jet.name: card_unit_kikka_jet
card_unit_kikka_jet.title: KIKKA
card_unit_kikka_jet.text: Destruction: Shuffle 4 KAMIKAZE cards into your deck.
card_unit_kikka_jet.flavorText: so it’s no coincidence that the design is similar.

card_unit_ki_42_ii_ko.name: card_unit_ki_42_ii_ko
card_unit_ki_42_ii_ko.title: Ki-43-IIb OTSU
card_unit_ki_42_ii_ko.text: Has +2 attack on your turn if the enemy controls no air units.

card_unit_matsue_regiment.name: card_unit_matsue_regiment
card_unit_matsue_regiment.title: MATSUE REGIMENT
card_unit_matsue_regiment.text: Deployment: Choose and discard a card. Gain attack equal to the cost.
card_unit_matsue_regiment.flavorText: before being transferred to Luzon in the Philippines in order to defend against the US advance in the Pacific. The division was annihilated in the Battle of Luzon in 1945 where it fought under the command of Japanese Fourteenth Area Army.

card_unit_nara_regiment.name: card_unit_nara_regiment
card_unit_nara_regiment.title: NARA REGIMENT
card_unit_nara_regiment.text: Ignore "Cannot attack the enemy HQ" on your units.
card_unit_nara_regiment.flavorText: surrendered in 1972 after living alone in a cave for 27 years.

card_unit_p1y2_kasho.name: card_unit_p1y2_kasho
card_unit_p1y2_kasho.title: P1Y1 MODEL 11
card_unit_p1y2_kasho.text: When a friendly unit loses Smokescreen it gets +2+2.
card_unit_p1y2_kasho.flavorText: but due to poor performance they were converted into the P1Y2 Ginga bomber variant. The Allied reporting name for the P1Y was “Frances”.

card_location_baguio.name: card_location_baguio
card_location_baguio.title: BAGUIO
card_location_baguio.text: The Battle of Baguio in 1945 involved Japanese and Allied forces.
card_location_baguio.flavorText: marking a significant victory in the Philippines Campaign.

card_location_changchun.name: card_location_changchun
card_location_changchun.title: TRUK
card_location_changchun.text: TRUK atoll was the main Japanese naval base in the South Pacific during WWII.
card_location_changchun.flavorText: repair facilities and a radar station. In February 1944 the Truk base was destroyed by the American airpower and was cut off for the remainder of the war.

card_location_manila.name: card_location_manila
card_location_manila.title: MANILA
card_location_manila.flavorText: or until it was recaptured by the Allies in 1945.

card_location_rangoon.name: card_location_rangoon
card_location_rangoon.title: RANGOON
card_location_rangoon.text: was captured by Japan in March 1942.
card_location_rangoon.flavorText: and many that initially fought on the side of Japan switched allegiance to the Allied side as the war progressed.

card_location_ai_japan_unlock1.title: CHERBOURG
card_location_ai_japan_unlock1.text: Cherbourg was an important harbor for the Allies after D-Day.

card_event_dug_in.name: card_event_dug_in
card_event_dug_in.title: DUG IN
card_event_dug_in.text: Deal 1 damage to a unit. Shuffle SHIFTING DOCTRINE into your deck.
card_event_dug_in.flavorText: over 60 miles of tunnels housed an entire army underground. Japan's dug-in strategy turned small islands into fortresses and made every yard of ground costly.

card_event_engage_range.name: card_event_engage_range
card_event_engage_range.title: ENGAGE AT RANGE
card_event_engage_range.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Convert into ENGAGE UP CLOSE if put from your hand to deck.
card_event_engage_range.flavorText: the Type 93 was the most advanced torpedo of its time and a major threat to Allied naval forces throughout the war.

card_event_ijn_akagi.name: card_event_ijn_akagi
card_event_ijn_akagi.title: IJN AKAGI
card_event_ijn_akagi.text: then draw 3 cards. They cost 2 less to play this turn.
card_event_ijn_akagi.flavorText: symbolizing the beginning of Japan’s decline in naval air power.

card_event_mikura.name: card_event_mikura
card_event_mikura.title: IJN MIKURA
card_event_mikura.text: draw an IJN MIKURA from your deck.
card_event_mikura.flavorText: she operated under increasingly difficult conditions with limited impact on the overall course of the war.

card_event_shifting_doctrine.name: card_event_shifting_doctrine
card_event_shifting_doctrine.title: SHIFTING DOCTRINE
card_event_shifting_doctrine.flavorText: and asymmetric tactics as its navy weakened. Leaders like General Tadamichi Kuribayashi exemplified this approach where his defense of Iwo Jima focused on maximizing US losses rather than holding ground. The strategy no longer aimed for victory but tried to stall the American advance and pressure the Allies into a negotiated peace.

card_event_the_tide_turns.name: card_event_the_tide_turns
card_event_the_tide_turns.title: THE TIDE TURNS
card_event_the_tide_turns.text: draw equal amount. Deal damage to all units equal to Navy cards shuffled in.
card_event_the_tide_turns.flavorText: it marked the moment when the tide of the Pacific War truly turned.

card_unit_10th_recon.name: card_unit_10th_recon
card_unit_10th_recon.title: 10th RECON
card_unit_10th_recon.flavorText: though disease and starvation took a greater toll than battle.

card_unit_3rd_kure_snlf.name: card_unit_3rd_kure_snlf
card_unit_3rd_kure_snlf.title: 3rd KURE SNLF
card_unit_3rd_kure_snlf.flavorText: the Japanese were forced to evacuate after suffering significant casualties. The heavy losses at Tulagi and Milne Bay marked the decline of the 3rd Kure SNLF's combat effectiveness and the unit was disbanded soon after.

card_unit_3rd_mixed_regiment.name: card_unit_3rd_mixed_regiment
card_unit_3rd_mixed_regiment.title: 3rd MIXED REGIMENT
card_unit_3rd_mixed_regiment.text: deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ when you shuffle your deck.
card_unit_3rd_mixed_regiment.flavorText: and the remainder of the men capitulated following the Japanese surrender in August 1945.

card_unit_5th_sasebo_snlf.name: card_unit_5th_sasebo_snlf
card_unit_5th_sasebo_snlf.title: 5th SASEBO SNLF
card_unit_5th_sasebo_snlf.flavorText: often fighting to the last man. Their actions in New Guinea exemplified the aggressive tactics and high morale characteristic of Japan’s naval infantry during the early Pacific campaigns.

card_unit_gifu_regiment.name: card_unit_gifu_regiment
card_unit_gifu_regiment.title: GIFU REGIMENT
card_unit_gifu_regiment.text: gains Shock and you draw a card when you play a Navy card.
card_unit_gifu_regiment.flavorText: their commander decided to lead a final banzai charge on July 7. This assault resulted in the annihilation of the 43rd Division.

card_unit_kyoto_regiment.name: card_unit_kyoto_regiment
card_unit_kyoto_regiment.title: KYOTO REGIMENT
card_unit_kyoto_regiment.text: Deployment: Remove an enemy unit until this unit leaves the battlefield.
card_unit_kyoto_regiment.flavorText: where they remained until Japan's surrender in August 1945.

card_unit_nakajima_b5n2.name: card_unit_nakajima_b5n2
card_unit_nakajima_b5n2.title: NAKAJIMA B5N2
card_unit_nakajima_b5n2.text: Gets +1+1 when you play a card with Intel.
card_unit_nakajima_b5n2.flavorText: largely due to its heavy use in the early campaigns.

card_unit_sabae_regiment.name: card_unit_sabae_regiment
card_unit_sabae_regiment.title: SABAE REGIMENT
card_unit_sabae_regiment.text: distribute damage randomly to enemies equal to units in play.
card_unit_sabae_regiment.flavorText: remembered for its desperate defense and heavy casualties.

card_unit_thunder_division.name: card_unit_thunder_division
card_unit_thunder_division.title: THUNDER DIVISION
card_unit_thunder_division.flavorText: the division was eventually overwhelmed. The majority of its personnel were killed in the battle.

card_event_7075_aluminium.name: card_event_7075_aluminium
card_event_7075_aluminium.title: 7075 ALUMINIUM
card_event_7075_aluminium.text: Add three 0-cost A6M2 ZERO to your hand with: "Destruction: Add a 0-cost copy of this unit to your hand."

card_event_advanced_imperial_rnd.name: card_event_advanced_imperial_rnd
card_event_advanced_imperial_rnd.title: ADVANCED IMPERIAL R&D
card_event_advanced_imperial_rnd.text: Choose One - Add 7075 ALUMINIUM to hand OR add IMPERIAL WEAPON No. 2 to hand.

card_event_cruiser_scouts.name: card_event_cruiser_scouts
card_event_cruiser_scouts.title: CRUISER SCOUTS
card_event_cruiser_scouts.text: Pin a unit and Forecast. Also Intel 3 if you have 0 kredits.
card_event_cruiser_scouts.flavorText: and fragile communications could turn even successful sightings into missed chances.

card_event_expanded_imperial_rnd.name: card_event_expanded_imperial_rnd
card_event_expanded_imperial_rnd.title: EXPANDED IMPERIAL R&D
card_event_expanded_imperial_rnd.text: Choose One - Add LONG LANCE to hand OR add ADVANCED IMPERIAL R&D to hand.

card_event_ferocious_assault.name: card_event_ferocious_assault
card_event_ferocious_assault.title: FEROCIOUS ASSAULT
card_event_ferocious_assault.text: Destroy target infantry. Lose a kredit slot if its attack was greater than your kredit slots.
card_event_ferocious_assault.flavorText: but often came at a severe cost to the infantry carrying out the assault.

card_event_imperial_research.name: card_event_imperial_research
card_event_imperial_research.title: IMPERIAL RESEARCH
card_event_imperial_research.text: Choose One - Add BALLOON BOMBS to hand OR add EXPANDED IMPERIAL R&D to hand.
card_event_imperial_research.flavorText: but arrived too late for operational service.

card_event_imperial_weapon_no_2.name: card_event_imperial_weapon_no_2
card_event_imperial_weapon_no_2.title: IMPERIAL WEAPON No. 2
card_event_imperial_weapon_no_2.text: Add four KIKKA on top of your deck. They cost 0 to deploy and operate.

card_event_last_ditch_force.name: card_event_last_ditch_force
card_event_last_ditch_force.title: LAST DITCH FORCE
card_event_last_ditch_force.text: Destroy all units. Players lose 6 kredit slots. Units in decks get +3 attack.
card_event_last_ditch_force.flavorText: swords and even bamboo spears were to be used in a final defense of Japanese territory. Operation Ketsugō was never carried out. Japan surrendered in August 1945 before the planned Allied invasion could begin.

card_event_long_lance.name: card_event_long_lance
card_event_long_lance.title: LONG LANCE
card_event_long_lance.text: Destroy target unit. Draw 2 cards if it had an attack of 3 or less.

card_event_out_of_the_sun.name: card_event_out_of_the_sun
card_event_out_of_the_sun.title: OUT OF THE SUN
card_event_out_of_the_sun.flavorText: making the attacker nearly invisible until the strike was already underway.

card_event_shinyo_motorboats.name: card_event_shinyo_motorboats
card_event_shinyo_motorboats.title: SHINYO MOTORBOATS
card_event_shinyo_motorboats.text: Lose a kredit slot. Deal damage to target unit equal to kredit slots lost this battle plus 1.

card_event_special_attack.name: card_event_special_attack
card_event_special_attack.title: SPECIAL ATTACK
card_event_special_attack.text: Lose a kredit slot. Your units get: "Destruction: Deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ. Gain a kredit slot."

card_unit_1st_recon.name: card_unit_1st_recon
card_unit_1st_recon.title: 7th RECON
card_unit_1st_recon.text: Destruction: Draw a card if you know a card in the enemy hand.
card_unit_1st_recon.flavorText: preparing for a potential Allied invasion. It remained there until Japan surrendered in September 1945.

card_unit_238th_regiment.name: card_unit_238th_regiment
card_unit_238th_regiment.title: 238th REGIMENT
card_unit_238th_regiment.text: Deals double damage if you have 3 or fewer kredit slots.
card_unit_238th_regiment.flavorText: where disease and malnutrition caused further losses before Japan’s surrender in 1945.

card_unit_38th_independent.name: card_unit_38th_independent
card_unit_38th_independent.title: 38th INDEPENDENT
card_unit_38th_independent.text: Cannot attack or move. Suppress it if you have 4+ copies. Duplicate this unit when you lose a kredit slot.
card_unit_38th_independent.flavorText: separated from the main Japanese concentration in the south.

card_unit_78th_yongsan.name: card_unit_78th_yongsan
card_unit_78th_yongsan.title: 78th YONGSAN
card_unit_78th_yongsan.text: Has +1 attack for each kredit slot the enemy has over you.

card_unit_79th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_79th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_79th_infantry_regiment.title: 79th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_79th_infantry_regiment.text: give your units +2 attack and remove pin on them.

card_unit_j2m_raiden.name: card_unit_j2m_raiden
card_unit_j2m_raiden.title: J2M RAIDEN
card_unit_j2m_raiden.text: Gets +1+1 and -1 operation cost when the enemy gives an order.
card_unit_j2m_raiden.flavorText: only hours before Japan announced its surrender.

card_unit_kawanishi_h8k.name: card_unit_kawanishi_h8k
card_unit_kawanishi_h8k.title: KAWANISHI H8K
card_unit_kawanishi_h8k.text:
Draw a card when you Forecast.
Deployment: Forecast.
card_unit_kawanishi_h8k.flavorText: but showed the aircraft’s unusual reach.

card_unit_murase_battalion.name: card_unit_murase_battalion
card_unit_murase_battalion.title: MURASE BATTALION
card_unit_murase_battalion.text: gain 3 additional kredits when you lose a kredit slot.
card_unit_murase_battalion.flavorText: it had largely ceased to exist as an organized unit.

card_unit_yokosuka_e14y.name: card_unit_yokosuka_e14y
card_unit_yokosuka_e14y.title: YOKOSUKA E14Y
card_unit_yokosuka_e14y.text: Deployment: Forecast. Draw a card if you have 0 kredits.
card_unit_yokosuka_e14y.flavorText: but it made the E14Y the only submarine-based aircraft to bomb the US mainland during WWII.

card_event_amphibious_assault_cam1.name: card_event_amphibious_assault_cam1
card_event_amphibious_assault_cam1.title: AMPHIBIOUS ASSAULT
card_event_amphibious_assault_cam1.text: Destroy an enemy unit that has 3 or less attack.

card_event_campaign_philippines2_chase_t.name: card_event_campaign_philippines2_chase_them_down
card_event_campaign_philippines2_chase_t.title: CHASE THEM DOWN
card_event_campaign_philippines2_chase_t.text: Friendly units have +2 attack and Blitz this turn.

card_event_campaign_philippines2_the_hun.name: card_event_campaign_philippines2_the_hunt
card_event_campaign_philippines2_the_hun.title: THE HUNT
card_event_campaign_philippines2_the_hun.text: Destroy target unit in the support line.

card_event_campaign_philippines4_aerial_.name: card_event_campaign_philippines4_aerial_assault
card_event_campaign_philippines4_aerial_.title: AERIAL ASSAULT
card_event_campaign_philippines4_aerial_.text: Deal 2 damage to all units in the frontline.

card_event_campaign_philippines4_infiltr.name: card_event_campaign_philippines4_infiltration
card_event_campaign_philippines4_infiltr.title: INFILTRATION
card_event_campaign_philippines4_infiltr.text: Give target Japanese unit in the frontline +3+3.

card_event_sneak_maneuver_cam1.name: card_event_sneak_maneuver_cam1
card_event_sneak_maneuver_cam1.title: SNEAK MANEUVER
card_event_sneak_maneuver_cam1.text: Give target infantry or tank with 0 operation cost +2 attack.

card_event_target_acquired.name: card_event_target_acquired
card_event_target_acquired.title: TARGET ACQUIRED
card_event_target_acquired.text: Destroy target unit that was attacked this turn.
card_event_target_acquired.flavorText: the Japanese AAA still depended on conventional fuses while the Americans had adopted the proximity fuse which had a far more devastating effect.

card_location_japan_scen1.name: card_location_japan_scen1
card_location_japan_scen1.title: FORMOSA
card_location_japan_scen1.text: The main force attacking the Philippines came from the island of Formosa.

card_event_outflank.title: OUTFLANK
card_event_outflank.flavorText: The Japanese army doctrine was focused on the offensive and to quickly close in on the enemy. The preferred offensive tactics used by the army commanders during WWII was a maneuver called Envelopment which had the primary goal of exploiting the enemies flanks. Usually this maneuver was accompanied with frontal pressure while the main force tried to outflank the enemy. Often a small force would try to attack the enemy rear.

card_unit_61st_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_61st_infantry_regiment
card_unit_61st_infantry_regiment.title: 61st INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_61st_infantry_regiment.flavorText: The 61st Infantry Regiment was a subordinate unit of the 4th Infantry Division of the Imperial Japanese Army. In April 1942 the 4th Division was assigned to the 14th Army and shipped to the Philippines to participate in the Battle of Bataan. The division then played a major part in the Japanese victory in the Battle of Corregidor where units of the 61st Infantry Regiment were the first to land on the island. Despite heavy resistance the regiment managed to secure a beachhead until the reinforcements arrived and managed to drive the enemies away. After the Philippines Campaign of 1941–42 the division was returned home for security duties. The division did not see much combat after that and ended the war in Thailand where it was disbanded after the war.

During these battles the 56th Division suffered heavy losses and was removed from the front line and ended the war on the border between South Burma and Thailand.

Later they took part in an unopposed landings on islands in the East Indies archipelago in 1942 and returned to Japan shortly after. card_unit_sakura_regiment.flavorText: The 57th Regiment Sakura was a regiment of the 1st Division of the Imperial Japanese Army during WWII. The division was sent to the Philippines to participate in the Pacific War in 1944 and was initially based in Manila before being shipped to Leyte to defend against the Filipino and US forces which had reoccupied the island. The 1st Division participated in fierce combat during the Battle of Leyte where it was nearly annihilated. Of the 11,000 soldiers only 800 managed to evacuate to Cebu island where they would participate in the Battle for Cebu City.

card_event_section_ii.flavorText: but had an elaborate network of agents who supplied information to the Allies throughout the war which made a significant difference in the war effort. Members of Section II also developed techniques to decipher the German Enigma enciphered messages that formed the basis of the Enigma decryption that was later developed by the British at  Bletchley Park.

card_event_stretch_the_line.name: card_event_stretch_the_line

card_unit_78th_steel_regiment.name: card_unit_78th_steel_regiment

Finally the division surrendered along with the Warsaw garrison on September 28th.The German forces that faced the 20th Infantry Division at Mława nicknamed it the "Steel Division".

card_unit_pzl_23_karas.flavorText: both because of the lack of fighter support and due to its light armor and low speed. There are no known PZL.23s survivors of the war.

card_unit_sherman_firefly_pl.flavorText: also utilized Sherman tanks during significant battles such as the Battle of Monte Cassino in 1944.

card_unit_spitfire_mk_v_pol.flavorText: most famously by Squadrons No. 303 and No. 302 who had a distinguished combat record and received several battle honours.
