card_event_barrage.name: card_event_barrage
card_event_barrage.title: BARRAGE
card_event_barrage.text: Choose one - enemy units have -4 attack this turn OR deal 2 damage to a ground unit.
card_event_barrage.flavorText: the Red Army fired at the enemy along a front of almost 30 km.

card_event_comrades.name: card_event_comrades
card_event_comrades.title: JUGGERNAUT
card_event_comrades.text: Give a friendly tank or infantry +2+1. It must attack each turn or it is destroyed.
card_event_comrades.flavorText: which at its peak had 12,500,000 enlisted men and women. The next in line was the US army with 12,364,000 enlisted personnel.

card_event_counter_offensive.name: card_event_counter_offensive
card_event_counter_offensive.title: COUNTER OFFENSIVE
card_event_counter_offensive.text: Target infantry or tank gets +2+1 for each damaged unit on the battlefield.
card_event_counter_offensive.flavorText: the 3rd and 4th Romanian armies and portions of the German Fourth Panzer Army. This counter offensive turned the tide on the Eastern Front and after it the Axis forces were fighting a defensive war on all fronts.

card_event_men_of_steel.name: card_event_men_of_steel
card_event_men_of_steel.title: MEN OF STEEL
card_event_men_of_steel.text: Choose one - your units get +1 Heavy Armor OR add a THE HAMMER to your hand.
card_event_men_of_steel.flavorText: it was decided to mass produce them in such a high quantity that they could be replaced whenever needed. The only change made in the T-34 production line was conducted in order to make the manufacturing easier and cheaper. The initial cost of producing a T-34 tank went from 269,500 rubles in 1941 to 135,000 rubles in 1943.

card_event_mobile_defense.name: card_event_mobile_defense
card_event_mobile_defense.title: MOBILE DEFENSE
card_event_mobile_defense.text: Add two T-70 units to your support line. Destroy them at the end of your next turn.
card_event_mobile_defense.flavorText: Mobile defense is a military manoeuvre where the defender drives back attacks by using well planned counter attacks. These tactics are usually applied when the defender wants to avoid a pitched battle where a static defensive system would not suffice to halt an advancing enemy.

card_event_mud.name: card_event_mud
card_event_mud.title: MUD
card_event_mud.text: Enemy ground units cannot attack next turn.
card_event_mud.flavorText: either due to autumn rain or melting ice and snow during spring time. During WWII the Rasputitsa provided a great defensive advantage for the Red Army. Common nicknames for the Rasputitsa seasons are “Marshal Mud” or “General Mud”.

card_event_night_witches.name: card_event_night_witches
card_event_night_witches.title: NIGHT WITCHES
card_event_night_witches.text: Add three POLIKARPOV PO-2-II to your hand.
card_event_night_witches.flavorText: each pilot often had to fly eight or more missions per night. The regiment was raised to guards status in 1943 and became known as the 46th "Taman" Guards Night Bomber Aviation Regiment.

card_event_no_retreat.name: card_event_no_retreat
card_event_no_retreat.title: NO RETREAT
card_event_no_retreat.text: Target unit gets: "Cannot Retreat or be Suppressed."
card_event_no_retreat.flavorText: while others were either shot or received various other types of punishment.

card_event_parade.name: card_event_parade
card_event_parade.title: PARADE
card_event_parade.text: Draw a random unit from your deck. Duplicate it.
card_event_parade.flavorText: During and shortly after WWII there were two memorable parades held on the Red Square in Moscow: The 1941 October Revolution Parade was held in honor of the October Revolution 24 years earlier and took place during the Battle of Moscow. The second one is the Moscow Victory Parade of 1945 which was dedicated to the Soviet and Allied victory against Nazi Germany and is the largest military parade ever held on Red Square.

card_event_veteran_pilots.name: card_event_veteran_pilots
card_event_veteran_pilots.title: VETERAN PILOTS
card_event_veteran_pilots.text: Choose One - Give a Soviet air unit +1+2 OR immune this turn.
card_event_veteran_pilots.flavorText: but they did outperform the Allied nations. The top Soviet fighter ace scored 66 victories during WWII while the top British and American aces scored 40 each.

card_unit_10th_guards_regiment.name: card_unit_10th_guards_regiment
card_unit_10th_guards_regiment.title: 10th GUARDS REGIMENT
card_unit_10th_guards_regiment.flavorText: but reformed in 1942 and sent to fight in the Battle of Stalingrad. The division was designated the 74th Guards Rifle Division in 1943 and participated in several battles and operations before it was disbanded in 1946.

card_unit_1271st_rifles.name: card_unit_1271st_rifles
card_unit_1271st_rifles.title: 1271st RIFLES
card_unit_1271st_rifles.text: Deployment: Add RESERVES to your hand.
card_unit_1271st_rifles.flavorText: but rejoined the 2nd Guards Army in 1944 for the Crimean Offensive. Lastly the division was assigned to the 2nd Ukrainian Front and spent the last weeks of the war in Austria and Hungary. The 387th Rifle Division served for an additional three years into the postwar period and was disbanded in 1947.

card_unit_34th_guards.name: card_unit_34th_guards
card_unit_34th_guards.title: 34th GUARDS
card_unit_34th_guards.text: this unit costs 2 less each time your HQ takes friendly damage.
card_unit_34th_guards.flavorText: Operation Bagration and the Battle for Berlin. The division earned several honors and decorations for their outstanding service during WWII.

card_unit_6th_motor_rifles.name: card_unit_6th_motor_rifles
card_unit_6th_motor_rifles.title: 15th MOTOR RIFLES
card_unit_6th_motor_rifles.text: Your HQ is immune to damage on enemy turns.
card_unit_6th_motor_rifles.flavorText: or until July 1944 when the whole army was moved to the 1st Baltic Front. The division fought in the Battle of Memel in 1944 before it was transferred to the 3rd Belorussian Front to participate in the East Prussian offensive. When the war ended the 2nd Guards Motor Rifle Division was located in the Baltic Sea coast north of Primorsk.

card_unit_83rd_naval_brigade.name: card_unit_83rd_naval_brigade
card_unit_83rd_naval_brigade.title: 83rd NAVAL BRIGADE
card_unit_83rd_naval_brigade.text: Deployment: Destroy an enemy unit that is damaged.
card_unit_83rd_naval_brigade.flavorText: before being transferred to the 3rd Ukrainian Front where they participated in the offensives into Romania and Hungary. Their last amphibious landing was done in 1945 where they made an assault across the Danube River in Budapest and helped clear the city of Axis resistance. When the war ended the brigade was attached to the 5th Guards Tank Army in the Czechoslovakian capital of Prague.

card_unit_845th_rifles.name: card_unit_845th_rifles
card_unit_845th_rifles.title: 845th RIFLES
card_unit_845th_rifles.text: your HQ gets equal amount of defense.
card_unit_845th_rifles.flavorText: such as the Siege of Budapest and finally the Prague Offensive. The division was disbanded in the summer of 1946.

card_unit_kv_ii.name: card_unit_kv_ii
card_unit_kv_ii.title: KV-2
card_unit_kv_ii.text: Order damage to a friendly unit is reduced by its Heavy Armor.
card_unit_kv_ii.flavorText: but due to its heavy weight and slow speed it was considered ineffective in combat and only 334 tanks were produced. The KV-2 had a crew of 6 and a secondary armament of 2× DT machine guns.

card_unit_mig_3.name: card_unit_mig_3
card_unit_mig_3.title: MIG 3
card_unit_mig_3.text: this unit costs 2 less each time an enemy countermeasure triggers.
card_unit_mig_3.flavorText: but it was not suited for this role and before the end of WWII the aircraft was withdrawn from service. By that time 3,422 aircraft had been built and 1,432 of them had been shot down.

card_unit_polikarpov_po_2.name: card_unit_polikarpov_po_2
card_unit_polikarpov_po_2.title: POLIKARPOV PO-2
card_unit_polikarpov_po_2.flavorText: which earned it its nickname Kukuruznik (Russian for "crop duster"). German troops nicknamed it Nähmaschine (German for “sewing machine”) because of its rattling sound.

card_unit_polikarpov_po_2_ii.name: card_unit_polikarpov_po_2_ii
card_unit_polikarpov_po_2_ii.title: POLIKARPOV PO-2-II
card_unit_polikarpov_po_2_ii.text: Destruction: Add a FROM THE PEOPLE to your hand.

card_unit_p_40b_tomahawk.name: card_unit_p_40b_tomahawk
card_unit_p_40b_tomahawk.title: P-40B TOMAHAWK
card_unit_p_40b_tomahawk.text: Infantry units you deploy or add get +1+1.
card_unit_p_40b_tomahawk.flavorText: but after that many of them were replaced with the Soviet Lavochkin La-5 and Yakovlev fighters.

card_unit_su_85.name: card_unit_su_85
card_unit_su_85.title: SU-85
card_unit_su_85.text: Your HQ gains +3 defense when you attack with a Soviet tank.
card_unit_su_85.flavorText: and later the Panther tank. 2,050 SU-85s were manufactured from 1943 to 1944.

card_unit_t_70eot.name: card_unit_t_70eot
card_unit_t_70eot.title: T-70
card_unit_t_70eot.text: Destroyed at the end of the second turn on the battlefield.
card_unit_t_70eot.flavorText: a main armament of a 45 mm Model 1932/38 20-K gun and a secondary armament of 7.62 mm DT coaxial machine gun. It was produced from 1942 to 1943 and 8,226 units were built.

card_unit_t_80.name: card_unit_t_80
card_unit_t_80.title: T-80
card_unit_t_80.text: Destruction: Deal 1 damage to your HQ.
card_unit_t_80.flavorText: so only a very small number was produced. The T-80 had a main armament of a 45 mm 20-K cannon and a secondary armament of a single 7.62 mm DT machine gun.

card_event_arctic_convoy.name: card_event_arctic_convoy
card_event_arctic_convoy.title: ARCTIC CONVOY
card_event_arctic_convoy.text: Draw two random units from your deck.
card_event_arctic_convoy.flavorText: and North America to northern ports in the Soviet Union – primarily Arkhangelsk (Archangel) and Murmansk in Russia.

card_event_assault.name: card_event_assault
card_event_assault.title: FRONTAL ASSAULT
card_event_assault.flavorText: same as in all armies fighting in WWII.

card_event_bloody_sickle.name: card_event_bloody_sickle
card_event_bloody_sickle.title: BLOODY SICKLE
card_event_bloody_sickle.text: Deal 1 damage to a unit and your HQ. Draw a card.
card_event_bloody_sickle.flavorText: the coat of arms of the Soviet Union and Communist symbol represented the proletarian struggle.

card_event_blood_red_sky.name: card_event_blood_red_sky
card_event_blood_red_sky.title: BLOOD RED SKY
card_event_blood_red_sky.text: Give all friendly Soviet air units +2+2.
card_event_blood_red_sky.flavorText: with a modernized air force and better trained pilots that became an equal match to the Germans.

card_event_burning_sky.name: card_event_burning_sky
card_event_burning_sky.title: BURNING SKY
card_event_burning_sky.text: Deal 4 damage to an enemy air unit.
card_event_burning_sky.flavorText: and 92 soldiers were awarded the title of Hero of the Soviet Union and one was twice given the honor.

card_event_close_combat.name: card_event_close_combat
card_event_close_combat.title: CLOSE COMBAT
card_event_close_combat.text: Friendly infantry units have +3 attack until end of turn.
card_event_close_combat.flavorText: by which under-armed Soviet soldiers kept the German army so close to them as to minimize the superior firepower enjoyed by the Wehrmacht.

card_event_critical_hit.name: card_event_critical_hit
card_event_critical_hit.title: CRITICAL HIT
card_event_critical_hit.flavorText: being stabbed through the mouth by a Red Army bayonet.

card_event_final_push.name: card_event_final_push
card_event_final_push.title: FINAL PUSH
card_event_final_push.text: Give a friendly unit +3 attack. Destroy it at the end of your turn.
card_event_final_push.flavorText: and it was followed by the unconditional surrender of the German forces. The Battle for Berlin marks the end of WWII in Europe.

card_event_from_the_people.name: card_event_from_the_people
card_event_from_the_people.title: FROM THE PEOPLE
card_event_from_the_people.flavorText: all the evidence points to the fact that workers willingly endured these hardships for the sake of the motherland and for the struggle against the German occupation.

card_event_mass_attack.name: card_event_mass_attack
card_event_mass_attack.title: MASS ATTACK
card_event_mass_attack.text: Deal damage to target equal to number of units you control.
card_event_mass_attack.flavorText: which ended with the unconditional surrender of Germany in Berlin.

card_event_mother_russia.name: card_event_mother_russia
card_event_mother_russia.title: MOTHER RUSSIA
card_event_mother_russia.text: Add to hand a copy of each friendly Soviet unit destroyed so far this turn.
card_event_mother_russia.flavorText: which symbolized the vast homeland which needed protection from the invading forces.

card_event_no_surrender.name: card_event_no_surrender
card_event_no_surrender.title: NO SURRENDER
card_event_no_surrender.text: Add LIGHT INFANTRY to your support line until it is full. Give them Blitz.
card_event_no_surrender.flavorText: which became a slogan of the Soviet resistance against the Nazi invasion.

card_event_order_no_227.name: card_event_order_no_227
card_event_order_no_227.title: ORDER 227
card_event_order_no_227.text: Give your damaged Soviet units +2 attack and fully repair them.
card_event_order_no_227.flavorText: which became a slogan of the Soviet resistance against the Nazi invasion.

card_event_patriotic_firestorm.name: card_event_patriotic_firestorm
card_event_patriotic_firestorm.title: PATRIOTIC FIRESTORM
card_event_patriotic_firestorm.text: Your support line units have + 2 attack until end of turn.
card_event_patriotic_firestorm.flavorText: a term used in Russia and many other former republics of the Soviet Union to describe the conflict between the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany and its Allies during WWII.

card_event_patriotic_war.name: card_event_patriotic_war
card_event_patriotic_war.title: GREAT PATRIOTIC WAR
card_event_patriotic_war.text: Set the defense of each HQ to 12.
card_event_patriotic_war.flavorText: 1945. The Great Patriotic War is commemorated on May 9th each year.

card_event_red_banner.name: card_event_red_banner
card_event_red_banner.title: RED BANNER
card_event_red_banner.text: Destroy a friendly unit. Add a random unit from same nation that costs 2 more.
card_event_red_banner.flavorText: the Siege of Stalingrad and the Battle of Kursk) had no parallel on the Western Front.

card_event_red_october.name: card_event_red_october
card_event_red_october.title: RED OCTOBER
card_event_red_october.text: Give a Soviet tank or infantry +3+3.
card_event_red_october.flavorText: The October revolution is the revolution of 1917 in Russia which was led by the by the Bolshevik Party of Vladimir Lenin. It ended with the overthrow of the provisional government led by Kerensky and the formation of the Soviet Union.

card_event_reserves.name: card_event_reserves
card_event_reserves.title: RESERVES
card_event_reserves.text: plus one for each previously played RESERVES.
card_event_reserves.flavorText: but by then they had 10.3 million men and women in active service against the Axis forces which counted a total 3.93 million men.

card_event_scorched_earth.name: card_event_scorched_earth
card_event_scorched_earth.title: SCORCHED EARTH
card_event_scorched_earth.text: Set the operation cost of all units on the battlefield to 4.
card_event_scorched_earth.flavorText: A scorched-earth policy is a military strategy with the aim of destroying anything that may be useful to an advancing or retreating enemy. The fallback is that it often affects both friends and foe.

card_event_siberian_transfer.name: card_event_siberian_transfer
card_event_siberian_transfer.title: SIBERIAN TRANSFER
card_event_siberian_transfer.text: Add a T-34 1942 unit to the support line. Destroy it at end of turn.
card_event_siberian_transfer.flavorText: At the start of the war there were a large numbers of veteran Siberian divisions defending the eastern Soviet borders against a possible attack from the Japanese . After Stalin realized that the Japanese had no intention of attacking he ordered these divisions to be transferred to the front near Moscow in the winter of 1941 and were encountered all along the front protecting the city.

card_event_tamanskya.name: card_event_tamanskya
card_event_tamanskya.title: TAMANSKAYA!
card_event_tamanskya.text: Fully repair all friendly ground units.
card_event_tamanskya.flavorText: an elite division which was named Tamanskaya in honor of the Bolshevik revolutionary and Soviet politician Mikhail Kalinin and the town of Taman.

card_event_the_hammer.name: card_event_the_hammer
card_event_the_hammer.title: THE HAMMER
card_event_the_hammer.text: Deal 6 damage to a ground unit.
card_event_the_hammer.flavorText: what is being referred to here is the hammer (and sickle) in the coat of arms of the Soviet Union and Communist symbol for proletarian struggle.

card_event_ural_factories.name: card_event_ural_factories
card_event_ural_factories.title: URAL FACTORIES
card_event_ural_factories.text: Destroy a friendly unit. Add a random unit from same nation that costs 1 more.
card_event_ural_factories.flavorText: and this helped them eventually surpass the Germans in arms production.

card_event_war_production.name: card_event_war_production
card_event_war_production.title: WAR PRODUCTION
card_event_war_production.text: Gain 2 additional kredits this turn. Discard all non-unit cards.
card_event_war_production.flavorText: as well as 25 destroyers and 52 submarines.

card_event_winter_war.name: card_event_winter_war
card_event_winter_war.title: WINTER WARFARE
card_event_winter_war.flavorText: compared to attacking in winter cold.

card_event_workers_unite.name: card_event_workers_unite
card_event_workers_unite.title: WORKERS UNITE!
card_event_workers_unite.text: Discard your LIGHT INFANTRY units. Gain a kredit and draw a card for each.
card_event_workers_unite.flavorText: The essence of this slogan is that members of the working classes throughout the world should cooperate to achieve victory in WWII and overcome the class conflict.

card_event_zhukov.name: card_event_zhukov
card_event_zhukov.title: ZHUKOV
card_event_zhukov.text: Draw a random Soviet infantry. It gets +1+1 and Blitz when deployed.
card_event_zhukov.flavorText: but in the end he was a winning general and it is claimed that he never lost a battle.

card_unit_11th_signal_battalion.name: card_unit_11th_signal_battalion
card_unit_11th_signal_battalion.title: 329th ENGINEER BATTALION
card_unit_11th_signal_battalion.flavorText: together with soldiers from the Motorized ­Rifle Division.

card_unit_13th_rifle_regiment.name: card_unit_13th_rifle_regiment
card_unit_13th_rifle_regiment.title: 13th RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_13th_rifle_regiment.text: Destruction: Add a random Soviet infantry to your hand.
card_unit_13th_rifle_regiment.flavorText: and was decorated with the Honorary Revolutionary Red Banner (1st Formation) and the Order of Kutuzov (3rd Formation).

card_unit_16th_rifles.name: card_unit_16th_rifles
card_unit_16th_rifles.title: 16th RIFLES
card_unit_16th_rifles.text: At the start of your turn gain +1+1.
card_unit_16th_rifles.flavorText: the Battle of Berlin and the Battle of Halbe.

card_unit_2nd_motor.name: card_unit_2nd_motor
card_unit_2nd_motor.title: 2nd RIFLES
card_unit_2nd_motor.text: Has +2 attack against units with Blitz.

card_unit_321st_rifles.name: card_unit_321st_rifles
card_unit_321st_rifles.title: 321st RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_321st_rifles.text: Destruction: Add a 1/1 LIGHT INFANTRY to the support line.
card_unit_321st_rifles.flavorText: and the Battle of Berlin in 1945.

card_unit_35th_rifles.name: card_unit_35th_rifles
card_unit_35th_rifles.title: 35th RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_35th_rifles.text: Deploys for 0 kredits if a friendly unit was destroyed this turn.
card_unit_35th_rifles.flavorText: and by 1945 it was with the 38th Army of the 4th Ukrainian Front.

card_unit_3rd_guards.name: card_unit_3rd_guards
card_unit_3rd_guards.title: 3rd GUARDS REGIMENT
card_unit_3rd_guards.flavorText: the Budapest Offensive and the Vienna Offensive.

card_unit_42nd_rifles.name: card_unit_42nd_rifles
card_unit_42nd_rifles.title: 42nd RIFLES
card_unit_42nd_rifles.flavorText: the Jassy-Kishinev Offensive and the Siege of Budapest.

card_unit_45mm_anti_tank_gun.name: card_unit_45mm_anti_tank_gun
card_unit_45mm_anti_tank_gun.title: 45 mm ANTI-TANK GUN
card_unit_45mm_anti_tank_gun.flavorText: but replaced in 1942 by the long-barreled 45 mm anti-tank gun M1942 (M-42).

card_unit_554th_rifles.name: card_unit_554th_rifles
card_unit_554th_rifles.title: 554th RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_554th_rifles.flavorText: the Order of the Red Banner and the Order of Suvorov. The 138th Division was disbanded after the war in 1945.

card_unit_6th_airborne.name: card_unit_6th_airborne
card_unit_6th_airborne.title: 6th AIRBORNE
card_unit_6th_airborne.text: Deployment: Add a T-34 1942 to your support line. Destroy it at end of turn.
card_unit_6th_airborne.flavorText: the Siege of Budapest and the Prague Offensive. In August 1945 it was sent east and fought in the Soviet invasion of Manchuria.

card_unit_6th_naval_brigade.name: card_unit_6th_naval_brigade
card_unit_6th_naval_brigade.title: 6th NAVAL BRIGADE
card_unit_6th_naval_brigade.flavorText: but mostly they served as regular infantry. The 6th Naval Brigade served under the 138th Rifle Division from 1943 and participated in various battles and campaigns on the Eastern Front.

card_unit_756th_regiment.name: card_unit_756th_regiment
card_unit_756th_regiment.title: 756th REGIMENT
card_unit_756th_regiment.text: deal excess damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_756th_regiment.flavorText: always distinguishing itself and was regarded as an elite force. It was given the honorific title of “Idritskaya” in July 1944 for its heroic battle in the town of Idritsa. But it most famous moment was being the unit that raised the Soviet banner on the roof of the Reichstag in Berlin in April 1945.

card_unit_76mm_howitzer_1939.name: card_unit_76mm_howitzer_1939
card_unit_76mm_howitzer_1939.title: 76 mm HOWITZER 1939
card_unit_76mm_howitzer_1939.flavorText: and it was used extensively throughout the war.

card_unit_84th_infantry.name: card_unit_84th_infantry
card_unit_84th_infantry.title: 84th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_84th_infantry.flavorText: the Soviet invasion of Manchuria. The division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner twice and the Order of Suvorov 2nd Class for its valor in combat.

card_unit_85mm_d44.name: card_unit_85mm_d44
card_unit_85mm_d44.title: 85mm D-44 FIELD GUN
card_unit_85mm_d44.text: Units damaged by 85mm D-44 FIELD GUN and their adjacent units get pinned.
card_unit_85mm_d44.flavorText: The 85-mm divisional D-44 field gun was a Soviet artillery gun used during the late phases of WWII. It was designed to replace the 76 mm divisional gun M1942 (ZiS-3) and was produced from 1944 to 1953. It could fire up to 20 rounds per minute and had a maximum firing range of 15.65 km.

card_unit_89th_infantry.name: card_unit_89th_infantry
card_unit_89th_infantry.title: 89th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_89th_infantry.flavorText: and the Order of Kutuzov 2nd Class for its actions.

card_unit_93rd_guards.name: card_unit_93rd_guards
card_unit_93rd_guards.title: 1st RIFLES
card_unit_93rd_guards.text: Destruction: Add a 2nd RIFLES to your support line.
card_unit_93rd_guards.flavorText: and again in the Second Battle of Kharkov. The division was reorganized in 1942 and sent to fight in Stalingrad and from there it was transferred to the Don Front. In April 1943 the division was raised to Guards status and became the 88th Guards Rifle Division. During the final stages of the war the division fought with the 46th Army of the 2nd Ukrainian Front and by the end of the war it was disbanded.

card_unit_95th_rifles.name: card_unit_95th_rifles
card_unit_95th_rifles.title: 95th RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_95th_rifles.text: Deployment: Deal 1 damage to a unit and your HQ.
card_unit_95th_rifles.flavorText: and later it took part in the Petsamo-Kirkenes Offensive in 1944 where the Red Army defeated the Wehrmacht's forces in the Arctic of Northern Finland and Norway. In December 1944 the division was transformed into the 101st Guards Rifle Division.

card_unit_a20_soviet.name: card_unit_a20_soviet
card_unit_a20_soviet.title: A-20B
card_unit_a20_soviet.text: Costs 1 less for each US unit you control.
card_unit_a20_soviet.flavorText: making it the most numerous foreign bomber in their inventory. The Soviets considered it a powerful and reliable aircraft that could be flown even by crews with minimal training.

card_unit_armored_train.name: card_unit_armored_train
card_unit_armored_train.title: BP-43 ARMORED TRAIN
card_unit_armored_train.text: add a LIGHT INFANTRY to the same front.
card_unit_armored_train.flavorText: and had a crew of over 100 men. Around 21 BP-43 armored trains were created during WWII.

card_unit_b4_203mm_howitzer.name: card_unit_b4_203mm_howitzer
card_unit_b4_203mm_howitzer.title: B-4 203mm HOWITZER
card_unit_b4_203mm_howitzer.text: Units damaged by this unit get -3 attack until end of turn.
card_unit_b4_203mm_howitzer.flavorText: The B-4 203 mm howitzer M1931 was a heavy howitzer used by the Soviet Red Army during WWII. These guns were nicknamed "Stalin's sledgehammer" by German soldiers and were mainly used against heavy enemy fortifications and in urban combat for crushing protected buildings and bunkers. The 203mm howitzer was produced from 1932 to the 1940s and 871 units were built.

card_unit_bt_7.name: card_unit_bt_7
card_unit_bt_7.title: BT-7
card_unit_bt_7.flavorText: The BT 7 was a light tank and was produced between 1935 and 1940. It was nicknamed “Betka and/or Betushka” and was the last one of the BT series of Soviet cavalry tanks. In 1940 the BT 7 was more or less replaced by the T-34 medium tank.

card_unit_cossack_cavalry.name: card_unit_cossack_cavalry
card_unit_cossack_cavalry.title: 4th KUBAN COSSACKS
card_unit_cossack_cavalry.flavorText: most of them fought for the Soviet Union. They led attacks during the Battle of Stalingrad and were able to keep the Germans from entering the Caucasus. The 4th Kuban Cossack Regiment was attached to the 4th Guards Kuban Cossack Corp and took part in heavy fighting against the German invading forces throughout the war. The regiment fought in Stalingrad and took part in the liberation of Southern Ukraine and Romania and became famous for their bravery. Their heroism was commemorated in 1945 when they were allowed to march in Red Square during the famous Victory Day Parade.

card_unit_isu_152.name: card_unit_isu_152
card_unit_isu_152.title: ISU-152
card_unit_isu_152.text: Deployment: Destroy all other damaged units.
card_unit_isu_152.flavorText: a main armament of 152.4 mm ML-20S gun-howitzer and a secondary armament of 12.7 x 108 mm DShK anti-aircraft machine gun.

card_unit_is_i.name: card_unit_is_i
card_unit_is_i.title: IOSEF STALIN II
card_unit_is_i.text: add a copy to your support line.
card_unit_is_i.flavorText: a main armament of a D25-T 122 mm gun and secondary armament of 1x DShK and 3x DT machine guns.

card_unit_i_15_chaika.name: card_unit_i_15_chaika
card_unit_i_15_chaika.title: I-15 CHAIKA
card_unit_i_15_chaika.text: Destruction: Add a I-16 ISHAK fighter to the support line.
card_unit_i_15_chaika.flavorText: but was still in use at the start of WWII and used in ground attacks by the Soviet Air Force. In late 1942 the I-15 were pulled from frontline service and used for second-line duties.

card_unit_i_16_ishak.name: card_unit_i_16_ishak
card_unit_i_16_ishak.title: I-16 ISHAK
card_unit_i_16_ishak.flavorText: the I-16 fighter was used by the Soviets until the end of the war. The pilots nicknamed it "Ishak" (meaning donkey or burro in Russian) because it was similar to the Russian pronunciation of "I-16".

card_unit_katyusha.name: card_unit_katyusha
card_unit_katyusha.title: KATYUSHA
card_unit_katyusha.flavorText: and due to the howling sound of the rocket motors when it launched.

card_unit_kv_1.name: card_unit_kv_1
card_unit_kv_1.title: KV-1 1939
card_unit_kv_1.flavorText: The KV-1 was a Soviet Kliment Voroshilov (KV) heavy tank variant used by the Red Army during WWII. The KV series were known for their heavy armor and were almost immune to the guns of the early Panzer III and Panzer IV tanks that were used by the Axis at the start of the war. The KV-1 had a crew of 5 and a main armament of a 76.2 mm M1941 ZiS-5 gun and a secondary armament of 3x to 4x DT machine guns. It was produced from 1939 to 1945 and 5,219 units were built.

card_unit_kv_1_1941.name: card_unit_kv_1_1941
card_unit_kv_1_1941.title: KV-1 1941
card_unit_kv_1_1941.text: deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.
card_unit_kv_1_1941.flavorText: hull front and sides. The turret was cast instead of welded and it was armed with a longer-barreled ZiS-5 tank gun. 1,121 units were produced of the 1941 series.

card_unit_la_3.name: card_unit_la_3
card_unit_la_3.title: LA-5
card_unit_la_3.flavorText: but no intact aircraft exists today.

card_unit_light_anti_air_battery.name: card_unit_light_anti_air_battery
card_unit_light_anti_air_battery.title: 37 mm ANTI-AIRCRAFT GUN
card_unit_light_anti_air_battery.text: Enemy air units cost +2 to operate.
card_unit_light_anti_air_battery.flavorText: but it was also effective against ground targets. It is believed that crews of the 37 mm anti-aircraft gun shot down 14,657 Axis planes.

card_unit_petlyakov_pe_2.name: card_unit_petlyakov_pe_2
card_unit_petlyakov_pe_2.title: PETLYAKOV PE-2
card_unit_petlyakov_pe_2.flavorText: both against the Axis in Europe and against Japanese forces in Manchuria. In total 11,427 Pe-2 aircraft were built in WWII.

card_unit_sturmovik.name: card_unit_sturmovik
card_unit_sturmovik.title: SHTURMOVIK Il-2M
card_unit_sturmovik.text: deal excess damage to the enemy HQ.

card_unit_su_152.name: card_unit_su_152
card_unit_su_152.title: SU 152
card_unit_su_152.text: Deployment: Your other tanks get +1 attack and +1 Heavy Armor.

card_unit_su_76.name: card_unit_su_76
card_unit_su_76.title: SU-76M
card_unit_su_76.text: Deployment: Deal 2 damage to your HQ.
card_unit_su_76.flavorText: Ferdinand being a reference to the German Heavy Ferdinand/Elefant Tank Destroyer.

card_unit_t_34.name: card_unit_t_34
card_unit_t_34.title: T-34 1942
card_unit_t_34.flavorText: a main armament of 76.2 mm F-34 tank gun (later 85 mm ZiS-S-53 gun) and a secondary armament of 2 × 7.62 mm DT machine guns.

card_unit_t_34eot.name: card_unit_t_34eot
card_unit_t_34eot.title: T-34 1942
card_unit_t_34eot.flavorText: a main armament of 76.2 mm F-34 tank gun (later 85 mm ZiS-S-53 gun) and a secondary armament of 2 × 7.62 mm DT machine guns.

card_unit_t_34_85.name: card_unit_t_34_85
card_unit_t_34_85.title: T-34-85
card_unit_t_34_85.flavorText: but at the start of Operation Bagration the T-34-85's formed the bulk of Soviet tank units. By the end of the war 23,213 units had been manufactured.

card_unit_t_34_flame.name: card_unit_t_34_flame
card_unit_t_34_flame.title: OT-34
card_unit_t_34_flame.text: Deals double damage against infantry and HQ.
card_unit_t_34_flame.flavorText: was fitted with an internally mounted flamethrower replacing the hull machine-gun. Usually it was a modified Model 1941 with the ATO-41 flamethrower or Model 1942 with ATO-42. During WWII 1172 OT-34 tanks were produced.

card_unit_t_70.name: card_unit_t_70
card_unit_t_70.title: T-70
card_unit_t_70.flavorText: a main armament of a 45 mm Model 1932/38 20-K gun and a secondary armament of 7.62 mm DT coaxial machine gun. It was produced from 1942 to 1943 and 8,226 units were built.

card_unit_yak_3.name: card_unit_yak_3

card_unit_128th_rifles.name: card_unit_128th_rifles
card_unit_128th_rifles.title: 128th RIFLES
card_unit_128th_rifles.flavorText: The 128th Rifle Regiment was part of the 29th Rifle Division of the Red Army which was formed in 1920 during the Russian Civil War. In 1939 the division participated in the Soviet invasion of Poland and in  1941 it defended against the German invasion of Soviet Union in Operation Barbarossa. After being destroyed and reformed two times the division was ordered to Stalingrad where it joined the 64th Army in the defense of the city. After the Soviet victory at Stalingrad the division was redesignated the 72nd Guards Rifle Division for its distinguished service during the battle and the 128th Rifles Regiment became the 224th Guards Rifle Regiment. For the remainder of the war the division fought in several battles on the Eastern Front and lastly it participated in the Budapest Offensive where it ended the war in a captured area around the Slovakian city of Bruty near the Hungarian border. The division is still active today but was transferred to Ukraine after the fall of Soviet Union and is now known as the 72nd Mechanized Brigade of the Ukrainian Army.

card_unit_61st_kirkenes.title: 61st KIRKENES
card_unit_61st_kirkenes.flavorText: guarding the soviet northern frontier. The division’s operations demonstrated the Red Army’s ability to wage high-tempo offensives even in harsh and remote environments.

card_unit_77th_guards.title: 77th GUARDS

card_unit_iosef_stalin_ii_1944.title: IS II 1944 EARLY

card_unit_kv_1s.name: card_unit_kv_1s
card_unit_kv_1s.title: KV-1S
card_unit_kv_1s.text: Your other units have +1 attack for each of their combat keywords.
card_unit_kv_1s.flavorText: it saw service on multiple fronts through 1943 and into early 1944. Production of the KV-1S ended after 1,370 units were built. It marked the final major revision of the KV-1 before the Red Army shifted focus to more advanced designs like the IS-2.

card_unit_tupolev_tb_3.name: card_unit_tupolev_tb_3
card_unit_tupolev_tb_3.title: TUPOLEV TB-3
card_unit_tupolev_tb_3.text: Deployment: Add I-16 ISHAK on both sides of this unit.
card_unit_tupolev_tb_3.flavorText: a few TB-3s remained in use for transport duties even after the war ended.

card_event_deep_operation.title: DEEP OPERATION
card_event_deep_operation.text: then give all such units in hand Blitz.
card_event_deep_operation.flavorText: deep operation was used with a devastating effect.

card_event_five_year_plan.name: card_event_five_year_plan
card_event_five_year_plan.title: FIVE YEAR PLAN

card_event_five_year_plan.flavorText: but many other socialistic states would later follow in their footsteps.

card_event_partisans.name: card_event_partisans
card_event_partisans.title: PARTISANS
card_event_partisans.flavorText: and to provide intelligence about German military and economic activities in the occupied territories. The Soviet Partisans movement grew from 90,000 men and women in 1941 to 550,000 in 1943 and managed to make a significant contribution to the Allied victory on the Eastern Front.

card_event_promotion.name: card_event_promotion
card_event_promotion.title: PROMOTION
card_event_promotion.text: Draw a random unit from your deck. It gets +2+2 when it is deployed.
card_event_promotion.flavorText: which included men that had risen from the ranks or were drawn from civil life.

card_event_red_dawn.name: card_event_red_dawn
card_event_red_dawn.title: RED DAWN
card_event_red_dawn.text: Choose one - Deal 3 damage to a unit and your HQ OR add FROM THE PEOPLE to hand.
card_event_red_dawn.flavorText: first emerged during the Russian Revolution and the red color symbolizes the workers that have died in their struggle against Capitalism.

card_event_refit.name: card_event_refit
card_event_refit.title: UPGRADE
card_event_refit.text: Destroy a friendly tank. Add a tank from the same nation that costs 3 more.
card_event_refit.flavorText: some were considered obsolete and withdrawn from service.

card_event_road_to_berlin.name: card_event_road_to_berlin
card_event_road_to_berlin.title: ROAD TO BERLIN
card_event_road_to_berlin.flavorText: and 1410 days later the tables had turned.

card_unit_125_rifle_regiment.name: card_unit_125_rifle_regiment

card_unit_175th_motorized.name: card_unit_175th_motorized

card_unit_175th_motorized.flavorText: the division took part in storming and liberating the town of Baltiysk from German occupation.

card_unit_214th_amur.name: card_unit_214th_amur
card_unit_214th_amur.title: 214th AMUR
card_unit_214th_amur.text: Your T-34 units have +1 Heavy Armor and operate for 1 less.
card_unit_214th_amur.flavorText: The 214th Amur Order of the Red Star Rifle Regiment was a unit of the 12th Rifle Division of the Red Army. The division was formed twice and its first formation was active from 1918-1921 and fought in the Russian Civil War and the Polish-Soviet War. The division was formed again in 1923 and was stationed at Omsk in Siberia where it spent WWII. In 1945 the division participated in the Soviet invasion of Manchuria and was involved in capturing several Chinese cities as well as defeating the Japanese Kwantung Army. In 1945 the division was given the honorific “Amur” for its services.

card_unit_272nd_guards.name: card_unit_272nd_guards
card_unit_272nd_guards.title: 272nd GUARDS
card_unit_272nd_guards.text: Destruction: Add a IOSEF STALIN II to your support line.
card_unit_272nd_guards.flavorText: the Baltic Offensive and finally the East Prussian Offensive. In recognition for its service during the war the division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner.

card_unit_2nd_marines_battalion.name: card_unit_2nd_marines_battalion
card_unit_2nd_marines_battalion.title: 2nd MARINES BATTALION
card_unit_2nd_marines_battalion.text: Combat damage dealt to this unit is doubled.
card_unit_2nd_marines_battalion.flavorText: but it came at a very high cost. Of the 700 marines participating in the battle almost all lost their lives. The few remaining survivors along with 3000 civilians were taken prisoner by the Germans and executed.

card_unit_461st_rifles.name: card_unit_461st_rifles
card_unit_461st_rifles.title: 461st RIFLES
card_unit_461st_rifles.text: your HQ gets equal amount of defense.
card_unit_461st_rifles.flavorText: where they managed to capture the town of Graudenz in northern Poland. The division finished the war on the Baltic coast where it was disbanded in the summer of 1945.

card_location_bryansk_waw.title: BRYANSK
card_location_bryansk_waw.text: Bryansk was the center of partisan activity against the German invaders.
card_location_bryansk_waw.flavorText: mainly from the Bryanskie Forests. The partisans managed to disrupt the German supply lines by blowing up railways and bridges as well as killing numerous German soldiers in combat. The city was finally liberated by the Red Army on 17 September in 1943.

card_location_kursk.name: card_location_kursk
card_location_kursk.title: KURSK
card_location_kursk.text: The Battle of Kursk was history's largest tank battle.
card_location_kursk.flavorText: leading to a series of offensives that pushed the Germans back.

card_location_moscow.name: card_location_moscow
card_location_moscow.title: MOSCOW
card_location_moscow.text: Moscow is the capital of the Soviet Union.
card_location_moscow.flavorText: but the Red Army managed to halt their offensive and execute a successful strategic counteroffensive that pushed back the Axis forces. The Battle of Moscow is considered to be one of the most important battles fought between Soviet Union and the Axis as it was the first time the Axis advance was stopped by the Red Army.

card_location_stalingrad.title: STALINGRAD
card_location_stalingrad.text: The Battle of Stalingrad is often identified as the turning point on the Eastern Front.
card_location_stalingrad.flavorText: in which Germany and its Allies fought the Soviet Union for control of the city of Stalingrad (now Volgograd) in Southern Russia.

card_event_extended_barrage.flavorText: Soviet artillery tactics had evolved significantly and massed and concentrated barrages were used to clear the way for advancing infantry and tanks. These tactics were key in battles like Seelow Heights and the final assault on Berlin.

card_event_honorifics.title: HONORIFICS

card_event_orders_from_above.title: ORDERS FROM ABOVE
card_event_orders_from_above.flavorText: concluding its role in directing the Soviet war effort.

card_event_surveil.title: SURVEIL

card_event_surveil.flavorText: Soviet recon units provided essential intelligence that shaped frontline tactics and helped direct artillery fire with greater accuracy.

The division was disbanded in the summer of 1945. Its personnel were reassigned to other formations under the Group of Soviet Occupation Forces in Germany.

card_unit_511th_regiment.flavorText: earning the Order of the Red Banner. The 511th Regiment later received the Orders of Alexander Nevsky and Kutuzov for its actions in Latvia and Silesia.

card_unit_641st_rifles.flavorText: before the division ended the war near the Baltic coast.

card_unit_75th_rifle_regiment.flavorText: ending the war deep in Central Europe.

card_unit_866th_rifles.flavorText: along with several other Soviet decorations.

card_unit_909th_roslavl.flavorText: while the division was decorated with the Order of the Red Banner.

card_unit_stz_5_katyusha.flavorText: with the STZ-5 representing one of the earliest tracked platforms for the launcher.

card_unit_tupolev_tu_2.text: Draw a random unit from your deck when a friendly unit becomes Veteran.
card_unit_tupolev_tu_2.flavorText: and played a key role in the Red Army’s final offensives.

card_event_campaign_moscow3_toe_to_toe.title: TOE TO TOE
card_event_campaign_moscow3_toe_to_toe.text: Deal damage to target unit equal to highest attack among friendly units.

card_event_from_the_people_tut.name: card_event_from_the_people_tut
card_event_from_the_people_tut.title: FROM THE PEOPLE
card_event_from_the_people_tut.flavorText: all the evidence points to the fact that workers willingly endured these hardships for the sake of the motherland and for the struggle against the German occupation.

card_event_reserves_cam1.name: card_event_reserves_cam1
card_event_reserves_cam1.title: RESERVES
card_event_reserves_cam1.text: plus one for each previously played RESERVES.

card_event_ural_factories_cam1.text: Destroy a friendly unit. Add a random unit from same nation that costs 1 more.

card_location_soviet_scen1.title: BRYANSK
card_location_soviet_scen1.text: Bryansk is an important town on the road towards Moscow.

card_unit_102_rifles_vet.text: add a THE HAMMER to your hand.

card_unit_216th_guards_vet.text: Your other units and HQ get +3 defense when this unit becomes Veteran.

card_unit_252nd_RIFLES_vet.title: 252nd RIFLES

card_unit_321st_rifles_cam1.title: 51st RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_321st_rifles_cam1.text: Destruction: Add a 1/1 LIGHT INFANTRY to the support line.
