card_unit_414th_rifles.title: 414th RIFLES
card_unit_414th_rifles.text: Destruction: Shuffle 97th RIFLES into your deck. Draw 3 cards and deal 3 damage to your HQ.

card_unit_511th_regiment_vet.name: card_unit_511th_regiment_vet
card_unit_511th_regiment_vet.title: 511th REGIMENT
card_unit_511th_regiment_vet.text: Your infantry with 1 defense have +2 attack.

card_unit_641st_rifles_vet.name: card_unit_641st_rifles_vet
card_unit_641st_rifles_vet.title: 641st RIFLES
card_unit_641st_rifles_vet.text: Destruction: Draw a card if this unit destroyed an enemy unit this turn.

card_unit_84th_infantry_cam1.name: card_unit_84th_infantry_cam1
card_unit_84th_infantry_cam1.title: 17th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_84th_infantry_cam1.flavorText: the Soviet invasion of Manchuria. The division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner twice and the Order of Suvorov 2nd Class for its valor in combat.

card_unit_95th_rifles_blank.name: card_unit_95th_rifles_blank
card_unit_95th_rifles_blank.title: 95th RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_95th_rifles_blank.text: Deployment: Deal 1 damage to your HQ.

card_unit_bt_7_1937_vet.name: card_unit_bt_7_1937_vet
card_unit_bt_7_1937_vet.title: BT-7 1937
card_unit_bt_7_1937_vet.text: deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.

card_unit_bt_7_cam1.name: card_unit_bt_7_cam1
card_unit_bt_7_cam1.title: BT-7
card_unit_bt_7_cam1.flavorText: The BT 7 was a light tank and was produced between 1935 and 1940. It was nicknamed “Betka and/or Betushka” and was the last one of the BT series of Soviet cavalry tanks. In 1940 the BT 7 was more or less replaced by the T-34 medium tank.

card_event_conscripts.name: card_event_conscripts
card_event_conscripts.title: CONSCRIPTS
card_event_conscripts.text: Shuffle a RESERVES into your deck for each enemy unit on the battlefield. Draw a card.
card_event_conscripts.flavorText: beliefs or political convictions (or lack thereof).

card_event_heroes_of_the_soviet_union.name: card_event_heroes_of_the_soviet_union
card_event_heroes_of_the_soviet_union.title: HEROES OF THE SOVIET UNION
card_event_heroes_of_the_soviet_union.text: Choose 1 of 3 random elite Soviet units to add to your hand.
card_event_heroes_of_the_soviet_union.flavorText: and some received it more than once.

card_event_moat.name: card_event_moat
card_event_moat.title: STAND FAST
card_event_moat.text: Give target infantry or tank unit +5+5 and +5 operation cost.
card_event_moat.flavorText: the city was fortified in a hurry. 250,000 women and elderly men were hastily recruited to build trenches and anti-tank moats around Moscow. It is estimated that they moved three million cubic meters of earth with handheld shovels and no mechanical help.

card_event_tractor_factories.name: card_event_tractor_factories
card_event_tractor_factories.title: TRACTOR FACTORIES
card_event_tractor_factories.text: Add two T-34 1942 to your support line.
card_event_tractor_factories.flavorText: which was four times more than the Germans and more than all the armies of the world combined.

card_event_ura.name: card_event_ura
card_event_ura.title: URA!
card_event_ura.text: your Soviet units get +3 attack and deal excess damage to the enemy HQ in combat.
card_event_ura.flavorText: at least since the Russo-Ottoman War in 1877. Soldiers of the Red Army frequently used it during WWII and it’s still being used by the Russian Ground Forces.

card_unit_1005th_rifles.name: card_unit_1005th_rifles
card_unit_1005th_rifles.title: 1005th RIFLES
card_unit_1005th_rifles.flavorText: but reformed  in 1942 and participated in numerous battles and campaigns on the Eastern Front after that. The division ended the war in the Courland Pocket in 1945.

card_unit_17th_rifle_regiment.name: card_unit_17th_rifle_regiment
card_unit_17th_rifle_regiment.title: 17th RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_17th_rifle_regiment.text: fully repair this unit and give it +1+1.
card_unit_17th_rifle_regiment.flavorText: and the first battle took place in the Yelnya area where the 17th Rifle Regiment had set up defenses. The best the 32nd division could hope for was to slow down the two advancing German veteran divisions (10th Panzer Division and the 2nd SS Division Das Reich) which they managed to do for 5 days before Mozhaisk was lost. The heroic defense did not go unnoticed by Soviet officials and the 32nd Rifle Division was raised to guard status (29th Guards Rifle Division) and the 17th Rifle Regiment was awarded the Order of the Red Banner.

card_unit_503rd_motors.name: card_unit_503rd_motors
card_unit_503rd_motors.title: 503rd MOTORS
card_unit_503rd_motors.text: Deployment: Give your LIGHT INFANTRY units +1+1.
card_unit_503rd_motors.flavorText: and finally to Czechoslovakia where it ended the war in 1945. For their outstanding performance during the war the division was awarded the Order of Suvorov 2nd degree.

card_event_claim_the_skies.name: card_event_claim_the_skies
card_event_claim_the_skies.title: CLAIM THE SKIES
card_event_claim_the_skies.flavorText: many German aircraft were just sitting on airfields without enough fuel to fly them.

card_event_depths_of_winter.name: card_event_depths_of_winter
card_event_depths_of_winter.title: DEPTHS OF WINTER
card_event_depths_of_winter.text: Remove all units from the battlefield. Replace them with LIGHT INFANTRY units.
card_event_depths_of_winter.flavorText: adopted ushankas and other Soviet-style winter gear because their own uniforms did not adequately shield them from extreme cold conditions.

card_event_line_of_engagement.name: card_event_line_of_engagement
card_event_line_of_engagement.title: LINE OF ENGAGEMENT
card_event_line_of_engagement.text: one in the frontline if possible.
card_event_line_of_engagement.flavorText: the line of engagement was highly fluid and moved as military forces advanced and retreated.

card_event_push.name: card_event_push
card_event_push.title: PUSH!
card_event_push.text: Your HQ takes 3 damage. Deal damage to target enemy equal to damage to your HQ this turn.
card_event_push.flavorText: while an additional 300,000 German soldiers found themselves trapped within the Courland Pocket.

card_event_snowstorm.name: card_event_snowstorm
card_event_snowstorm.title: SNOWSTORM
card_event_snowstorm.text: All units have an operation cost of 4 until the start of your next turn.
card_event_snowstorm.flavorText: especially for the German forces who were not equipped for the harsh winter conditions.

card_event_special_reinforcements.name: card_event_special_reinforcements
card_event_special_reinforcements.title: SPECIAL REINFORCEMENTS
card_event_special_reinforcements.text: Add a copy of your last destroyed unit to your hand.
card_event_special_reinforcements.flavorText: the Guards units received extensive training and support to ensure their effectiveness. They were also provided with access to the best available equipment and resources within the Soviet military at the time.

card_unit_122nd_korsun.name: card_unit_122nd_korsun
card_unit_122nd_korsun.title: 122nd KORSUN
card_unit_122nd_korsun.text: Costs 1 less to deploy for each of your units.
card_unit_122nd_korsun.flavorText: the division was transformed into the 18th Guards Mechanized Division.

card_unit_146th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_146th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_146th_infantry_regiment.title: 146th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_146th_infantry_regiment.text: Deployment: Gets +1+2 if you control 3 or more units.
card_unit_146th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: with some of its regiments transferring to another division.

card_unit_252nd_RIFLES.name: card_unit_252nd_RIFLES
card_unit_252nd_RIFLES.title: 252nd RIFLES
card_unit_252nd_RIFLES.text: then becomes Veteran if attack is 6+.
card_unit_252nd_RIFLES.flavorText: it undertook garrison duties in Pomerania before its disbandment in early 1947.

card_unit_334th_mountain_rifles.name: card_unit_334th_mountain_rifles
card_unit_334th_mountain_rifles.title: 334th MOUNTAIN RIFLES
card_unit_334th_mountain_rifles.flavorText: and in 1943 it fought in the Nevel Offensive as part of the 83rd Rifle Corps. Afterwards the 47th Division was awarded the honorific title “Nevel” for its part in capturing the town. The division was later awarded the Order of Suvorov and the Order of Lenin for its actions. It was disbanded after the war.

card_unit_67th_baranovichi.name: card_unit_67th_baranovichi
card_unit_67th_baranovichi.title: 67th BARANOVICHI
card_unit_67th_baranovichi.text: Your LIGHT INFANTRY units have Alpine.
card_unit_67th_baranovichi.flavorText: and received the honorific title "Baranovichi". It was also awarded the Order of Suvorov 2nd class. The 20th Rifle Division was transferred to Lida with the 28th Army after the war and disbanded in July 1946.

card_unit_t_34_85_1944.name: card_unit_t_34_85_1944
card_unit_t_34_85_1944.title: T-34-85 1944
card_unit_t_34_85_1944.text: Has Blitz and Guard if you control 3 or more units.
card_unit_t_34_85_1944.flavorText: radio moved from the hull into a turret with improved layout and new gunner's sights.

card_unit_t_35_winter.name: card_unit_t_35_winter
card_unit_t_35_winter.title: T-35
card_unit_t_35_winter.text: Deals 1 damage to each HQ at the end of your turn.
card_unit_t_35_winter.flavorText: the T-35 was gradually phased out of service during the early years of the war. A total of 56 T-35 tanks were built and only one survived and is preserved in running condition at the Patriot Park near Moscow.

card_event_hasty_reinforcements.name: card_event_hasty_reinforcements
card_event_hasty_reinforcements.title: HASTY REINFORCEMENTS
card_event_hasty_reinforcements.flavorText: which is the most critical period for fresh recruits.

card_event_machines_of_war.name: card_event_machines_of_war
card_event_machines_of_war.title: MACHINES OF WAR
card_event_machines_of_war.text: Add the top Soviet infantry unit in your deck to your support line.

card_event_monastyr.name: card_event_monastyr
card_event_monastyr.title: MONASTYR
card_event_monastyr.text: Destroy all units with 1 or fewer combat keywords.
card_event_monastyr.flavorText: the major Soviet offensive at Stalingrad.

card_event_out_with_the_old.name: card_event_out_with_the_old
card_event_out_with_the_old.title: OUT WITH THE OLD
card_event_out_with_the_old.flavorText: modern force capable of meeting the Luftwaffe head-on.

card_event_surazh_gate.name: card_event_surazh_gate
card_event_surazh_gate.title: SURAZH GATE
card_event_surazh_gate.text: Pin target unit. Deal 2 damage to adjacent units.
card_event_surazh_gate.flavorText: the Red Army did not launch another offensive in this area and in September 1942 the Germans launched a counteroffensive and managed to close the gate.

card_unit_39th_rifle_regiment.name: card_unit_39th_rifle_regiment
card_unit_39th_rifle_regiment.title: 39th RIFLE REGIMENT
card_unit_39th_rifle_regiment.text: Deployment: Take control of an enemy unit with cost 2 or less.
card_unit_39th_rifle_regiment.flavorText: but it was disbanded in 1942 after heavy losses in the Battle of the Caucasus. The 4th Division was reformed in 1943 and participated in the Lublin-Brest Offensive in 1944 and the Battle of Berlin in May 1945. Shortly after the war ended in Europe the division was disbanded.

card_unit_52_k.name: card_unit_52_k
card_unit_52_k.title: 52-K
card_unit_52_k.text: Deployment: Deal 4 damage to target enemy air unit.
card_unit_52_k.flavorText: anti aircraft gun was used by the Red Army during WWII. The gun entered service in 1939 in regiments of 16 guns each and was used effectively against  German aircraft between 1941 and 1945. In its secondary role the 52-K was used as an anti tank weapon and some gun barrels were mounted on vehicles such as the SU-85 tank destroyer. After the war most Soviet nations had the 52-K in its arsenal and in some cases they were refitted for peaceful purposes as anti-avalanche guns.

card_unit_60th_cavalry_regiment.name: card_unit_60th_cavalry_regiment
card_unit_60th_cavalry_regiment.title: 60th CAVALRY REGIMENT
card_unit_60th_cavalry_regiment.text: Players can only give one order each turn.
card_unit_60th_cavalry_regiment.flavorText: but was moved to 3rd Belorussian Front where it served until the end of the war.

card_unit_bryansk_irregulars.name: card_unit_bryansk_irregulars
card_unit_bryansk_irregulars.title: BRYANSK IRREGULARS
card_unit_bryansk_irregulars.text: Destruction: Deal 3 damage to each unit that dealt damage to this unit this turn.
card_unit_bryansk_irregulars.flavorText: and several partisan brigades operated their own aircraft.

card_unit_ilyushin_10.name: card_unit_ilyushin_10
card_unit_ilyushin_10.title: ILYUSHIN IL-10
card_unit_ilyushin_10.text: Destruction: Add your last destroyed ground unit to your support line.
card_unit_ilyushin_10.flavorText: it marked the Air Forces’ shift to more modern and versatile strike aircraft.

card_unit_p_39_airacobra.name: card_unit_p_39_airacobra
card_unit_p_39_airacobra.title: LITTLE COBRA
card_unit_p_39_airacobra.text: Deployment: Destroy another random friendly unit.
card_unit_p_39_airacobra.flavorText: the P-39 became a workhorse in Soviet hands and contributed significantly to the air war on the Eastern Front.

card_event_air_blitz_tut.name: card_event_air_blitz_tut
card_event_air_blitz_tut.title: AIR BLITZ
card_event_air_blitz_tut.text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.

card_event_gunship_assault_tut.name: card_event_gunship_assault_tut
card_event_gunship_assault_tut.title: GUNSHIP ASSAULT
card_event_gunship_assault_tut.text: Deal 2 damage to a target in the enemy support line.

card_event_carrier_cover.name: card_event_carrier_cover
card_event_carrier_cover.title: CARRIER COVER
card_event_carrier_cover.flavorText: both as convoy escorts and later in independent hunting groups.

card_event_counter_strike.name: card_event_counter_strike
card_event_counter_strike.title: COUNTER STRIKE
card_event_counter_strike.flavorText: but did so by falling back to entrenched positions and continued their resistance. This slowed down the German advance even more and dealt a major setback to their timetable.

card_event_embargo.name: card_event_embargo
card_event_embargo.title: EMBARGO
card_event_embargo.text: The enemy gets 2 fewer kredits next turn.
card_event_embargo.flavorText: rather than fight the long and bloody war that later came.

card_event_magic.name: card_event_magic
card_event_magic.title: MAGIC
card_event_magic.flavorText: which were secret operating codes used by the Japanese in WWII.

card_event_naval_task_force.name: card_event_naval_task_force
card_event_naval_task_force.title: NAVAL TASK FORCE
card_event_naval_task_force.text: Choose one - add a NAVAL BOMBARDMENT to hand OR add a SUPPLY SHIPMENT to hand.
card_event_naval_task_force.flavorText: cruisers or fast battleships and 18-24 destroyers. Fast Carrier Task Forces were used in all US Navy’s battles in the Pacific and usually 1-2 task groups were utilized in raids against island strong points in the Pacific such as Iwo Jima or Chichi Jima.

card_event_shore_bombardment.name: card_event_shore_bombardment
card_event_shore_bombardment.title: SHORE BOMBARDMENT
card_event_shore_bombardment.text: Choose one - deal 3 damage to a unit OR give a unit +2+3.
card_event_shore_bombardment.flavorText: both by the Allies and the Axis forces.

card_event_strafing.name: card_event_strafing
card_event_strafing.title: STRAFING
card_event_strafing.text: Choose one - destroy target artillery unit OR pin all units in the frontline.
card_event_strafing.flavorText: the Republic P-47 Thunderbolt (armed with 8 .50 calibre machine guns) and the North American B-25 Mitchell were the two best strafing aircraft.

card_event_strategic_planning.name: card_event_strategic_planning
card_event_strategic_planning.title: STRATEGIC PLANNING
card_event_strategic_planning.text: Double the attack and defense of your units.
card_event_strategic_planning.flavorText: and the success of the operation lay not least in the meticulous planning and forethought of the parties involved.

card_event_supply_front.name: card_event_supply_front
card_event_supply_front.title: SUPPLY FRONT
card_event_supply_front.text: Fully repair all units in the frontline and give them +1+2.
card_event_supply_front.flavorText: and portable gasoline pipelines were deployed.

card_unit_106th_quartermasters.name: card_unit_106th_quartermasters
card_unit_106th_quartermasters.title: 106th QUARTERMASTERS
card_unit_106th_quartermasters.flavorText: barracks and distributing supplies and provisions for the division. The author Kurt Vonnegut served in the 106th Infantry Division and wrote about his experience in the Battle of the Bulge and later as a POW in Germany in his book “Slaughterhouse-Five”.

card_unit_109th_combat_engineers.name: card_unit_109th_combat_engineers
card_unit_109th_combat_engineers.title: 109th COMBAT ENGINEERS
card_unit_109th_combat_engineers.flavorText: second to the 32nd Infantry Division with 617 days of front line combat.

card_unit_11th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_11th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_11th_infantry_regiment.title: 11th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_11th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: but reactivated in 1954 and has stayed active to this day.

card_unit_12th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_12th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_12th_infantry_regiment.title: 12th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_12th_infantry_regiment.text: Deployment: Spend your remaining kredits. This unit gets +X+X where X is kredits spent.
card_unit_12th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: but reactivated in 1947 and is still active today.

card_unit_1st_marines.name: card_unit_1st_marines
card_unit_1st_marines.title: 1st MARINES
card_unit_1st_marines.text: give your HQ Smokescreen until your next turn.
card_unit_1st_marines.flavorText: but afterwards it was deployed to North China where it would help garrison the area until 1949. The regiment has remained active since WWII and has participated in most major American wars since then.

card_unit_a_36_apache.name: card_unit_a_36_apache
card_unit_a_36_apache.title: A-36 APACHE
card_unit_a_36_apache.flavorText: and then later in the Allied invasion of Sicily and the China-Burma-Indian Theater. The aircraft looked very similar to the P-51A Mustang fighter but had two more .50 caliber machine guns inside the lower engine housing that shot through the propeller arc. The A-36 also had dive breaks installed which limited the dive speed to 630 km/h and made it a very accurate dive bomber. The A-36 Apache was used in service until 1945 but many were withdrawn from service in 1944 and replaced with the P-40 Warhawk and P-47 Thunderbolt. A total of 500 aircraft were manufactured.

card_unit_b_25h.name: card_unit_b_25h
card_unit_b_25h.title: B-25 H
card_unit_b_25h.text: Deployment: Add a GUNSHIP MISSION to your hand.

card_unit_b_29_super_fortress.name: card_unit_b_29_super_fortress
card_unit_b_29_super_fortress.title: B-29 SUPERFORTRESS
card_unit_b_29_super_fortress.text: Deployment: Distribute 6 damage randomly between enemies.
card_unit_b_29_super_fortress.flavorText: such as a pressurized cabin and an analog computer controlled firing system that allowed crew members to remotely control four machine gun turrets. 3,970 B-29s were built and the aircraft stayed in use until 1960.

card_unit_f4f_3_wildcat.name: card_unit_f4f_3_wildcat
card_unit_f4f_3_wildcat.title: F4F-3 WILDCAT
card_unit_f4f_3_wildcat.flavorText: and most of them served on escort carriers.

card_unit_m4a1.name: card_unit_m4a1
card_unit_m4a1.title: M4A1
card_unit_m4a1.text: Can't be targeted by enemy orders. Draw this unit from deck if enemy makes you discard.
card_unit_m4a1.flavorText: The M4A1 was a Sherman medium tank variant and the first type to be used in US front line service. The M4A1 differed from other variants by its fully cast upper hull and its rounded appearance. The tank was first used by US forces in the North Africa Campaign and was the main Sherman type tank until late 1944 when the US Army began to replace them with the preferred M4A3 variant. The M4A1 was nevertheless used in front line service by the US and the Allies throughout the duration of the war.

card_unit_m8_howitzer.name: card_unit_m8_howitzer
card_unit_m8_howitzer.title: M8 HOWITZER
card_unit_m8_howitzer.text: Deployment: Distribute 3 damage randomly between all enemies.
card_unit_m8_howitzer.flavorText: by both the US and French Army. A total of 1,778 M8s were built.

card_unit_motorized_infantry.name: card_unit_motorized_infantry
card_unit_motorized_infantry.title: 5th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_motorized_infantry.text: Gets +1+1 when it moves into the frontline.
card_unit_motorized_infantry.flavorText: Fulda and Bayreuth. The regiment was the first US Army unit to cross the Danube River and the first to invade Austria where it performed occupation duty after the war.

card_unit_p_61_black_widow.name: card_unit_p_61_black_widow
card_unit_p_61_black_widow.title: P-61 BLACK WIDOW
card_unit_p_61_black_widow.text: give a random friendly air unit immune this turn.
card_unit_p_61_black_widow.flavorText: The Northrop P-61 Black Widow was an American night fighter introduced in 1944 and used for the remainder of the war. The P-61 was the first aircraft designed to carry a radar and although it was sufficiently armed it lacked the speed to engage some of the German fighters and medium bombers. 706 P-61 aircraft were built and were used in front line service in all theaters of the war and remained in service until 1954.

card_event_air_defense.name: card_event_air_defense
card_event_air_defense.title: AIR DEFENSE
card_event_air_defense.flavorText: which was the most powerful AA gun of its time with an altitude capability of 18 km (60,000 ft).

card_event_awoken_giant.name: card_event_awoken_giant
card_event_awoken_giant.title: AWOKEN GIANT
card_event_awoken_giant.flavorText: half of the worldwide military production during WWII came from the United States.

card_event_cadet_nurse_corps.name: card_event_cadet_nurse_corps
card_event_cadet_nurse_corps.title: CADET NURSE CORPS
card_event_cadet_nurse_corps.text: Fully repair all friendly units and give them +1+1.
card_event_cadet_nurse_corps.flavorText: and during this period 179,294 student nurses enrolled in the program.

card_event_death_from_above.name: card_event_death_from_above
card_event_death_from_above.title: DEATH FROM ABOVE
card_event_death_from_above.flavorText: almost five times more than the Axis powers combined.

card_event_enemy_spotted.name: card_event_enemy_spotted
card_event_enemy_spotted.title: ENEMY SPOTTED
card_event_enemy_spotted.flavorText: using a special technique referred to as the Renshaw Training System for Aircraft and Ship Recognition. Officers studied pictures of planes and vessels and learned to identify them by their form in a fraction of a second. Over a million combined Navy and Army personnel learned Renshaw’s techniques and it is believed to have saved an untold amount of lives during the war.

card_event_for_freedom.name: card_event_for_freedom
card_event_for_freedom.title: FOR FREEDOM
card_event_for_freedom.text: Give a unit +1+1. Draw a card.
card_event_for_freedom.flavorText: of not being imprisoned or enslaved.

card_event_gunship.name: card_event_gunship
card_event_gunship.title: GUNSHIP MISSION
card_event_gunship.text: Deal 2 damage to a target in the enemy support line. Your HQ gains +2 defense.
card_event_gunship.flavorText: primarily intended for attacking ground targets.

card_event_industrial_might.name: card_event_industrial_might
card_event_industrial_might.title: INDUSTRIAL MIGHT
card_event_industrial_might.text: Draw a card for each unit you have deployed or added this turn.
card_event_industrial_might.flavorText: which was more than half of what the Allied powers spent in total.

card_event_land_of_the_free.name: card_event_land_of_the_free
card_event_land_of_the_free.title: LAND OF THE FREE
card_event_land_of_the_free.text: Reduce the operation cost of target unit to 0.
card_event_land_of_the_free.flavorText: ranging from light bombers to very heavy bombers.

card_event_mobilization.name: card_event_mobilization
card_event_mobilization.title: MOBILIZATION
card_event_mobilization.text: Draw 2 units from your deck. Discard them at the end of turn.
card_event_mobilization.flavorText: The US Mobilization for WWII was immensely rapid and played a major role in the outcome and victory for the Allied Forces. Throughout the war over 16 million US citizens served in the military and after the war the US emerged as an undisputed superpower.

card_event_naval_bombardment.name: card_event_naval_bombardment
card_event_naval_bombardment.title: NAVAL BOMBARDMENT
card_event_naval_bombardment.text: Send a unit to hand. Costs 2 less if the enemy controls the frontline.
card_event_naval_bombardment.flavorText: in the hope of reducing fortifications and defending forces.

card_event_overwhelming_force.name: card_event_overwhelming_force
card_event_overwhelming_force.title: OVERWHELMING FORCE
card_event_overwhelming_force.text: Choose and discard a unit. Give its attack and defense to target friendly infantry or tank.
card_event_overwhelming_force.flavorText: they managed to assemble a large fighting force in a short period of time. From the year 1939 to 1945 the US military personnel grew from 334,473 to 12,209,238 members. Of these men and women 38.8% (6,332,000) were volunteers and 61.2% (11,535,000) were draftees.

card_event_patriotic_zeal.name: card_event_patriotic_zeal
card_event_patriotic_zeal.title: PATRIOTIC ZEAL
card_event_patriotic_zeal.text: Double the attack and defense of a friendly unit.
card_event_patriotic_zeal.flavorText: Japans attack on Pearl Harbor soon changed that and seemingly united the nation in determination to achieve total victory over the Axis powers in Asia and Europe.

card_event_patton.name: card_event_patton
card_event_patton.title: PATTON
card_event_patton.text: Units you deploy cost 1 less kredit and have Blitz this turn.
card_event_patton.flavorText: where he turned and force-marched his entire army to the relief of the besieged Americans at Bastogne.

card_event_seaborne_invasion.name: card_event_seaborne_invasion
card_event_seaborne_invasion.title: SEABORNE INVASION
card_event_seaborne_invasion.text: All enemy units in the frontline retreat. Add two US infantry units there with total attack of 6.
card_event_seaborne_invasion.flavorText: 104,428 vehicles and 547,428 tonnes of supplies had been landed on the beaches.

card_event_strategic_bombing.name: card_event_strategic_bombing
card_event_strategic_bombing.title: STRATEGIC BOMBING
card_event_strategic_bombing.text: Deal 3 damage to all targets in the enemy support line. The enemy loses a kredit slot.
card_event_strategic_bombing.flavorText: both on non-military and military targets.

card_event_supply_chain.name: card_event_supply_chain
card_event_supply_chain.title: SUPPLY CHAIN
card_event_supply_chain.text: add 2 copies to your hand with a cost of 1.
card_event_supply_chain.flavorText: 500,000 vehicles and 4 million tonnes of supplies until its decommissioning in April 1945.

card_event_supply_shipment.name: card_event_supply_shipment
card_event_supply_shipment.title: SUPPLY SHIPMENT
card_event_supply_shipment.text: Give a unit in the frontline +2+3.
card_event_supply_shipment.flavorText: transports and shelter in order live to fight another day.

card_event_the_alliance.name: card_event_the_alliance
card_event_the_alliance.title: THE ALLIANCE
card_event_the_alliance.text: Give all your non USA units +2+2.

card_event_the_war_machine.name: card_event_the_war_machine
card_event_the_war_machine.title: THE WAR MACHINE
card_event_the_war_machine.flavorText: especially a mechanical one such as a siege engine or tank. 2) The military resources of a belligerent country considered as a whole.

card_event_torpedo_attack.name: card_event_torpedo_attack
card_event_torpedo_attack.title: TORPEDO ATTACK
card_event_torpedo_attack.text: Destroy an enemy unit that is in the frontline.
card_event_torpedo_attack.flavorText: and armed with a magnetic exploder that was set to activate at the appropriate time.

card_event_uncle_sam.name: card_event_uncle_sam
card_event_uncle_sam.title: UNCLE SAM
card_event_uncle_sam.text: Duplicate a random unit in your hand.
card_event_uncle_sam.flavorText: and child to endure the personal sacrifice and domestic adjustments during wartime.

card_event_unity_is_strength.name: card_event_unity_is_strength
card_event_unity_is_strength.title: UNITY IS STRENGTH
card_event_unity_is_strength.text: Give a friendly infantry +1+1 for each friendly infantry unit on the battlefield.
card_event_unity_is_strength.flavorText: the Tunisian Campaign and the Allied invasion of Italy.

card_event_usace.name: card_event_usace
card_event_usace.title: USACE
card_event_usace.flavorText: and played a major role in the European and Pacific Theater.

card_event_war_bonds.name: card_event_war_bonds
card_event_war_bonds.title: WAR BONDS
card_event_war_bonds.text: Gain 2 extra kredit slots. Draw an additional card at the beginning of next turn.
card_event_war_bonds.flavorText: which would be bought back for $50 ten years later. Larger denominations were also available in $1000 and 85 cent saving stamps were also sold to those who wanted to save up for a bond. 185 million Americans bought war bonds for a total amount of $185 billion.

card_event_we_can_do_it.name: card_event_we_can_do_it
card_event_we_can_do_it.title: WE CAN DO IT!
card_event_we_can_do_it.text: Give your units and HQ +3 defense and draw a card.
card_event_we_can_do_it.flavorText: far beyond its defined purpose during WWII.

card_unit_101st_airborne.name: card_unit_101st_airborne
card_unit_101st_airborne.title: 101st AIRBORNE
card_unit_101st_airborne.text: Deployment: Deal 2 damage to a target in the enemy support line.
card_unit_101st_airborne.flavorText: the liberation of the Netherlands and for their defense of the city of Bastogne during the Battle of the Bulge.

card_unit_1918_155mm.name: card_unit_1918_155mm
card_unit_1918_155mm.title: 155mm 1918 MODEL
card_unit_1918_155mm.text: it deals 1 damage to a random enemy.
card_unit_1918_155mm.flavorText: and was for most parts replaced in 1942 with the American 155 mm howitzer M1.

card_unit_30th_regiment.name: card_unit_30th_regiment
card_unit_30th_regiment.title: 30th REGIMENT
card_unit_30th_regiment.flavorText: Operation Shingle and Operation Anvil. In the final stages of the war the 30th Regiment was attached to the XV Corps that was tasked as the Spearhead across the Rhine into Germany. Their motto is "Our Country Not Ourselves".

card_unit_332nd_engineers.name: card_unit_332nd_engineers
card_unit_332nd_engineers.title: 332nd ENGINEER REGIMENT
card_unit_332nd_engineers.text: Deployment: Gain 1 extra kredit slot. Your HQ gains +2 defense.

card_unit_463rd_battalion.name: card_unit_463rd_battalion
card_unit_463rd_battalion.title: 463rd BATTALION
card_unit_463rd_battalion.text: deal 1 damage to a random enemy in same front.
card_unit_463rd_battalion.flavorText: including the invasion of Normandy and the Battle of Bastogne where it was attached to the 101st Airborne Division.

card_unit_506th_airborne.name: card_unit_506th_airborne
card_unit_506th_airborne.title: 506th AIRBORNE
card_unit_506th_airborne.flavorText: and the Battle of the Bulge. The 506th Airborne were the subject of the HBO miniseries Band of Brothers.

card_unit_75_mm_pack_howitzer.name: card_unit_75_mm_pack_howitzer
card_unit_75_mm_pack_howitzer.title: 75mm PACK HOWITZER
card_unit_75_mm_pack_howitzer.flavorText: The 75mm Pack Howitzer M1 was an American made artillery piece used by the United States and their Allies. It was designed for moving over difficult terrain and was primarily used by airborne units of the United States Army and the US Marine Corps.

card_unit_7th_regiment.name: card_unit_7th_regiment
card_unit_7th_regiment.title: 7th REGIMENT
card_unit_7th_regiment.text: Draw a card when 7th REGIMENT moves into the frontline.
card_unit_7th_regiment.flavorText: and Northwest Europe. Some claim that no other regiment exceeded the 7th’s combat time in WWII.

card_unit_8th_cavalry_regiment.name: card_unit_8th_cavalry_regiment
card_unit_8th_cavalry_regiment.title: 8th CAVALRY REGIMENT
card_unit_8th_cavalry_regiment.text: Your HQ is immune to damage on your turn.
card_unit_8th_cavalry_regiment.flavorText: the regiment was given the responsibility of occupying the entire city of Tokyo along with the 1st Division.

card_unit_99th_infantry.name: card_unit_99th_infantry
card_unit_99th_infantry.title: 99th INFANTRY BATTALION
card_unit_99th_infantry.flavorText: attended the final battle at Cherbourg and took part in the Battle of the Bulge.

card_unit_a20_havoc.name: card_unit_a20_havoc
card_unit_a20_havoc.title: A-20 HAVOC
card_unit_a20_havoc.text: Deployment: Your bombers operate for 2 less this turn.
card_unit_a20_havoc.flavorText: both as low altitude bombers and ground attack aircraft.

card_unit_a26_invader.name: card_unit_a26_invader
card_unit_a26_invader.title: A-26 INVADER
card_unit_a26_invader.flavorText: both by the Americans and other countries.

card_unit_a_24_banshee.name: card_unit_a_24_banshee
card_unit_a_24_banshee.title: A-24 BANSHEE
card_unit_a_24_banshee.text: Deployment: Deal damage to target enemy unit equal to your unspent kredits.
card_unit_a_24_banshee.flavorText: but land based and lacked the tail hook for carrier landings. The A24's were used to a very minor degree by the US Air Force in early stages of the war.

card_unit_b_17.name: card_unit_b_17
card_unit_b_17.title: B-17 FLYING FORTRESS
card_unit_b_17.flavorText: while still being able to reach its target and bring the crew home safe.

card_unit_b_25_mitchell.name: card_unit_b_25_mitchell
card_unit_b_25_mitchell.title: B-25 MITCHELL
card_unit_b_25_mitchell.text: Deployment: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy unit.
card_unit_b_25_mitchell.flavorText: but later productions added room for 2-3 more crew members in various gun positions. The Mitchell was an exceptionally sturdy aircraft that could withstand tremendous punishment. It was used by many Allied air forces and served in every theater of WWII.

card_unit_b_26_marauder.name: card_unit_b_26_marauder
card_unit_b_26_marauder.title: B-26 MARAUDER
card_unit_b_26_marauder.text: Your non-targeting deployment effects trigger twice.
card_unit_b_26_marauder.flavorText: but later in the Mediterranean Theater and in Western Europe. In total 5,288 units were built and it was considered the most successful medium-range bombers used by the US Army Air Forces during WWII. By the end of the war the B-26 had flown more than 110,000 sorties and dropped 150,000 tonnes of bombs.

card_unit_corsair_f4u.name: card_unit_corsair_f4u
card_unit_corsair_f4u.title: CORSAIR F4U-1C
card_unit_corsair_f4u.flavorText: and according to the US Navy it had a 11:1 kill ratio.

card_unit_corsair_f4u_1d.name: card_unit_corsair_f4u_1d
card_unit_corsair_f4u_1d.title: CORSAIR F4U-1D
card_unit_corsair_f4u_1d.text: Destruction: Destroy a random enemy unit.
card_unit_corsair_f4u_1d.flavorText: and according to the US Navy it had a 11:1 kill ratio.

card_unit_f4f_wildcat.name: card_unit_f4f_wildcat
card_unit_f4f_wildcat.title: F4F-4 WILDCAT
card_unit_f4f_wildcat.text: Add a BREWSTER F2A beside this unit when it moves into the frontline.

card_unit_grumman_hellcat2.name: card_unit_grumman_hellcat2
card_unit_grumman_hellcat2.title: F6F-3 HELLCAT
card_unit_grumman_hellcat2.text: When this unit attacks it gets +1+1.
card_unit_grumman_hellcat2.flavorText: designed to replace the earlier F4F Wildcat and to counter the Japanese Mitsubishi A6M Zero. It was produced from 1942 to 1945 with 12,275 units built and it became the US Navy's dominant fighter in the Pacific War. The aircraft claimed 5,163 kills which counted for 56% of all U.S. Navy/Marine air victories of WWII.

card_unit_m16_halftrack.name: card_unit_m16_halftrack
card_unit_m16_halftrack.title: M16 HALF-TRACK
card_unit_m16_halftrack.text: Deployment: An enemy air or infantry unit must retreat.
card_unit_m16_halftrack.flavorText: the Battle of Arracourt and the Ardennes Offensive.

card_unit_m18_hellcat.name: card_unit_m18_hellcat
card_unit_m18_hellcat.title: M18 HELLCAT
card_unit_m18_hellcat.flavorText: a main armament of a 76 mm gun and a secondary armament of a .50 caliber Browning machine gun.

card_unit_m1_155mm_long_tom.name: card_unit_m1_155mm_long_tom
card_unit_m1_155mm_long_tom.title: LONG TOM
card_unit_m1_155mm_long_tom.flavorText: The 155 mm Gun M1 (nickname Long Tom) was an American 155 millimeter caliber field gun used by the United States military and Allied forces during WWII. The gun could fire a 45.36 kg (100 lb) shell to a maximum range of 22 km (13.7 miles). 1,882 guns were produced 1940-1945.

card_unit_m24_chaffee.name: card_unit_m24_chaffee
card_unit_m24_chaffee.title: M24 CHAFFEE
card_unit_m24_chaffee.flavorText: a main armament of 75 mm Gun M6 in Mount M64 and a secondary armament of .50 cal Browning M2HB machine gun.

card_unit_m26_pershing.name: card_unit_m26_pershing
card_unit_m26_pershing.title: M26 PERSHING
card_unit_m26_pershing.text: your HQ cannot be reduced below 1 defense.
card_unit_m26_pershing.flavorText: a mounted 90 mm gun as main armament and a secondary armament of 2x Browning .30-06 machine guns.

card_unit_m36_destroyer.name: card_unit_m36_destroyer
card_unit_m36_destroyer.title: M36 JACKSON
card_unit_m36_destroyer.text: put it on the battlefield instead.
card_unit_m36_destroyer.flavorText: assistant driver) and a secondary armament of .50 caliber (12.7 mm) Browning M2HB machine gun. The M36 was well liked by US troops as it was one of the few armored vehicles available to the US forces that was capable of destroying heavy German tanks from a distance. It was generally referred to by American soldiers as "TD" (Tank Destroyer).

card_unit_m3_stuart.name: card_unit_m3_stuart
card_unit_m3_stuart.title: M5 STUART
card_unit_m3_stuart.flavorText: the Americans usually referred to the tank as "Light Tank M5".

card_unit_m4_sherman.name: card_unit_m4_sherman
card_unit_m4_sherman.title: M4 SHERMAN
card_unit_m4_sherman.flavorText: or as the British Sherman Firefly that was refitted with an Ordnance QF 17-pounder.

card_unit_m4_sherman_flam.name: card_unit_m4_sherman_flam
card_unit_m4_sherman_flam.title: M4A3R3 ZIPPO
card_unit_m4_sherman_flam.text: Has +4 attack against infantry and enemy HQ.
card_unit_m4_sherman_flam.flavorText: rather than risk being burned alive.

card_unit_m7_priest.name: card_unit_m7_priest
card_unit_m7_priest.title: M7 PRIEST
card_unit_m7_priest.text: Deployment: Gains +1+1 if you control the frontline.
card_unit_m7_priest.flavorText: The 105 mm Howitzer Motor Carriage M7 was a self-propelled artillery vehicle produced by the US and used by the Allies during WWII. The M7 Priest had a crew of 8 and was mounted with a 105 mm Howitzer and 1 x 0.5 Browning machine gun. It was called M7 Priest by the British since the machine gun ring looked like a pulpit.

card_unit_m8_greyhound.name: card_unit_m8_greyhound
card_unit_m8_greyhound.title: M8 GREYHOUND
card_unit_m8_greyhound.text: units in your support line have +1 attack.
card_unit_m8_greyhound.flavorText: The M8 Greyhound was an American light armored car and was mainly used by the Americans and the British who gave it the nickname Greyhound due to its high speed on normal roads. The M8 Greyhound was mainly used for reconnaissance as the 37 mm gun was not very effective against enemy armor.

card_unit_marines.name: card_unit_marines
card_unit_marines.title: 3rd MARINE REGIMENT
card_unit_marines.flavorText: During WWII the 3rd Marine Regiment was attached to the 2nd Marine Brigade. They fought at Bougainville and Guam and during this period their members were awarded four Medals of Honor for their acts of valor. During the Battle of Iwo Jima the 3rd Marines were kept in reserve and were not sent ashore.

card_unit_p38_lightning.name: card_unit_p38_lightning
card_unit_p38_lightning.title: P-38D LIGHTNING
card_unit_p38_lightning.flavorText: and extensively as a long-range escort fighter when equipped with drop tanks under its wings.

card_unit_p40n.name: card_unit_p40n
card_unit_p40n.title: P-40 N-5
card_unit_p40n.text: Units deployed by the enemy have +2 operation cost.
card_unit_p40n.flavorText: both by the Americans and other Allied air forces.

card_unit_p40_warhawk.name: card_unit_p40_warhawk
card_unit_p40_warhawk.title: P-40 WARHAWK
card_unit_p40_warhawk.flavorText: single-seat fighter and ground-attack aircraft that was all metal. The P-40 was agile at low and medium altitudes and was used by most Allies during World War II. War-records claim that over 200 fighter pilots from 7 different nations became Aces flying the P-40.

card_unit_p51_mustang.name: card_unit_p51_mustang
card_unit_p51_mustang.title: P-51 MUSTANG
card_unit_p51_mustang.text: Deployment: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy air unit.
card_unit_p51_mustang.flavorText: both as an escort for bombing raids over Germany and as a fighter-bomber. It is claimed that Mustang pilots destroyed 4,950 enemy aircraft and that it played a large role in ensuring Allied air superiority in 1944.

card_unit_sbd3_dauntless.name: card_unit_sbd3_dauntless
card_unit_sbd3_dauntless.title: SBD 3 DAUNTLESS
card_unit_sbd3_dauntless.flavorText: The SBD 3 Dauntless was a Douglas SBD Dauntless scout plane and dive bomber variant that was first manufactured in 1941. It was flown both from land air bases and aircraft carriers and earned its nickname “Slow But Deadly“ after delivering the fatal blows to the Japanese carriers at the Battle of Midway.

card_unit_t19_howitzer.name: card_unit_t19_howitzer
card_unit_t19_howitzer.title: T19 HOWITZER
card_unit_t19_howitzer.text: Units attacked by T19 HOWITZER lose Guard this turn.
card_unit_t19_howitzer.flavorText: although some were still in use as late as 1944 during the Allied invasion of France.

card_unit_tbf_avanger.name: card_unit_tbf_avanger
card_unit_tbf_avanger.title: TBF-1 AVENGER

In 1944 the division was one of the first to land on Leyte Island in the Philippines where they saw extensive combat in one of the bloodiest battles in the Pacific. card_event_victory_garden.text: Each US unit in your deck gets: "Destruction: Give the top unit in your deck +1+1."
card_event_victory_garden.flavorText: and families often kept hens alongside their vegetable plots for fresh eggs. These gardens transformed neighborhoods into productive spaces and helped maintain morale during a time of scarcity.

card_unit_15th_engineers.name: card_unit_15th_engineers
card_unit_15th_engineers.title: 15th ENGINEERS
card_unit_15th_engineers.text: Deployment: Gain 1 extra kredit slot for each unit in the frontline. Your units gain equal amount of attack.
card_unit_15th_engineers.flavorText: after having supported every major 9th Division campaign in Europe.

card_unit_1st_florida.title: 1st FLORIDA
card_unit_1st_florida.text: Destruction: A random friendly unit gets attack and defense equal to the attack of this unit.

card_unit_41st_infantry_regiment.title: 41st INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_41st_infantry_regiment.text: UNITY IS STRENGTH or WE CAN DO IT!
card_unit_41st_infantry_regiment.flavorText: the regiment continued to serve in major conflicts including Desert Storm and operations in Iraq and Afghanistan.

card_unit_f6f_hellcat_home.title: F6F-5 HELLCAT
card_unit_f6f_hellcat_home.text: it and the top unit of your deck gets +1+1.
card_unit_f6f_hellcat_home.flavorText: more than any other Allied naval plane. Its impact on air superiority was unmatched during the critical campaigns from the Gilbert Islands to Okinawa.

card_unit_m2a4.name: card_unit_m2a4
card_unit_m2a4.title: M2A4
card_unit_m2a4.text: Has Blitz if it has 3 or more attack.
card_unit_m2a4.flavorText: the M2A4 bridged the gap between interwar designs and the modern combat vehicles of WWII.

card_unit_m3_lee_home.name: card_unit_m3_lee_home
card_unit_m3_lee_home.title: M3 LEE
card_unit_m3_lee_home.text: all units in your deck get +1 attack.
card_unit_m3_lee_home.flavorText: the M3 Lee played a vital role in bridging the gap to more advanced designs.

card_unit_magnificent_seven.name: card_unit_magnificent_seven
card_unit_magnificent_seven.title: MAGNIFICENT SEVENTH
card_unit_magnificent_seven.text: the top unit of your deck gets +1+1.
card_unit_magnificent_seven.flavorText: the regiment had been involved in some of the most intense fighting in the Pacific. Its experience reflected the high toll that extended amphibious operations imposed on US forces.

card_unit_p_38_lightning_home.name: card_unit_p_38_lightning_home
card_unit_p_38_lightning_home.title: P-38H LIGHTNING
card_unit_p_38_lightning_home.text: Destruction: The top unit of your deck gets +3 attack and Blitz.
card_unit_p_38_lightning_home.flavorText: endurance and adaptability that proved vital in the air war.

card_unit_red_bull.name: card_unit_red_bull
card_unit_red_bull.title: RED BULL
card_unit_red_bull.text: double the attack of this unit.
card_unit_red_bull.flavorText: was inspired by a soldier’s design from its 1917 training days in New Mexico.

card_unit_the_professionals.name: card_unit_the_professionals
card_unit_the_professionals.title: THE PROFESSIONALS
card_unit_the_professionals.text: Destruction: All units in your deck get +2+3 and a random combat keyword.
card_unit_the_professionals.flavorText: mechanized warfare earned them their other nickname: "Victory’s Spearpoint".

card_unit_thunderbolt.name: card_unit_thunderbolt
card_unit_thunderbolt.title: THUNDERBOLT
card_unit_thunderbolt.text: Deployment: Draw 2 cards. Then choose a card in hand and put it on top of your deck.
card_unit_thunderbolt.flavorText: marking a key moment in the final collapse of Nazi Germany.

card_event_fresh_recruits.name: card_event_fresh_recruits
card_event_fresh_recruits.title: FRESH RECRUITS
card_event_fresh_recruits.flavorText: starting with a skeleton force and ending with a military worthy of a superpower.

card_event_in_hour_of_need.name: card_event_in_hour_of_need
card_event_in_hour_of_need.title: IN HOUR OF NEED
card_event_in_hour_of_need.flavorText: but during the course of the war only 139 were manufactured.

card_event_island_hopping_elit.title: ISLAND HOPPING
card_event_island_hopping_elit.flavorText: but ultimately it led to victory over the Japanese forces.

card_event_mass_deployment.name: card_event_mass_deployment
card_event_mass_deployment.title: MASS DEPLOYMENT
card_event_mass_deployment.text: Add 3 US units to your support line with total cost equal to your kredit slots.
card_event_mass_deployment.flavorText: their largest military deployment was in Europe.

card_event_stars_n_stripes.name: card_event_stars_n_stripes
card_event_stars_n_stripes.title: STARS & STRIPES
card_event_stars_n_stripes.text: Deal 1 damage to each unit in the enemy support line for each unit there.
card_event_stars_n_stripes.flavorText: but it’s also a name of a daily newspaper that reports on matters concerning the members of the US Armed Forces. During WWII the newspaper was printed and distributed in several operating theaters.

card_event_united_we_stand.name: card_event_united_we_stand
card_event_united_we_stand.title: UNITED WE STAND
card_event_united_we_stand.text: both players gain 1 extra kredit slot.
card_event_united_we_stand.flavorText: and other artifacts from WWII that displayed wartime patriotism.

card_unit_1st_texas_infantry.name: card_unit_1st_texas_infantry
card_unit_1st_texas_infantry.title: 1st TEXAS INFANTRY
card_unit_1st_texas_infantry.text: Double attack and defense when you gain an extra kredit slot.
card_unit_1st_texas_infantry.flavorText: and the first troops of the 36th Division to enter Germany.

card_unit_26th_infantry_regiment.title: 26th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_26th_infantry_regiment.text: Has +2 attack for each adjacent unit.
card_unit_26th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: but would later do occupation duties in Germany and serve as guards at the Nuremberg Trials.

card_unit_2nd_california.name: card_unit_2nd_california
card_unit_2nd_california.title: 2nd CALIFORNIA
card_unit_2nd_california.text: Combat damage dealt to this unit is reduced to 1.
card_unit_2nd_california.flavorText: the 184th was sent to Korea in order to disarm the garrison and there it served as an occupation force until 1946.

card_unit_37mm_m1_aa_gun.title: 37mm M1 AA GUN
card_unit_37mm_m1_aa_gun.text: reset the attack of the defending unit.
card_unit_37mm_m1_aa_gun.flavorText: but some batteries had four 37 mm guns. The 37 mm would later be replaced with the 40 mm Bofors gun M1.

card_unit_507th_pir.title: 507th PIR
card_unit_507th_pir.text: give a random friendly infantry unit +2 attack.
card_unit_507th_pir.flavorText: the airborne crossing the Rhine and the largest airborne operation in history. The regiment continued fighting with the 17th Airborne Division in Germany until the war ended in May 1945.

card_unit_pb4y_2_privateer.name: card_unit_pb4y_2_privateer
card_unit_pb4y_2_privateer.title: PB4Y-2 PRIVATEER
card_unit_pb4y_2_privateer.text: It costs the enemy +2 kredits to target or attack this unit.
card_unit_pb4y_2_privateer.flavorText: some of which were produced after the war.

card_unit_p_40_k.name: card_unit_p_40_k
card_unit_p_40_k.title: P-40 K
card_unit_p_40_k.flavorText: but a few were sent to Britain under Lend-Lease and were redesignated as Kittyhawk III.

card_unit_red_devils.name: card_unit_red_devils
card_unit_red_devils.title: RED DEVILS
card_unit_red_devils.text: It costs the enemy +1 kredits to target or attack this unit.
card_unit_red_devils.flavorText: where they defended their positions against the German Panzer Divisions. After the Battle of the Bulge the regiment saw little combat and in 1946 it returned to the US and deactivated.

card_unit_sb2c_helldiver.name: card_unit_sb2c_helldiver
card_unit_sb2c_helldiver.title: SB2C HELLDIVER
card_unit_sb2c_helldiver.text: add a copy of this unit to your hand.

card_location_arracourt.name: card_location_arracourt
card_location_arracourt.title: ARRACOURT
card_location_arracourt.text: The Battle of Arracourt was a 1944 tank battle between US and German forces.
card_location_arracourt.flavorText: marking a decisive victory that furthered the Allies' push toward Germany.

card_location_cherbourg.name: card_location_cherbourg
card_location_cherbourg.title: CHERBOURG
card_location_cherbourg.text: Cherbourg was an important harbor for the Allies after D-Day.

card_location_guadalcanal.name: card_location_guadalcanal
card_location_guadalcanal.title: GUADALCANAL
card_location_guadalcanal.flavorText: and was the first Allied major land offensive against Japan and the first decisive victory won by the Allies in the Pacific.  What made the island a strategic place of importance was the Henderson Field air base which helped the Allies to control the sea lines of communications between Australia and the United States.

card_location_washington_waw.name: card_location_washington_waw
card_location_washington_waw.title: WASHINGTON
card_location_washington_waw.text: Washington DC played a vital role in the United States planning and preparation for WWII.
card_location_washington_waw.flavorText: but the military did put up some anti-aircraft guns in the city just to be safe.

card_event_air_cover_us.flavorText: while the P-47 Thunderbolt and P-51 Mustang dominated in Europe.

card_event_night_patrol.flavorText: it was the smaller boats that took the risks close to shore.

card_event_semper_fi.name: card_event_semper_fi
card_event_semper_fi.title: SEMPER FI
card_event_semper_fi.text: Convert 4 of the top 8 cards of your deck into 22nd MARINES. Give them the Navy type.
card_event_semper_fi.flavorText: and Anchor emblem holds a ribbon emblazoned "Semper Fidelis".

card_event_strike_group.name: card_event_strike_group
card_event_strike_group.title: STRIKE GROUP
card_event_strike_group.text:
Show when drawn: Draw a random air unit from your deck.
Your air units get +1+1.
card_event_strike_group.flavorText: and delivered sustained pressure on Japan’s shrinking perimeter.

card_event_uss_arcfish.name: card_event_uss_arcfish
card_event_uss_arcfish.title: USS ARCHERFISH
card_event_uss_arcfish.text: Destroy a random enemy unit. Repeat if there is a Navy card on top of your deck.

card_event_uss_fitch.name: card_event_uss_fitch
card_event_uss_fitch.title: USS FITCH
card_event_uss_fitch.text: Give your units +1+1. Give them +2+2 instead if there is a Navy card on top of your deck.

card_event_uss_missouri.name: card_event_uss_missouri
card_event_uss_missouri.title: USS MISSOURI
card_event_uss_missouri.text: Destroy target unit in the frontline. Retreat adjacent units.
card_event_uss_missouri.flavorText: she is preserved as a museum ship at Pearl Harbor.

card_unit_175th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_175th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_175th_infantry_regiment.title: 175th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_175th_infantry_regiment.text: Deployment: Choose a card in hand. Put it on top of your deck.
card_unit_175th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: before returning home and reactivating later that year.

card_unit_22nd_marines.name: card_unit_22nd_marines
card_unit_22nd_marines.title: 22nd MARINES
card_unit_22nd_marines.text: Becomes Veteran and you draw a card when you play a Navy card.
card_unit_22nd_marines.flavorText: the regiment was sent to China to help oversee the surrender and repatriation of Japanese forces before being inactivated in March 1946.

card_unit_4th_alabama.name: card_unit_4th_alabama
card_unit_4th_alabama.title: 4th ALABAMA
card_unit_4th_alabama.text: Show when drawn: Give your units +1 attack until end of turn.
card_unit_4th_alabama.flavorText: returning to the United States in December 1945.

card_unit_pb2y_coronado.title: PB2Y CORONADO

card_unit_sykes_regulars.title: SYKES REGULARS
card_unit_sykes_regulars.text: Draw 3 cards when this unit moves into the frontline.
card_unit_sykes_regulars.flavorText: the most heavily engaged unit in the United States Army during WWII.

card_unit_the_123s.name: card_unit_the_123s
card_unit_the_123s.title: 123s
card_unit_the_123s.text: this unit is Converted into it and gains this ability.
card_unit_the_123s.flavorText: the 123rd Infantry Regiment served as part of the occupation forces in Japan until its demobilization in early 1946.

card_unit_the_american_guard.name: card_unit_the_american_guard
card_unit_the_american_guard.title: THE AMERICAN GUARD
card_unit_the_american_guard.text: Deployment: Choose a card in hand. Convert the top card of your deck into it.
card_unit_the_american_guard.flavorText: the 44th Division returned to the US in July and was inactivated in November 1945 following the end of the war.

card_event_naval_battle.name: card_event_naval_battle
card_event_naval_battle.title: NAVAL BATTLE
card_event_naval_battle.text: Choose One - Destroy all units with an odd cost OR even cost.
card_event_naval_battle.flavorText: was killed and received the Medal of Honor posthumously.

card_event_parachute_assault.name: card_event_parachute_assault
card_event_parachute_assault.title: PARACHUTE ASSAULT
card_event_parachute_assault.text: Fill your support line with 506th AIRBORNE. Give them Blitz and Shock.
card_event_parachute_assault.flavorText: and additional infantry followed in gliders.

card_event_quinine.name: card_event_quinine
card_event_quinine.title: QUININE
card_event_quinine.text: Target infantry gets +1+2 and -1 operation cost.

card_event_surprise_engagement.name: card_event_surprise_engagement
card_event_surprise_engagement.title: SURPRISE ENGAGEMENT
card_event_surprise_engagement.text: Costs 2 less if Rain was played this turn. Destroy a random enemy unit. Draw the top unit of your deck.
card_event_surprise_engagement.flavorText: the Japanese offensive lost strength. The fighting around the Driniumor river showed how quickly a quiet jungle front could erupt into a brutal infantry battle at close range.

card_event_usaaf.name: card_event_usaaf
card_event_usaaf.title: USAAF
card_event_usaaf.text: Draw a US bomber and a US fighter from your deck.
card_event_usaaf.flavorText: the USAAF had effectively become an independent air service in all but name. Its wartime experience led to the creation of the independent United States Air Force in September 1947.

card_event_us_weather_bureau.name: card_event_us_weather_bureau
card_event_us_weather_bureau.title: US WEATHER BUREAU
card_event_us_weather_bureau.text: Choose One - Forecast OR draw a card.
card_event_us_weather_bureau.flavorText: shipping and public safety had become too high.

card_unit_116th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_116th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_116th_infantry_regiment.title: 116th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_116th_infantry_regiment.text: Deployment: Give a friendly infantry and all units with the same name in hand and deck +5+5.
card_unit_116th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: where the 29th Infantry Division linked up with Soviet forces shortly before Germany’s surrender.

card_unit_162nd_regiment.name: card_unit_162nd_regiment
card_unit_162nd_regiment.title: 162nd REGIMENT
card_unit_162nd_regiment.text: Combat damage dealt to your infantry is reduced to 2. Fully repair your infantry when you play a Rain card.
card_unit_162nd_regiment.flavorText: before preparing for the planned invasion of Japan.

card_unit_1st_infantry_regiment_us.name: card_unit_1st_infantry_regiment_us
card_unit_1st_infantry_regiment_us.title: 1st INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_1st_infantry_regiment_us.text: it operates for free this turn.
card_unit_1st_infantry_regiment_us.flavorText: where the 6th Infantry Division was tasked with occupation duties. The 1st Infantry Regiment remained there until its inactivation in 1949.

card_unit_6th_marine_regiment.name: card_unit_6th_marine_regiment
card_unit_6th_marine_regiment.title: 6th MARINE REGIMENT
card_unit_6th_marine_regiment.text: Has Blitz and 0 operation cost if Sunny or Rain was played this turn.
card_unit_6th_marine_regiment.flavorText: but the war ended before that landing happened.

card_unit_duck_us.name: card_unit_duck_us
card_unit_duck_us.title: DUCK
card_unit_duck_us.text: Gets +1+1 and you Forecast when you move it into the frontline.
card_unit_duck_us.flavorText: carrying five passengers and pilot Roland J. Barnick. It was the last aircraft to leave Bataan before the Allied surrender there. Ducks later served at Guadalcanal in search and rescue missions.

card_unit_fifth_ohio.name: card_unit_fifth_ohio
card_unit_fifth_ohio.title: FIFTH OHIO
card_unit_fifth_ohio.text: Deployment: Destroy target enemy unit with combined attack and defense of 6 or less.
card_unit_fifth_ohio.flavorText: and stormed intra muros through the Quezon and Parian Gates.

card_unit_kingfisher_us.name: card_unit_kingfisher_us
card_unit_kingfisher_us.title: KINGFISHER

card_event_direct_hit.name: card_event_direct_hit
card_event_direct_hit.title: DIRECT HIT

card_event_high_altitude_bombing.name: card_event_high_altitude_bombing
card_event_high_altitude_bombing.title: HIGH ALTITUDE BOMBING
card_event_high_altitude_bombing.flavorText: the tactic of dropping bombs on a target from a high altitude. At the start of WWII the US air forces used heavy bombers such as the B-17 and the B-24 Liberator for high altitude and the 1930s technology of gyroscope-stabilized optical bombsights helped them to strike their targets with more accuracy. The B-29 Superfortress was introduced in 1944 and it was designed for high altitude bombing and the technology exceeded all its predecessors.

card_event_patrol.name: card_event_patrol
card_event_patrol.title: PATROL
card_event_patrol.text: Smokescreen and Destruction. Deal 2 damage to it.
card_event_patrol.flavorText: The Guadalcanal Campaign was a war of attrition which escalated over a period of 6 months. There were times when weeks or months would pass without the Americans encountering the enemy and much time was spent patrolling the island while trying to hunt down and eliminate the Japanese resistance.

card_event_special_delivery_us.name: card_event_special_delivery_us
card_event_special_delivery_us.title: SPECIAL DELIVERY
card_event_special_delivery_us.flavorText: Reinforcements and supplies for the starved and malaria-ridden Marines that had been on Guadalcanal island since early August 1942 finally started to arrive in October that same year. The first unit to arrive was the 164th Infantry Regiment of the Americal Division. By end of the year US forces were strong enough to begin the final offensive on the island.

card_unit_164th_infantry_regiment.name: card_unit_164th_infantry_regiment
card_unit_164th_infantry_regiment.title: 164th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card_unit_164th_infantry_regiment.text: Destruction: Give a random friendly unit +1+1.
card_unit_164th_infantry_regiment.flavorText: at first they managed to withstand repeated assaults by the Japanese and later they participated in jungle patroles in an attempt to eliminate resistance on the island. After the Battle of Guadalcanal the 164th Regiment had gained valuable experience in jungle warfare. The regiment fought in the Bougainville campaign as part of the 5307th Composite Unit (AKA Merrill’s Marauders) which was a special operations jungle warfare unit.

The US Army managed to amass around 350 guns of all calibers in the northern sector of the Bulge which was one of the largest concentrations of artillery in history. This massive firepower helped slow down the German advance and proved vital in the Allied defense of Elsenborn Ridge and Bastogne.

In December 1944 the division was sent to reinforce the Allied southern flank in Belgium during the Battle of the Bulge.
